izzyondroid:com.kitsumed.shizucallrecord.name: ShizuCallRecorder
izzyondroid:com.kitsumed.shizucallrecord.summary: Empowers ADB through Shizuku to record phone calls on non-rooted device!
izzyondroid:com.kitsumed.shizucallrecord.description:
ShizuCallRecorder is the first non-root FOSS call recorder app for Android 11+ .
 This app main focus are Cellular/VoLTE calls, however, we do attempt to support Wifi-Calling and VoIP when possible . Third-party app support is not guaranteed , they may work provided they use Android Telecom.
 Features 
 Records both sides of phone calls (incoming and outgoing) Should work even when using Bluetooth or a remote headset
 Separate uplink and downlink audio inside a stereo recording
 Security toggles to manage Shizuku on/off state An attempt to reduce the potential attack surface introduced by Shizuku
 Helps with apps that detect / yells at you when USB Debugging or Shizuku is enabled
 Automatic call recording option with basic exclusion rules : Ignore anonymous calls
 Ignore specific contacts
 Ignore all contacts
 Multiple codecs available: Opus , AAC , HE-AAC-v1 , and more!
 The app runs only on phone event changes, no persistent background process and notifications
 Requirements 
 Android 11 or newer
 See the Android Tested Versions table on GitHub for more information on limitations
 Shizuku (recommended fork: thedjchi )
 Installation 
 Please follow the installation instructions in the SUPPORT documentation , under Installation & Configuration .
 Please note that the official release source is GitHub. 
 Support the Project 
 If you find ShizuCallRecorder useful and want to support its development, you can contribute in several ways:
 Contribute to the project on GitHub: Contributing Guide 
 Support ongoing development via GitHub Sponsors: Sponsor kitsumed 
 Disclaimer 
 Recording phone calls may be subject to complex and varying laws in different countries and jurisdictions. 
 For example, you may need to ensure you have consent from all parties before recording conversations.The developers and contributors are not responsible for any misuse or legal consequences arising from the use of this application.
 You can learn more on Wikipedia at : Telephone call recording laws .
 If you are legally required to inform or ask someone for consent before recording , please note that the application DOES NOT handle this for you . In some cases, certain features, like automatic call recording, may not be legally allowed. It is your responsibility to ensure compliance with applicable laws. This is not legal advice . Please consult a legal professional for guidance regarding your specific situation.

izzyondroid:dev.abhi.photon.name: Photon
izzyondroid:dev.abhi.photon.description:
Photon is a cross-platform file-transfer application. It uses http to transfer files between devices.You can transfer files between devices that run Photon. No wifi router is required, you can use hotspot.
 Features include e.g.:
 Cross-platform support: For instance you can transfer files between Android and Windows
 Transfer multiple files: You can pick any number of files.
 Pick files faster: Most of the apps use file_picker for picking the files. But for android it caches files before retrieving the paths. If the file size is large it will result in considerable amount of delay. So I have tweaked file_picker to avoid caching(android) unless it is required (some files need to be cached). No matter how many files are selected ,paths will be retrieved within no time. (Note:Caching issue is android specific)
 Smooth UI: Material You design.
 Works between the devices connected via mobile-hotspot / between the devices connected to same router (same local area network)
 Uses cryptographically secure secret code generation for authentication (internally): Even though the files are streamed at local area network,files cannot be downloaded/received without using Photon. No external client like browser can get the files using url,as secret code is associated with url. It will be regenerated for every session.
 Supports high-speed data transfer: Photon is capable of transferring files at a very high rate but it depends upon the wifi bandwidth. (No internet connection required)

izzyondroid:devs.org.calculator.name: Calculator - Hide Files
izzyondroid:devs.org.calculator.summary: Encrypted file vault with calculator interface
izzyondroid:devs.org.calculator.description:
Calculator Hide File App is an open-source Android application that combines a functional calculator interface with a secure private file storage feature. It allows users to store and manage personal files such as images, videos, documents, and notes, protected by a passcode.
 Key Features: 
 Dual Functionality: A fully working calculator alongside a private file storage area accessible via passcode.
 Passcode Protection: Access your private files securely using a user-defined code.
 Secure File Manager: Add, remove, and organize files within a protected local environment.
 Local Storage: All files are stored on-device, ensuring user control and privacy.
 Lightweight & Fast: Designed to run smoothly across a wide range of Android devices.
 No Root Required: Works on standard Android devices without requiring root access.
 File Encryption: Protect stored data using encryption mechanisms.
 How It Works: 
 Calculator Mode: Use the app as a standard calculator for everyday calculations.
 Access Private Storage: Enter your passcode to open the secure file storage area.
 Manage Files: Import, organize, and remove files within the app. Data remains protected locally on your device.
 Requirements: 
 Android 6.0 or higher
 Storage permissions enabled
 “Manage All Files” permission may be required on Android 11+ for full file access functionality
 Technologies Used: Kotlin, XML, Android SDK, MediaStore API, and secure local storage techniques
 Open Source: This project is fully open-source, allowing users to inspect the code and verify how data is handled.
 Privacy Focus: The app operates entirely offline and does not collect or share user data.

fdroid:biz.binarysolutions.healthybatter.name: Healthy Battery Charging
fdroid:biz.binarysolutions.healthybatter.summary: Prolong the life of your battery by keeping it charged between 40% and 80%
fdroid:biz.binarysolutions.healthybatter.description:
Make your smartphone or tablet battery last longer!
Good range to aim for when charging a Li-ion battery is from about 40 to 80 percent in one go. A bunch of tiny charges throughout the day is your second best bet, and going from zero to 100 and then 100 to zero on a regular basis will put the most strain on your lithium-ion battery.
Healthy Battery Charging notifies you when to plug or unplug your phone from the charger in order to improve the battery life. The app itself is optimized for low battery consumption, running in the background and checking the battery level every 15 minutes (configurable). The exact timing of these checks depends on the Android OS, which might schedule them alongside other tasks or delay them when in sleep mode. As a result, the battery level may slightly exceed the high threshold while charging or drop slightly below the low threshold while discharging before you receive a notification.
For those who want to know more technical details about Li-ion batteries:
https://batteryuniversity.com/learn/article/how_to_prolong_lithium_based_batteries

fdroid:com.aka.alarm.name: aka Alarm
fdroid:com.aka.alarm.summary: Wakes you within a 30-min window when you start stirring
fdroid:com.aka.alarm.description:
aka Alarm wakes you at the right moment within a 30-minute window you choose, instead of jolting you out of bed at a fixed time.
How it works: while an alarm is armed the app uses the microphone to measure the ambient sound level of your room. It maintains a rolling 5-minute baseline of "how quiet it really is" and watches for the level to rise above that baseline by a configurable threshold. When that happens — you turn over, sigh, shift the duvet — the alarm fires. If nothing happens, the alarm fires at the end of the window so you never oversleep.
Privacy: the microphone is active only while an alarm is set, and audio is processed in memory then immediately discarded. No audio buffer is ever written to disk, persisted, or transmitted off your device. There is no network code in this app at all — no analytics, no crash reporting, no third-party SDKs.
Features:
• Wake-up window with smart spike detection on the microphone
• 60-second gradual volume fade-in for the alarm tone
• Motion-driven snooze (lightly move the phone) with random duration clamped to the remaining window
• Slide up anywhere to dismiss
• Foreground service keeps the alarm reliable overnight
• Material 3 UI with dark + light mode
aka Alarm is open source under the MIT licence: https://github.com/seeingred/aka-alarm

 Separate front and rear target pressures, with warnings when a tyre drifts

fdroid:com.phonepvr.friends.name: Bondwidth
fdroid:com.phonepvr.friends.summary: Private, offline phone & contacts app that helps you keep up your bonds
fdroid:com.phonepvr.friends.description:
Bondwidth is an all-in-one phone, contacts, and relationship app that works entirely on your device. No accounts, no servers, no tracking — and it quietly helps you stay close to the people who matter.
Friendship is small attentions, often. Set a check-in cadence for each person and Bondwidth gently flags who's getting too quiet, so you can reach out before silence becomes a habit. Birthdays and anniversaries are remembered for you, and the calls you make are counted automatically.
Private by design
* No internet permission at all — the app cannot reach the network, and its build pipeline fails if that ever changes.
* No accounts, no servers, no cloud. Everything stays in the app's private storage on your device.
* No analytics, no ads, no third-party trackers.
* Optional encrypted backups (AES-256-GCM) that only you can open.
* Optional biometric app lock and a "hide from screenshots" mode.
Phone
* Default dialer with its own in-call screen, Picture-in-Picture, and per-contact ringtones.
* T9 smart dial, speed dial, and dual-SIM call routing.
* Block numbers, missed-call notifications, call history and search.
* Colour-coded call directions, with optional WhatsApp / Signal shortcuts.
Contacts
* Browse, create, edit and delete contacts, with group filtering.
* Typed phone numbers, emails, postal address, website, organisation, notes and birthday.
* Find and merge duplicates; import and export vCard files.
Bonds
* Per-person check-in cadence with gentle overdue nudges.
* Birthday and anniversary reminders, with a "Mark as wished" action.
* An interaction timeline and an at-a-glance relationship dashboard.
* A home-screen widget for upcoming occasions and who you haven't spoken to lately.
Bondwidth is free software (GPL-3.0). Its phone and contacts features are derived from the Fossify Phone and Fossify Contacts projects.

fdroid:io.github.digitalvalut.logos.name: DigitalValut Logos
fdroid:io.github.digitalvalut.logos.summary: Encrypted peer-to-peer chat and calls. No account, no server, no phone number.
fdroid:io.github.digitalvalut.logos.description:
Peer-to-peer encrypted chat, voice and video calls, and file sharing — directly
between two devices, with no account, no phone number, and no server that ever
sees a message.
Two browsers negotiate a private WebRTC connection and talk to each other
directly. A small relay only ever helps them find each other and, when an
unusually strict network requires it, forwards traffic that is already
encrypted and which it has no key to read. There is no database anywhere
holding conversations.
The relay is a Cloudflare Worker run by the project
(digitalvalut-turn.burbeng78.workers.dev); the connection helpers (STUN/TURN)
are Cloudflare's (stun.cloudflare.com, turn.cloudflare.com). The relay address
is fixed in the app. Its source is in the same repository (turn-worker/), so
anyone can run their own, but using it means rebuilding the app.
 How you reach someone 
A permanent address (DV-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) is the SHA-256 hash of a key pair
generated on the device, so it verifies itself: whoever dials it fetches the
published key, checks that it really hashes back to the address dialled, and
only then trusts it. A substituted key produces a different address and is
rejected. Up to eight throwaway addresses can be held alongside the permanent
one, each revocable on its own.
You can also connect by a tappable invite link, or by scanning a QR code in
person.
 Knowing who you are really talking to 
The first time you connect to someone, both sides see the same three-word
security code, derived from the actual cryptographic handshake — the same
principle used by ZRTP-based secure calling. Read them aloud once; if they
match, nobody is sitting in the middle. That check is bound to the other
person's cryptographic fingerprint, not to a display name.
 What it does 
• Text, emoji, voice messages, photos, video and files up to 512 MB, sent
 uncompressed at original quality
• Photos have their embedded GPS location, device model and software metadata
 stripped on-device before sending, without re-encoding the image
• Audio and video calls with screen sharing
• The phone rings even with the app closed, without Google and without Firebase:
 a service belonging to the app reads its own encrypted mailbox, and the
 question it asks has only yes or no for an answer. It holds no key and can
 read nothing; who is calling, and what they wrote, are read by the app when
 you open it. It uses more battery than a push notification would, and it is
 off until you turn it on
• A sealed letter for someone who does not answer, held up to 7 days, openable
 only by the address owner
• Self-destructing messages and optional automatic cleanup of old conversations
• Interface in 13 languages, with right-to-left layout for Arabic and Urdu
 Honest limits 
Both people need to be online at the same time for a live conversation. That is
the price of having no server, and it is architectural, not a bug.
Your IP address is visible to the person you connect to, as it is in any direct
peer-to-peer connection, unless you switch on "Hide where you are".
 About this package 
The entire application is inside this package. It is not a wrapper that opens a
website: the app is served from the package's own storage, so what runs on your
phone is what was built from the source in this repository, and it keeps working
when the website cannot be reached at all.
There is no push notification service anywhere in it — no Google Play Services,
no Firebase, no account. The only background service is the app's own, described
above, and it talks to nothing but the same relay the app already uses. Every
cryptographic primitive comes from the system's own Web Crypto implementation.
No third-party script, library or CDN resource is loaded at any point.
Built by Associazione di Promozione Sociale DigitalValut, an Italian nonprofit.
Free forever, with no account and nothing to buy.

fdroid:io.github.ewoc2026.visualroutines.name: Visual Routines

fdroid:io.github.ewoc2026.visualroutines.description:
Visual Routines is a local-first Android app for creating and following simple everyday routines one step at a time.
Create routines with short steps and optional notes. Add one optional bundled or locally selected image to a step. While running a routine, see the current step, go back, mark it done, skip it, pause, continue later, reset, or finish.

The app has no account, backend, analytics, advertising, tracking, or Internet permission. Cloud backup is disabled. Supported Android device-to-device migration may transfer a narrow set of app data.
Visual Routines does not provide its own export or import feature. It is a general everyday tool, not a medical, therapeutic, emergency, productivity, habit-tracking, or remote-care service.
Create a personal routine from an example, then change it to suit your needs. You can send feedback through your email app from Settings.

fdroid:io.github.rastislavpapp.justopenl.name: just open links in a browser
fdroid:io.github.rastislavpapp.justopenl.summary: Sends links to your real browser instead of an app's built-in one
fdroid:io.github.rastislavpapp.justopenl.description:
Android apps love opening links in an in-app browser: a bare little window
inside the app, with one page, no tabs, no extensions, no history, and nothing
left when you close it.
This app sends those links to your real browser instead.
Set it as your default browser, then open it once to pick which of your
installed browsers links should go to. From then on, every link an app hands to
the system arrives in the browser you actually use, with your bookmarks, your
logins and your content blocker.
That is the whole app. There are no settings beyond that one choice. It has no
network access of its own, and contains no analytics, no advertising and no
tracking. It never loads a page: it passes the link on and gets out of the way.
One limit worth knowing about. Some apps do not hand the link to the system at
all and draw the page themselves. Facebook and Instagram are the usual
examples. Nothing installed on the device can redirect those, this app
included.

fdroid:org.strongswan.android.name: strongSwan VPN Client
fdroid:org.strongswan.android.summary: An easy to use IKEv2/IPsec-based VPN client.
fdroid:org.strongswan.android.description:
Official Android port of the popular strongSwan VPN solution.
# FEATURES AND LIMITATIONS #
 Uses the VpnService API featured by Android 4+. Devices by some manufacturers seem to lack support for this - strongSwan VPN Client won't work on these devices!
 Uses the IKEv2 key exchange protocol
 Uses IPsec for data traffic
 Full support for changed connectivity and mobility through MOBIKE (or reauthentication)
 Supports username/password EAP authentication (namely EAP-MSCHAPv2, EAP-MD5 and EAP-GTC) as well as RSA/ECDSA private key/certificate authentication to authenticate users, EAP-TLS with client certificates is also supported
 Combined RSA/ECDSA and EAP authentication is supported by using two authentication rounds as defined in RFC 4739
 VPN server certificates are verified against the CA certificates pre-installed or installed by the user on the system. The CA or server certificates used to authenticate the server can also be imported directly into the app.
 IKEv2 fragmentation is supported if the VPN server supports it (strongSwan does so since 5.2.1)
 Split-tunneling allows sending only certain traffic through the VPN and/or excluding specific traffic from it
 Per-app VPN allows limiting the VPN connection to specific apps, or exclude them from using it
 The IPsec implementation currently supports the AES-CBC, AES-GCM, ChaCha20/Poly1305 and SHA1/SHA2 algorithms
 Passwords are currently stored as cleartext in the database (only if stored with a profile)
 VPN profiles may be imported from files
 Supports managed configurations via enterprise mobility management (EMM)
Details and a changelog can be found in our documentation: https://docs.strongswan.org/docs/latest/os/androidVpnClient.html
# PERMISSIONS #
 READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Allows importing VPN profiles and CA certificates from external storage on some Android versions
 QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: Required on Android 11+ to select apps to ex-/include in VPN profiles and the optional EAP-TNC use case
# EXAMPLE SERVER CONFIGURATION #
Example server configurations may be found in our documentation: https://docs.strongswan.org/docs/latest/os/androidVpnClient.html#_server_configuration
Please note that the host name (or IP address) configured with a VPN profile in the app *must be* contained in the server certificate as subjectAltName extension.
# FEEDBACK #
Please post bug reports and feature requests via GitHub: https://github.com/strongswan/strongswan/issues/new/choose
If you do so, please include information about your device (manufacturer, model, OS version etc.).
The log file written by the key exchange service can be sent directly from within the application.

NewsGator is a news aggregator built to end information overload. It gathers every article covering the same real-world event, from all your sources, into a single Story. It gives that story a realistic, clickbait-free title and keeps a neutral summary up to date as new facts emerge. Then it sends you to the original publisher, so the people who did the reporting get your visit.
WHY I BUILT IT
I was tired of skipping articles I had already read somewhere else. My first version was a server running AI models next to my Mac Studio, and it worked great, but I knew nobody should need a home AI server just to read the news. Apple Intelligence changed that: now NewsGator runs on your devices, with no server and no account. Since then I follow twice as many sources, and I read each event only once.
ONE EVENT, ONE STORY
• Story Clustering: Multiple articles reporting on the same event are merged into a single Story card. No more scrolling past twenty headlines about the exact same announcement.
• Honest Titles: Every story gets a factual title that says what happened. No clickbait.
• Living Summaries: The summary is refined as new facts emerge, and the story is badged "updated" — never returning already-read news as unread.
READ THE SOURCE, SUPPORT ITS AUTHOR
Interested in a story? One tap opens the original publisher's website, so your visit, subscription or ad views go to the journalists who did the work. The summary is a triage tool, not a replacement for real journalism.
RUN IT YOUR WAY: TWO ENGINES
• Standalone with Apple Intelligence: No server or subscription required. Runs entirely on your Apple devices using Apple Foundation Models (Apple Private Cloud Compute and on-device System Language Models). Your feeds and read states sync seamlessly across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac via your private iCloud account.
• Optional Server Mode: Connect to a self-hosted NewsGator server for centralized multi-user ingestion, any AI model server of your choice (oMLX, Ollama, LM Studio…), IMAP newsletter mailboxes, and third-party RSS reader sync (FreshRSS, Miniflux, Inoreader).
INTERACTIVE ARCHIVE CHAT
• Chat Your Archive: Need to recall where or when you read something? Ask questions directly to your news library. Answers are grounded in your stored stories and cite clickable source cards.
ADDITIONAL HIGHLIGHTS
• Ingest Anything: Supports RSS and Atom feeds, OPML import and export, newsletter inboxes, and YouTube channels (import your subscriptions; videos are summarized from their transcript and play in the story).
• Reader Experience: Mobile touch-first swipe deck (swipe left to mark read, swipe right for previous) and desktop split-view navigation.
• Listen (Pro): Turn the current News selection into a spoken queue that always starts at your first unread story. Natural voices run fully on your device, with adjustable speed and pauses. Works with media controls, Siri save shortcuts and CarPlay.
• Siri & Shortcuts: Full App Intents integration for daily news briefings, archive queries, and hands-free Listen saves.
• Zero Tracking: No ads, no third-party trackers, no analytics. Your feeds and your reading stay yours.

- Shortcuts and Siri — "Save clipboard to KeepText," or add it to your Action
 button for one-press capture.
SEARCH THAT TELLS YOU THE TRUTH
Most apps guess. KeepText matches exactly — the word you typed, or the start
of it, and nothing looser. That sounds like a limitation until you use it: when
KeepText says nothing matched, it genuinely isn't saved yet, so you can create
it right there instead of wondering whether you're about to make a duplicate.
TEMPLATES
Put {{name}} or {{date}} anywhere in a snippet. When you use it, KeepText asks
you for the values and fills them in. Good for the email you send constantly
with one line that changes.
SYNCS EVERYWHERE. NO ACCOUNT. EVER.
Your snippets sync across your devices through your own iCloud account. There
is no KeepText account, no sign-up, no password, no server of ours in the
middle. Nothing to breach, because there's nowhere for your text to go.
The keyboard asks for Full Access because that is the only way iOS lets a
keyboard read the snippets stored on your own device. KeepText uses it for
exactly that. Nothing is collected, nothing is transmitted, there's no
analytics — the app has no account system to send anything to in the first
place. You can export everything you've saved to a plain JSON file whenever
you like.
FREE, THEN ONE SMALL PURCHASE
Keep up to 20 snippets free for as long as you want. One small purchase
unlocks unlimited snippets, forever. No subscription. No trial that quietly
starts charging. No ads.
NO FOLDERS
You'll notice there's no filing system. That's deliberate. Search and
frequency do the organizing, so saving something costs you one tap instead of
one decision — which is the whole reason your snippets actually get saved

flathub:com.kjxbyz.PicGuardPro.description:
Introducing PicGuard Pro - the ultimate solution for securing and customizing your digital photos.
 With our app, you can easily add watermarks to your images to protect your creative work and maintain
 your privacy.
 PicGuard Pro offers robust privacy protection features, ensuring your personal and sensitive
 information remains safeguarded. It's highly customizable, allowing you to personalize watermarks
 with various fonts, styles, and designs to suit your needs.
 Accessible on web, mobile, and desktop, you can seamlessly integrate and manage your watermarking
 tasks across all your devices. PicGuard Pro, as an open-source tool, it's not only free but also

flathub:fr.inria.corese.CoreseGui.name: Corese GUI
flathub:fr.inria.corese.CoreseGui.description:
Corese GUI is an interactive sandbox for working with RDF data. It provides an intuitive
 graphical environment for loading, exploring, querying, reasoning, and validating
 semantic datasets.
 The application supports multiple RDF serialization formats for import/export, includes
 a
 Turtle editor, and allows running SPARQL queries directly. It also integrates reasoning
 engines, supporting both standard profiles like RDFS and OWL, as well as custom rule
 files for advanced inferencing workflows.
 With Corese GUI, users can visualize and manipulate semantic data, test SHACL
 validations, and prototype knowledge-based systems with ease.

flathub:in.p1x.TanksOfFreedom.name: Tanks of Freedom
flathub:in.p1x.TanksOfFreedom.summary: Indie Turn Based Strategy in Isometric Pixel Art
flathub:in.p1x.TanksOfFreedom.description:
A classic turn-based strategy game with two armies fighting against each other. Challenge yourself
 in campaign against AI or hot-seat battle with a friend. Using the easy map editor you can create

flathub:in.varb.Ausweiskopie.name: Meine Ausweiskopie
flathub:in.varb.Ausweiskopie.summary: Redact and mark German id copies
flathub:in.varb.Ausweiskopie.description:
Easily watermark and hide information in copies of your (German) identity documents!
 This tool allows watermarking copies of German identity documents. You can also redact information

 Dieses Werkzeug ermöglicht es eine Ausweiskopie eindeutig als Kopie und mit Wasserzeichen zu
 kennzeichnen. Für den Adressaten unwichtige Daten (z. B. die CAN oder die Ausweisnummer) können
 geschwärzt werden.
 Currently, this tool supports the following documents:
 Temporary German identity cards (issued on paper)
 Regular German identity cards (all revisions)

flathub:io.github.Andrettin.Wyrmsun.name: Wyrmsun
flathub:io.github.Andrettin.Wyrmsun.summary: Strategy game based on history, mythology and fiction
flathub:io.github.Andrettin.Wyrmsun.description:
In the Wyrmsun universe a myriad of inhabited planets exist. Humans dwell on Earth, while dwarves
 inhabit Nidavellir and elves nourish the world of Alfheim. These peoples struggle to carve a place
 for themselves with their tools of stone, bronze and iron. And perhaps one day they will meet one
 another, beyond the stars...
 Features:
 Retro-style graphics
 3 playable civilizations, and a number of non-playable ones
 Scenarios playable on a huge map
 Dozens of units, buildings and technologies
 Personal names and traits for units
 Units can earn experience, being able to upgrade to new unit types or acquire new abilities
 upon level-up
 Persistent heroes, who carry over their level and abilities throughout scenarios
 Possibility to create your own custom persistent heroes
 Normal, magic-enchanted and unique items drop from enemies
 Cave, Conifer Forest, Dungeon, Fairlimbed Forest and Swamp tilesets
 Dozens of maps of real and fictional locations to choose from, as well as random maps
 Very moddable game, with mod-loading capability built in
 In-game encyclopedia, allowing players to learn more about the units, buildings and other
 elements of the game, as well as their historical and mythological sources of inspiration

 The game features a fully destructible terrain, bunker building, a large number of different game activities and extensive mod support with many mods available at mod.io/g/cccp .
 The Cortex Command Community Project is an open source continuation of the game Cortex Command by DataRealms.

micro is a terminal-based text editor that aims to be easy to use and

 It comes as a single, batteries-included, static binary with no dependencies;
 you can download and use it right now!
 As its name indicates, micro aims to be somewhat of a successor to the nano
 editor by being easy to install and use. It strives to be enjoyable as a full-time

flathub:io.gpt4all.gpt4all.name: GPT4ALL
flathub:io.gpt4all.gpt4all.description:
Cross platform Qt based GUI for GPT4All

flathub:org.cataclysmdda.CataclysmDDA.name: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead
flathub:org.cataclysmdda.CataclysmDDA.summary: A turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world
flathub:org.cataclysmdda.CataclysmDDA.description:
Struggle to survive in a harsh, persistent, procedurally generated world. Scavenge the remnants
 of a dead civilization for food, equipment, or, if you are lucky, a vehicle with a full tank of
 gas to get you the hell out of Dodge. Fight to defeat or escape from a wide variety of powerful
 monstrosities, from zombies to giant insects to killer robots and things far stranger and deadlier,
 and against the others like yourself, that want what you have...
 As your game begins, you awaken with hazy memories of violence and terror from when the world
 suddenly unraveled around you. Now you need to explore your surroundings, and secure food, water
 and safety. After that, who knows? Long term survival will mean tapping abilities you haven’t used
 before, learning to survive in this new environment and developing new skills.

flathub:org.godotengine.Godot3.name: Godot 3
flathub:org.godotengine.Godot3.description:
NOTE: This Flatpak is unofficial and not supported by Godot Engine developers. Find
 officially supported binaries on godotengine.org.
 The feature-packed, cross-platform game engine to create 2D and 3D games from a unified interface.
 Godot Engine provides a comprehensive set of common tools, so that you can focus on making games
 without having to reinvent the wheel. Games can be exported in one click to a number of platforms,
 including the major desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows) as well as mobile (Android, iOS),
 web-based (HTML5) platforms and consoles (Switch, PS4 and Xbox One - via thirdparty publishers).
 Completely free and open source under the very permissive MIT license. No strings attached,
 no royalties, nothing. Your game is yours down to the last line of engine code. Godot's development
 is fully independent and community-driven, empowering you to help shape the engine to match your
 expectations. It is supported by the non-profit Godot Foundation.
 Create games with ease, using Godot's unique approach to game development:
 Nodes for all your needs. Godot comes with hundreds of built-in nodes that make game design
 a breeze. You can also create your own for custom behaviors, editors and much more.
 Flexible scene system. Create node compositions with support for instancing and inheritance.
 Visual editor with all the tools you need packed into a beautiful and uncluttered context-sensitive
 UI.
 Friendly content creation pipeline for artists, level designers, animators and everything
 in between.
 Persistent live editing where changes are not lost after stopping the game. It even works
 on mobile devices!
 Create your own custom tools with ease using the incredible tool system.
 Current limitations of the Flatpak version:
 For C#/Mono support, install org.godotengine.Godot3Sharp instead: https://flathub.org/apps/org.godotengine.Godot3Sharp
 External script editors are supported, but you need to follow the steps described here: https://github.com/flathub/org.godotengine.Godot3#using-an-external-script-editor

flathub:org.kde.kblocks.name: KBlocks
flathub:org.kde.kblocks.description:
KBlocks is the classic falling blocks game. The idea is to stack the falling blocks to create
 horizontal lines without any gaps. When a line is completed it is removed, and more space is available
 in the play area. When there is not enough space for blocks to fall, the game is over.

flathub:org.pwsafe.pwsafe.name: Password Safe
flathub:org.pwsafe.pwsafe.description:
Password Safe is a password manager. It stores your passwords in an encrypted file, allowing you to remember only one password (the "master password"), instead of all the username/password combinations that you use. For extra security, you can use a Yubikey device to provide two-factor authentication.
 Password Safe runs on Windows, Linux, macOS and FreeBSD.

flathub:org.yamagi.YamagiQ2.name: Yamagi Quake II
flathub:org.yamagi.YamagiQ2.summary: Yamagi Quake II is an alternative client for id Software's Quake II
flathub:org.yamagi.YamagiQ2.description:
Yamagi Quake II is an alternative client for id Software's Quake II. Our goal is to provide the best Quake II experience possible, we strive to preserve the gameplay as it was back in 1997. Thus we aim mostly for bug fixes, stability and gentle enhancements were appropriate. Yamagi Quake II has a lot of unique features. The most notables ones are:
 A modern OpenGL 3.2 renderer, providing a greatly enhanced look and feel. The original OpenGL 1.4 and even the Software renderers are still supported. Both 3D accelerated renderers support anisotropic filtering and multisampling anti aliasing.
 Full support for widescreen displays and arbitrary resolutions. The HUD can be scaled to be readable on high resolutions. 
 Support for surround sound, from stereo up to 7.1 channels and even HRTF. The background music can be played from OGG/Vorbis files, a CD drive is no longer necessary.
 A rewritten savegame system. Yamagi Quake II savegames are completely reliable and backward compatible between releases as long as the principle architecture stays the same.
 Highly precise timings. For example, on a flat panel display with a 59.95 hertz refresh rate and vertical synchronisation (VSync) enabled Yamagi Quake II is running at exactly 59.95 frames per second.
 In comparison with the original client over 1.500 bugs were fixed. The Yamagi Quake II client is very well tested and stable. The dedicated server is able to run for weeks without a single restart. Last but not least the code is fully 64 bit clean and highly portable.
 Commercial data files are required to run the supported game. These can be aquired though a multitude of sources. See the manual for more info on this.

firefox-addons:667962.name: Browserling Web Testing & Cybersecurity
firefox-addons:667962.summary: Cross-browser test websites in the most popular browsers such as Internet Explorer, Edge, Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Opera. Try for free!
firefox-addons:667962.description:
Browserling Web Testing & Cybersecurity is a browser extension that lets you quickly test how the current website looks and behaves in different browsers, browser versions, and operating systems.
The extension integrates with Browserling and opens a remote browser testing session with the current page loaded. Select an available operating system, browser, and browser version to verify website compatibility without installing multiple browsers or configuring virtual machines on your computer.
It is designed for web developers, QA engineers, designers, and cybersecurity professionals who need to test websites across different browsing environments.
 Key Features 
- Test the current website in different browsers and browser versions
- Choose from available operating systems and browser environments
- Automatically opens the current page in a Browserling testing session
- No local virtual machines or additional browser installations required
- Simple popup interface for quick testing
- Fast access to remote browser sessions
 Popup 
 Opens when clicking the extension icon in the browser toolbar
 Provides options to select an operating system, browser, and browser version
 Automatically uses the URL of the currently active tab
 Opens the remote browser testing session in a new browser tab
 How It Works 
 Open the website you want to test.
 Click the Browserling icon in the browser toolbar.
 Select an operating system, browser, and browser version.
 Click the arrow button to start testing.
 A new tab opens with a Browserling remote browser session.
 Interact with the page to verify its layout, styles, and functionality.
 Permissions 
 activeTab — accesses the current tab URL so it can be opened in the remote testing session
 storage — stores extension preferences and state
 contextMenus — enables launching browser testing from the browser context menu
 No unrelated user data is collected or processed. 
 Notes 
- Works with the currently active browser tab
- Uses Browserling's remote browser testing environments
- Available browsers and operating systems depend on Browserling's service
- No local virtual machines or additional browser installations are required
- The extension does not need to install the target browsers on your computer
 About Browserling 
Browserling develops online browsers and browser-based tools used by developers, designers, cybersecurity professionals, and technical teams around the world. Browserling Web Testing & Cybersecurity is part of Browserling's collection of independently maintained, ad-free browser extensions built for long-term reliability. Our goal is to create simple, focused browser tools that make everyday testing and development tasks faster and easier.

firefox-addons:3024590.name: Escudo — Ad Blocker para YouTube
firefox-addons:3024590.summary: Bloqueador de anuncios para YouTube en tres capas: corta las conexiones a servidores de anuncios, poda los datos del reproductor en origen y vigila el DOM. Listas de filtros actualizables. Funciona en Firefox de escritorio y Android.
firefox-addons:3024590.description:
Escudo bloquea los anuncios de YouTube con un enfoque en TRES CAPAS que actúa antes de que el anuncio llegue a reproducirse:
1) RED — Corta los pedidos a los servidores de anuncios con reglas de red (declarativeNetRequest). El anuncio ni siquiera se descarga.
2) ORIGEN — Poda la respuesta del reproductor (/youtubei/v1/player) para quitar los datos de anuncios en la fuente, antes de que el video cargue.
3) DOM — Un vigía observa la página y limpia cualquier resto que se escape.
Funciona en YouTube de escritorio y en la versión móvil ( m.youtube.com ), tanto en Firefox como en Firefox para Android.
CARACTERÍSTICAS
 • Listas de filtros actualizables desde una URL que vos definís.
 • Lista de permitidos por canal: dejá pasar anuncios en los canales que quieras apoyar.
 • Sin recolección de datos: toda tu configuración se guarda localmente en tu navegador. No se envía nada a ningún servidor.
 • Liviana, sin seguimiento.
PRIVACIDAD
 Escudo no recopila información personal ni de navegación. No usa analítica ni rastreadores.

firefox-addons:2933122.name: Per-Tab Volume Controller
firefox-addons:2933122.summary: Take control of your browser's audio experience with per-tab volume management. Set custom volume levels for each website, and enjoy precise fine-tuning with 0.1% increments. Perfect for managing multiple audio sources across different tabs.
firefox-addons:2933122.description:
Volume Controller gives you granular control over audio playback across all your browser tabs. Whether you're watching videos, listening to music, or browsing content with sound, this extension lets you set custom volume levels for each website individually.
 Key Features: 
* Adjust volume per tab with a simple slider and button interface
* Fine-tune audio with 0.1% precision when fine control is enabled
* Save volume settings automatically per website (optional)
* Quick access via context menu (right-click tab)
- Multiple match types for saved rules:
 - Domain : Match entire website (e.g., example.com )
 - Contains : Match URLs with keywords (e.g., watch?v=)
 - Exact : Match specific URLs
 - Regex : Advanced pattern matching
- Customizable theme : Dark, light, or auto (follow system)
- Session history : Track your recent volume adjustments
 Perfect for: 
* Managing multiple video tabs with different volume needs
* Setting lower volumes for music while keeping videos loud
* Creating consistent audio experiences across your favorite sites
* Developers and power users who need precise audio control
 How to Use: 
1. Click the extension icon in your toolbar for the popup
2. Right-click any tab and select "Volume Control" for quick presets
4. Enable "Remember volume per website" in options to auto-save settings
5. In options, manage saved sites and create custom URL rules
Your volume preferences are saved and restored when you revisit sites. No more juggling different volume levels across multiple tabs!

Hi, we’re DiveThru! Through our in-person studios and online platform, we offer mental health support, designed with you in mind. Whether you’re looking for therapy or a psychological assessment, we’re here to support you through every step of your mental health journey.
Therapy At DiveThru
At DiveThru, you can find a therapist who reaallly gets you. With our thorough matching tool, we can connect you to a therapist that is the right fit for your needs. Whether virtually or in-person at our studio, you can access individual, child/youth, couples or family therapy. 
Our Self Guided Resources
The DiveThru app is filled with hundreds of tools created by licensed therapists that are designed to help you lead a mentally healthier and more fulfilling life. These resources include: 
- Solo Dives: Our 3 step routines that take less than 5 minutes
- Mental Health Courses 
- Guided Journaling Exercises
- Mindfulness Exercises
- Informative Articles 
These tools created by licenced mental health professionals can help you:
- Calm your pandemic-related stress and anxiety 
- Boost your self-esteem
- Work through your fears and anxieties
- Heal your relationship with food
- Alleviate work-related conflict and stress
- Bounce back after a breakup or navigate relationship challenges
- Practice self-care + self-love
- Care for your student-related burnout and stress
- And so much more! 
Read our terms + conditions here: https://divethru.com/terms-and-conditions/
Read our privacy policy here: https://divethru.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00119761:ios.description:
Communicate and collaborate securely and easily. From anywhere. Always.
Wire is secured with end-to-end encryption and makes life easier.
Get everything done in one app.
• Simple to use and beautifully designed
• A single tool to make small teams and complex organizations more productive
• Security and privacy at the core
Wire offers a free version for friends and family.
Work securely, wherever you are
• Communicate and share information easily – call, chat, send pictures and files, audio and video messages – and be protected by the industry's most secure end-to-end encryption
• Stay in control of your data
• Increase privacy through self-deleting messages for sensitive information, device fingerprints, and guest links with passwords
• Eliminate risks with constant bitrate in calls
Stay connected and work productively
• Communicate with your teams through private or group conversations to bring the right people together
• Share and collaborate with files, documents, and links 
• Enjoy high-quality calls and video conferences
• Invite partners, customers, and suppliers to collaborate through the unique guest rooms – perfect for one-time conversations
• Set up meetings quickly
• Use formatting options to write clear and structured messages
• Collaborate smoothly with the help of mentions, replies, and reactions
• Send a ping to get someone's attention
• Use QR codes to connect with people
• Share your location in a conversation
• Add conversations to a custom folder helps you organize your conversations by topics
• Archive conversations to keep your list clean
• Rely on full administrative controls
Get things done and enjoy it
• Customize the app to your needs: choose your favorite color, theme, and suitable text size
• Draw a sketch in any conversation 
• Send audio messages if you are on the go or too busy to type
• Use animated GIFs – text, select, share
• Use emojis to make your messages more fun
• History backup lets you take all the conversations, pictures, videos, and files when upgrading to a new phone 
• Use Wire on up to 8 devices. Messages are separately end-to-end encrypted for each device. Your conversations are in sync across devices.
• Use up to 3 different Wire accounts on your device simultaneously — all without logging in and out
wire.com

Flo cooks her way to TV fame as a celebrity chef in this fast-paced
bluejetty:00063186:ios.description:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
Flo cooks her way to TV fame as a celebrity chef in this fast-paced time management game – COOKING DASH!
 Sharpen your skill as you prepare, cook, and serve delicious menu items in each exotic restaurant… in front of a live studio audience! Hear them gasp and cheer as you earn profits in each exciting episode! Quirky customers, superstar VIPs, fast-paced kitchen action, and TV fame await!
 Excel as a chef to beat Series Finales and compete in the Trial of Style, where you can earn adorable Pets & Outfits!
 COOK YOUR WAY TO STARDOM!
 Control the fast-paced chaos as you dash your way around the kitchen, preparing meals for crazy customers! Collect tons of tips for excellent service and make those profits! YOU ARE DESTINED FOR FABULOUS TV CHEF MEGA-FAME!
 HUNDREDS OF EPISODES TO COMPLETE!
 Tons of fun cooking play across unique restaurant shows like the Vegas-themed Table Steaks, crazy Taco Train, and trendy Hip Stir Cafe with many more on the way! 
 COLLECT AND UPGRADE!
 Wanna get more successful and famous? Spend your profits on upgrades for food and appliances for your restaurant! Upgrade to shiny stoves, fancy food prep stations, and more to ensure all customers get three-star service!
 PRIZE WHEELS!
 Introducing Weldon Brownie’s brand new game show - Spin to Win! Spin a free Prize Wheel every day to win prizes like Gold, Prep Recipes, VIP Tickets, Auto Chefs, Outfits, Pets, and more!
 OUTFITS & PETS!
 Dress up Flo in fun outfits themed for each Show, and equip Pets to help you out in the kitchen by auto-serving Prep Recipes!
 SERIES FINALES!
 Want to test your skill? Face a gauntlet of challenging levels in a Venue’s Series Finale - experts only! Beat every episode in a Venue with 4 or more Stars to unlock!
 TRIAL OF STYLE!
 Try your luck in the Trial of Style! This multiplayer event features different Venues each time - do you have what it takes to be the best?
 PREP AWESOME RECIPES FOR MORE CUSTOMERS!
 Make special Recipes in the Prep Kitchen and attract customers with their favorite dishes! They’ll get you more and more famous, drop cool items, and give you special powers to blast your coffers with mega-profits and keep your star on the rise! 
 BECOME SUPER-FAMOUS!
 Fan the flames of your fame as you start your OWN SHOW full of the most elite VIPs coming to see YOU and your amazing cheffing skills! It’s FOOD and FAME for you as you host the hippest dinner parties in the WORLD in front of MILLIONS of VIEWERS! It’s a TV Chef dream come true! 
 PLAY WITH FRIENDS!
 Exchange gifts and compete with friends on your never-ending quest to be the best!
 WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?!?
 Show your stuff and feed the hungry stomachs -- and fragile egos -- of the guests and VIPs! Download the FREE Cooking Dash® today! THIS IS THE MOST INSANELY FUN DASH GAME EVER!
 COOKING DASH now supports iPhone X in true wide-screen! See your favorite Venues in all their glory!
 PLEASE NOTE: 
 - This game is free to play, but you can choose to pay real money for some extra items, which will charge your iTunes account. You can disable in-app purchasing by adjusting your device settings.
 - Please buy carefully.
 - Advertising appears in this game.
 - This game permits users to interact with one another (eg. chat rooms, player to player chat, messaging). Linking to social networking sites are not intended for persons under age 13.
 - A network connection is required to play.
 - A network connection is required to enable certain features/access certain content. 
 - For information about how Glu collects and uses your data, please read our privacy policy at: www.Glu.com/privacy
 - If you have a problem with this game, please contact us at: www.Glu.com/support

bluejetty:00156496:ios.name: MyUCDavisHealth
bluejetty:00156496:ios.summary: At UC Davis Health we’re committed to supporting you on your unique health journey. We work hard to understand your individual perspective and to empower you to take an active role in your care – in a way that doesn’t add unnecessary stress
bluejetty:00156496:ios.description:
At UC Davis Health we’re committed to supporting you on your unique health journey. We work hard to understand your individual perspective and to empower you to take an active role in your care – in a way that doesn’t add unnecessary stress to your busy life. 
Our secure online portal gives you the freedom to be more involved in your own health decisions in a convenient way. The MyUCDavisHealth app allows you to use your existing MyChart account to manage your health information and communicate with your doctor and care team from any mobile device.
The health-management app allows you to:
 Communicate with your care team
 Review test results, medications, immunization history, and more
 Manage your appointments 
 View and pay your medical bills
 Access your family’s health information 
The MyUCDavisHealth app also allows you to integrate self-tracking programs like HealthKit into your medical record. You can upload health and fitness data such as activity level, nutrition, sleep patterns and more.
To begin using MyUCDavisHealth, register and create a UC Davis Health MyChart account online at https://mychart.ucdavis.edu/mychart/. 
For questions or access support, visit the UC Davis Health MyChart website or contact customer service at 916-703-HELP (916-703-4357).

bluejetty:00084244:ios.description:
Welcome to Studio KSL with your trainer, Katrina Scott— the ultimate health and fitness app empowering you through movement, mindfulness, and connection. 
Katrina Scott is a NCCA Accredited NASM Certified Personal Trainer and offers strength training, yoga sculpt, cardio workouts, pregnancy routines, meditations, and wellness programs with her signature pillars: Kinetics, Strength, and Longevity.
STUDIO KSL FEATURES:
New Workouts Every Week to Keep You Motivated
You’ll always have fresh new classes to look forward to at Studio KSL
Extensive On-Demand Workout Library  
Workout anytime, anywhere! Choose from Strength Training, Yoga Sculpt, Stretching, Cardio, Meditations, Pregnancy, and MORE! 
Live Studio Classes 
Join Katrina and other members live and stream studio classes in real-time. All classes are recorded and available on-demand
Exclusive Access to 'Studio Connect'
Access an intimate community space for meaningful connection and friendship. Includes Member Groups, Messaging, and Support
Weekly Schedule & Monthly Calendars
You’ll know exactly what to do each week with tailored fitness schedules 
Fitness Programs Aligned with your Goals  
Join fitness programs designed and catered to specific life chapters and goals 
KSL Sessions; 
Bonus Feature- Complete Guided Circuits, Stretching, & Cardio Workouts while listening to your own music or a podcast. Great for the gym or travel 
Goal Setting, Journal Reflections, and Mindfulness 
Set goals, track your progress, and journal each day within your built-in calendar
Custom Search 
Search by body focus, class type and duration
Flexible Music & Non-Music Options
Elevate your workout experience by integrating your favorite tunes. Studio KSL syncs seamlessly with your accounts on Spotify or Apple Music, giving you the freedom to choose your perfect playlist
Workout Anywhere, Anytime 
Studio KSL makes staying active simple and seamless, no matter where you are. Stream workouts effortlessly from any device, whether you're at home, traveling, or in the gym. Your fitness routine is always within reach. Plus, we know that wifi isn't always possible—that's why Studio KSL offers offline viewing. Download your favorite sessions within the app in advance and keep your momentum going, even without internet access.
Accessibility 
Enable closed-captions to enhance accessibility. Great for users who are deaf or hard of hearing
FITNESS PROGRAMS:
Signature KSL Program
Get ready to feel strong and empowered for 8 weeks! This program includes a powerful combination of strength training, yoga, cardio, meditations, and sculpting workouts. You're going to see and feel incredible results from this program.
KSL Pregnancy Program
The Pregnancy Program is your ultimate 34-week guide to staying strong, supported, and connected throughout every stage of pregnancy. With trimester-specific workouts, mindfulness practices, and weekly check-ins and resources from your trainer, this program is designed to nurture both you and your growing baby. 
A LETTER FROM YOUR TRAINER
I'm so grateful that we're connected! My passion is in kinetics, wellness, and helping women achieve strength and overall wellness. I love teaching and continuing to learn about health, fitness, and nutrition so I can best support you in every aspect of your life. My greatest honor is being your trainer. I can’t wait to see you thrive as we work together to achieve your goals through movement, strength, and longevity.
Sincerely, 
Katrina Scott 
Bachelor's Degree, Health Science
NCCA Accredited NASM Certified Personal Trainer 
Women’s Fitness Specialist | Prenatal & Postnatal
NASM Certified Nutrition Coach
Your fitness journey starts here. Download Studio KSL today!
Terms & Conditions: https://shop.studioksl.com/pages/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://shop.studioksl.com/pages/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00120043:ios.description:
Indulge your child in a thrilling world of cars and dinosaurs with "Dinosaur Smash: Bumper Cars". Unleash the power of 18 distinct bumper cars, from the fiery truck to the authoritative police car, each tailored to ignite your child's imagination. Dive deep into responsive environments, ensuring the dinosaurs meet their fate via an alien's UFO tractor beam.
Crafted especially for children aged 2-5, this educational game promotes learning through play. But who says adults can't join the fun? Dive in, with or without your child, for a unique play experience. Explore an array of vivid locations, from the moon's cratered surface to ancient Indian temples. Plus, you're not bound by Wi-Fi. Play offline, anytime and anywhere, ensuring the fun never stops.
Key Features:
• Educational Gameplay: Enhance Pre-K activities with cars games designed for toddlers to kindergarteners.
• Diverse Vehicle Selection: From trucks to the unique Coke-Mobile, there's a vehicle for every young adventurer.
• Stunning Animations & Effects: Watch as each scene comes to life, kindling awe and wonder.
• Offline Capability: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Dive into the game whenever, wherever.
• Safe & Sound: No third-party ads and kid-friendly sound effects ensure a smooth gaming journey.
• Learning through Play: Harnessing the power of fun to fuel education.
About Yateland:
At Yateland, our mission transcends mere fun. We aim to educate, curating games that blend learning with play. Rooted in our philosophy – "Apps children adore and parents believe in", we’re the trusted choice for families worldwide. Explore our diverse portfolio at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Your trust is paramount. We champion user privacy, ensuring top-tier data protection standards. Delve deeper into our commitment at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00133206:ios.description:
The land is littered with dilapidated buildings, but beneath it lies countless... Secret!
Create order out of chaos!
Countless fossil remains, endless ancient relics, barren land, crumbling buildings... To match and combine the same items, you need to use a little bit of strategy, see the order behind the chaos and bring it back to the world, make this land precious again!
Rebuild the land in order!
There's no need to worry about selling new items to merchants. There's plenty of treasure in the ground. Boldly collect gold coins, repair dilapidated buildings, explore more unknown areas, and restore the beauty of this land in the past!
Rediscover lost artifacts!
You never know what the next artifact will be, keep merging it with the mind-set of revealing secrets! Using your fingers and a little bit of strategy, you can travel through thousands of years to see what fossils and artifacts looked like in the first place, and discover a little truth about the mysterious days of the unknown!
This is stylize merge game, no need for multiplayer, just need a small individual strategy and finger use, you can create your own new world! Tips: You can also play it offline!

bluejetty:00157171:ios.description:
Welcome to ONE SOL™, your ultimate partner in achieving your health and fitness aspirations. Step into a world of wellness and experience the transformative power of our 100% vegan-friendly, premium-quality products. ONE SOL is more than a brand; it's a commitment to your well-being and a catalyst for your journey towards a healthier, stronger you.
With ONE SOL, you have access to an array of exceptional features designed to elevate your fitness game:
Stay Ahead of the Game: Get ready for exclusive flash sales, irresistible promotions, and limited-time offers! ONE SOL ensures you never miss a beat by delivering real-time notifications straight to your device. Stay in the know and seize every opportunity to fuel your progress and achieve your goals.
Connect with Influencers: Immerse yourself in a world of inspiration as you engage with renowned fitness influencers and industry experts. Our app serves as a portal to their valuable knowledge, expert advice, and captivating content. Learn their secrets, discover new workout routines, and harness the power of their expertise to drive your success.
Personalized Workouts: Experience the ultimate training sessions with our wide range of workout classes. Whether you want to shed those extra pounds, build lean muscle, sculpt your curves, or increase strength, ONE SOL has the perfect workout for you. Our classes cater to all fitness levels, ensuring you find the ideal challenge to meet your unique needs.
Pure Vegan Excellence: Embrace the benefits of our 100% vegan-friendly products, meticulously crafted with the highest quality ingredients. From weight loss to weight gain, booty building to fat burning, and strength enhancement to overall well-being, ONE SOL offers an exceptional range of supplements that align with your health goals.
Early Access Privileges: As a member of the ONE SOL community, you'll be granted exclusive early access to our latest product releases. Be the first to discover groundbreaking innovations designed to optimize your performance, enhance your recovery, and accelerate your progress. Stay ahead of the curve and unlock your full potential with ONE SOL.
Join a Vibrant Community: ONE SOL is not just an app; it's a thriving community of like-minded individuals who share a passion for health and wellness. Connect with fellow ONE SOL enthusiasts, share your journey, inspire others, and celebrate collective achievements. Together, we create a positive and uplifting environment where everyone thrives.
Don't hesitate to take the first step towards a healthier, stronger version of yourself. Download ONE SOL now and embark on an extraordinary journey of self-improvement. Transform your health, redefine your limits, and embrace the extraordinary possibilities that await you with ONE SOL. It's time to shine as the best version of yourself!

Download QR Code Mobile Scanner・Reader today and enjoy fast, reliable scanning right from your phone.

bluejetty:00016913:ios.description:
450,000 km² of stories at your fingertips. Whether you’re camping, hiking, or discovering local culture, the Parks Canada App is your pocket guide to visiting Canada’s national parks, historic sites, and marine conservation areas. Enjoy features like self-guided tours, travel tips, and offline access. 
Use the app to:
- Find locations and navigate
- Enjoy interactive self-guided tours
- Locate nearby gift shops
- Access hours, real-time directions, weather forecasts, and local tips
- Save your favourite pages for easy access later 
- Explore offline, no Wi-Fi or cell service needed
Plan and explore! Download the Parks Canada App and start your adventure today.
For more information: parks.canada.ca/app
Location services are optional and can be turned off at any time. Favourites saved to your profile are stored only on your personal device and are not accessible by Parks Canada or others. 
Parks Canada is a federal agency of the Government of Canada. On behalf of the people of Canada, we protect and present nationally significant examples of Canada's natural and cultural heritage, and foster public understanding, appreciation and enjoyment in ways that ensure the ecological and commemorative integrity of these places for present and future generations.

bluejetty:00069730:ios.description:
Never buy the same thread twice.
Needlentory keeps your embroidery threads, beads and fabrics in one place. See what you own, what each project still needs and what to buy — no more guessing in the craft store.
PALETTES
Create custom material palettes or import ready-made ones from Needleply — threads, beads and fabrics from 50+ manufacturers in seconds. Build organized palettes and keep only the manufacturers you actually use.
STOCK
Track your threads, beads and fabrics with a simple inventory system. See exactly what’s in your stash, set quantities, create checklists and avoid buying duplicates.
CLOSEST COLORS
Every thread, bead and fabric color shows its closest colors from other brands — shades that look almost the same. Find a substitute when a color is sold out or a chart calls for a brand you don’t have.
PROJECTS
Cross stitch, satin stitch, needlepoint, punch needle, sashiko, hardanger, blackwork, goldwork, whitework, redwork, tapestry, long stitch, canvaswork or freestyle — choose the technique for every project. Manage your embroidery projects with linked materials and required quantities. Instantly see what’s in stock and what still needs to be purchased. Filter by status, group projects into collections and track your progress with notes over time. Turn a StitchHub chart into a project in one step, with its cover, fabric, threads, beads, amounts and stitching history. Check each color first: keep the match, pick another from your palettes or add it as new.
PURCHASES
View your full shopping list in one place — for a single project or across all of them. Mark items as bought and keep everything up to date. Copy the list for online shopping or export it to PDF. Add the Purchases widget to your Home Screen to see what to buy at a glance.
BACKUPS
Keep your inventory safe with backups to iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive or Box. Restore your data on any device in seconds.
Start organizing your embroidery stash today and stitch with confidence.

bluejetty:00092364:ios.description:
Welcome to Title City Barbers! With a few taps, you can check availability, book appointments, and pay for services.
Title City Barbers opened its doors in October 2016 in the small town of Natick, Mass with only one barber. The location was perfect for locals and commuters who took the train. After its first month, they hired a second barber, and from there more licensed barbers had to be recruited to keep up with such a high demand of customers. All the barbers are trained to cut and service all hair types and textures, and they strive to give clients a great experience every time.
With our app, you can:
-View our full menu of services and prices
-View availability and reserve a time that fits your schedule
-Quickly and securely pay and tip so you never need cash
-Receive notifications and appointment reminders
-Manage Appointments: Reschedule, Cancel, Get Directions
Download our app today and book your next appointment with ease.

bluejetty:00129561:ios.description:
[Game Overview]
A cruel and gruesome war among three wolf species begins. A real network survival game to survive not only from animals hunting for food but also from battles against other wolf species for your own species’ survival. “Wolf Online” is the best online animal game followed by the “Life of Wolf” series, reaching 5 million downloads throughout the world. We are now waiting for you, the best wolf warrior, to join the fight.
[Game Theme]
The wolves’ hunting for survival and prosperity has started. You can select one wolf from Mountain Wolf, Snow Wolf, and Wild Wolf and participate in hunting as a member of one of these packs. To survive in a dangerous, rough hunting environment, you have to endlessly hunt animals and master your own skills. Also, you can only grow faster if you win in the battles among the wolf species and get trust from your own wolf pack. In the hunting ground that is distinguished by 6 characters, there are plant-eating animals such as rabbits, deer, and giraffes, but there are also many other scary beasts and wild animals such as tigers, lions, and rhinoceros that can threaten and attack you. When you meet monsters from legends, you should ask for help from your wolf colleagues because they will make your strong teeth and sharp claws useless. Your colleagues will come to you right after hearing your cry. If you are ready and all set, let’s leave to the hunting ground of the wolves.
[Characteristics of Species]
Mountain Wolf : Living in Stone Mountain, rough and dangerous mountainous area, the Mountain Wolf has the most balanced abilities among the three species.
Snow Wolf : The Snow Wolf, living in Snowstorm that is covered in cold ice and snow, is the species with the fastest speed and the best agility when hunting preys.
Wild Wolf: The Wild Wolf, which settled in Wild Land of living and breathing souls of ancient beasts, is notorious for being the most brutal and aggressive out of all three species.
[Features of Game]
1. The best real hunting game with three wolf species.
Harmonious Mountain Wolf, coldhearted and fast Snow Wolf, and scary and cruel Wild Wolf. You can choose one from a total of 12 wolves, consisting of 4 kinds for each of the 3 species. 
2. Various battle mode system
Single-play hunt, fighting other wolf species (PVP), a cooperative raid fight with wolf players from all over the world to defeat the dragon, etc.
3. The best wolf is always with his pack.
You can enjoy hunting animals and share food with other wolves of your species.
4. Summon your wolf friends immediately when you are tired.
When you get too tired while hunting or fall in a danger, you can immediately call your wolf friends around you through the network summon function.
5. Character growth system through hunting
Attack, defense, moving speed, stamina, and skill development system according to animal hunting and by winning honor/credit.
6. Various animals for hunting and monsters from myths
Herbivores such as rabbits, deer, giraffes; predatory animals such as lions, tigers, and bears; Monsters and creatures from myths such as Cerberus, vampire, chimera, and dragon.
7. A total of 6 different combat/hunting maps offered
6 different, highly realistic combat/hunting maps with varying geographical features and backgrounds: Snowstorm, Arcane River, Wildland, Combat Field, Dragon Lava, Stone Mountain
8. Other functions
Energy supplement system through the self and dead bodies
Real-time multi-chatting function with other players online

bluejetty:00165587:ios.description:
Embark on a journey where your driving habits pave the way for rewards and safety. LETSTOP is not just an app; it's a beacon for change in the driving community. By prioritizing safety, you're not only protecting yourself but also earning rewards that make every journey more fulfilling.
Experience the LETSTOP Difference:
Dynamic Reward System: Earn LETSTOP credits every time you drive safely. Redeem these for a variety of rewards, including upgrades and exclusive deals.
Innovative Safety Monitoring: Our AI-powered system analyzes your driving, offering constructive feedback and rewarding you for safe practices.
Global Leaderboards: Showcase your commitment to safety by climbing the global rankings, inspiring others, and earning additional credits.
Seamless Integration: With LETSTOP, safety becomes a seamless part of your driving. Enjoy easy-to-understand feedback and suggestions that enhance your journey.
Tailored Driving Insights: Get personalized tips to improve your driving, understand your patterns, and see how small changes can lead to big rewards.
What's in Store for You?
Diverse Rewards: From in-app upgrades to exciting vouchers, the rewards with LETSTOP are as varied as they are enticing.
Community Engagement: Join a global community of responsible drivers. Refer your friends to increase your earnings, climb the leaderboards, and even challenge friends to beat your safety score.
Regular Enhancements: With continuous updates and new features, LETSTOP is an evolving platform dedicated to your driving experience and safety.
We have the option to purchase monthly subscriptions and earn more, check our Terms https://www.letstop.io/terms-of-use
Take the Wheel with LETSTOP
Download now and be a part of a growing community that values safety, innovation, and rewards. Your journey towards safer, more rewarding driving starts with LETSTOP!

bluejetty:00130869:ios.description:
### THIS IS A DEPRECATED PRODUCT. Get KQ Dixie 26 instead. ###
If you bought this app recently, you can request a refund.
KQ Dixie is a 6-Operator FM synthesizer that is modeled on the synthesizer which appeared on the 1980s.
FM synthesizers make sounds with Frequency Modulation.
FM brings rich and brilliant sounds which are impossible to create with analog one.
It makes very complex waves with simple modulations.
The same method is used for radios.
The synthesizer gained much popularity in the 1980s.
This app lets you make sounds freely with 156 voice parameters.
Almost all parameters but multi-timbral, filter, and delay are compatible with DX7.
Audio Unit v3 compatible. Multiple-Out is supported when you use "KQ Dixie Multi".
Audiobus compatible.
Inter-App Audio compatible.
32 algorithms included.
You can manage the hardware DX7 when it is connected with external MIDI cables.
Supports DX7 System Exclusive Messages (SysEx) and syx files.
Supports Zip files. Place Zip files at the app folder instead of extracting them.
Supports micro tuning. The app can load Anamark/Scala tuning files (TUN/SCL).
Supports external and virtual MIDI.
Supports Volca FM.
You may be able to find a lot of patches on the internet.
Multi-timbres and Unisons functions are there.
Yamaha DX7 is a trademark of Yamaha Corporation.
Volca is a trademark of Korg Inc.
I have no business relations with Yamaha and Korg.
If you encounter a bug, please send me your Dixie Performance file.
https://www.kiraqtech.jp/blog/contact-en/
Machine translated text is included in this application and description.
Terms of Use: https://www.kiraqtech.jp/termsofuse/

bluejetty:00174538:ios.summary:
Enjoy design anytime anywhere together with more than 100 million users around the world. 
[3D Modeling]: Supports BIM, Revit, Solidworks, NX, CATIA, Inventor, SolidEdge, ACIS, Pro/E, and other mainstream 3D design software models. Support
bluejetty:00174538:ios.description:
Enjoy design anytime anywhere together with more than 100 million users around the world. 
[3D Modeling]: Supports BIM, Revit, Solidworks, NX, CATIA, Inventor, SolidEdge, ACIS, Pro/E, and other mainstream 3D design software models. Supports browsing over 50 formats of 3D drawings, including .rvt/.sldprt/.sldasm/.asm/.prt/.prt.*/.asm.*/.stp/.step. 
3D Features include 3D model assembly part preview, scaling, rotation, sectioning, and explosion; 3D measurement (distance measurement between points, lines, and surfaces, arc length, etc.), 3D annotation; PMI display and hiding; free color matching; viewing and multiple views; 
DWG FastView is a cross-platform CAD software that meets designers’ demands in all kinds of situation, and fully compatible with AutoCAD (DWG, DXF). Various of CAD features such as: Edit, View, Measure, Dimension, Find text, etc. enables you do real CAD work on the go.
【DWG FastView Highlights】
(1) Accurate and fast access your drawings
•Creating, viewing and editing with with easy-to-use advance tools.
• There is no limit to how large the file is.
• Fully compatibility with AutoCAD.
(2) Support export to PDF, BMP, JPG and PNG, and share it to anyone freely
• Transfer CAD drawings into PDF format and customize its paper size, orientation, color and so on. 
• Convert PDF to DWG.
(3) No registration & Offline drawings
• Simply download DWG FastView and use it immediately with NO REGISTRATION needed.
• Without internet, you are able to save your masterpieces in the local workspace.
• Drawings from E-mail, Cloud Service or Network Disk like Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, Box or WebDAV can be opened, viewed, edited and shared as well with Internet.
(4) Do real CAD work on mobile.
• Move, Copy, Rotate, Scale, Color, Measure object, record management results, manage layers and use Layout.
• Advanced drawing and editing tools such as trim, offset, dimension and find text.
•Set precision and display formats of coordinates, distance and angle.
• Zoom in or zoom out a CAD drawing by adjusting the space between two fingers.
• Import or download the CAD drawing with its fonts and symbols to the font’s folder in order to display all uncommon fonts.
(5) Easily switch between 2D and 3D mode, 3D mode include: 3D Wireframe, Realistic and 3D Hidden with the powerful tools of Layer, Layout, and ten different perspectives viewing.
• View 3D models, View different CAD file formats including: RVT, Solidworks, Creo, NX, CATIA, Inventor, SolidEdge and more than 40 formats;
• Rotate 3D CAD drawing by touching the drawing area and moving to view the 3D mode comprehensively in 360 degrees. Click the screen to stop rotating and locate the 3D mode at the best perspective.
(6)Precise Drawing available, e.g., user can change the number of the coordinates to move the points precisely.
• Support 2D absolute coordinates, relative coordinates and polar coordinates and 3D Spherical coordinates and Cylindrical coordinates.
(7) Stay connected. Helpful and responsive technical support.
Click the “Feedback” button to send your tech problem to us via email.
【Auto-renew Subscription Notification】
Auto-renew Subscription Cycle: Subscriptions are billed monthly and annually at the rate based on the subscription plan. Please choose the subscription cycle you need and confirm before payment. 
Payment: Payment will be charged to your iTunes、App Store account at purchase confirmation. 
Cancellation of Subscription: You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes/App Store account settings; you must do so at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period to avoid being billed for the next cycle. 
Privacy Policy：https://www.gstarcad.com/agreement/privacy-app
Terms of Use：http://www.gstarcad.com/Terms-of-use
Apple Standard License Agreement（EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Feedback Email: support@dwgfastview.com

bluejetty:00127596:ios.description:
Since 2015, AdBlock Pro for Safari has been trusted by millions of users and featured by Apple multiple times. Enhance your browsing experience on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro with our powerful ad-blocking solution.
Core Features:
• Block Ads: Eliminate pop-ups, banners, autoplay videos, and more.
• Preserve Privacy: Block trackers that collect your data online.
• Speed up Browsing: Load pages 2-4x faster and save up to 60% data.
• Save Battery: Extend battery life by reducing resource usage.
• Eliminate Annoyances: Remove cookie prompts and similar distractions.
Additional Features:
• iCloud Sync: Seamlessly sync settings across all your devices.
• Family Sharing: Share the app with up to 5 family members.
• HTTPS Only Mode: Ensure all your connections are secure.
• Quick Access: Use the built-in Safari shortcut for easy adjustments.
• Custom Blocking: Select and hide specific elements on websites.
• Picture-in-Picture: Watch videos while multitasking.
• Block Miners: Prevent cryptocurrency mining scripts from running.
• Blocking Scripts: Disable unwanted JavaScript.
• Block Adult Content: Make browsing safer for kids.
• Frequent Updates: Enjoy regular performance improvements.
• Helpful Support: Access a dedicated support team for assistance.
• Localized: Fully translated UI in 60+ languages.
• And more...
Supported Language Ad Filters:
• English, Japanese, Indonesian, Russian, Persian, Latvian, Romanian, Bulgarian, Finnish, Korean, Swedish, Italian, French, Polish, Dutch, Estonian, Hebrew, Icelandic, Lithuanian, Danish, Greek, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, Czech, Slovak, Norwegian, Hungarian, Chinese, German, Vietnamese, Arabic.
How It Works:
• Our app uses Apple’s native Content Blocking API to feed blocking rules to Safari without accessing your browsing data.
Compatibility:
• Available for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS.
Report Ads:
• Help us improve by reporting ads within the app.
Join the Movement:
• Love the app? Leave a review and share with friends!
Premium and Terms:
AdBlock Pro for Safari is free to download and includes powerful ad blocking for Safari. Premium unlocks enhanced country-specific ad blocking, additional blocking categories, and automatic filter updates.
Premium may be available as a subscription or one-time purchase depending on your region and current App Store offer. Current pricing, trial availability, and renewal terms are shown in the App Store purchase sheet before confirmation.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in App Store settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple Account is charged after purchase confirmation.

Privacy Policy: https://www.adblockpro.com/privacy
