bluejetty:00064546:ios.name: Bravera Bank
bluejetty:00064546:ios.summary: The Bravera Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay o
bluejetty:00064546:ios.description:
The Bravera Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Bravera Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Bravera Bank App, you must be enrolled as an Bravera Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00174422:ios.description:
Umami is a beautifully designed app to collect, organize, and share recipes from any device.
Collaborate
Create a recipe book of your favorite family recipes and invite your family members to work on it with you. Or, start a recipe book with a friend so you can share the pastries and desserts you've made together over the years.
Organize and Manage
Tag your recipes with things like "Vegetarian", "Dessert", or "Baking" so you can easily find the perfect recipe for any occasion.
Browse and Import
Open the recipe browser to automatically import recipes from popular sites or paste the URL of a recipe you want to add.
Cook Mode
Get in the zone by tapping the "Start Cooking" button on any recipe to see an interactive checklist of ingredients as well as step-by-step directions.
Grocery Lists
Create shared lists with family and friends, add groceries directly from your recipes, and automatically organize items by aisle or by recipe.
Meal Plans
Schedule your recipes in a dynamic calendar view. Pull down to see meals for the whole month, or swipe up to collapse the calendar into a single week.
Access and Edit Online
Manage all of your recipes from any computer by going to umami.recipes on your web browser.
Export
Your data is yours. You can export your recipes as PDF, Markdown, HTML, Plain Text, or Recipe JSON Schema.
Share
Easily create links to share recipes with friends. They will be able to read your recipe online, even if they don't have the app!
Pricing
Umami is free for the first 30 days. After the trial period, you can purchase a monthly, yearly, or lifetime subscription. You can always view and export your recipes, even after your trial has expired.
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Second in Command: The Old World - Prepare for Waaaagh!

Marshal the Grand Armies

Comprehensive Tome of Units: Instantly consult the strengths and weaknesses of any unit on the field, from a lowly State Trooper to a mighty Grail Knight, allowing for decisive and informed tactical command.
Heed the Call to War!

Download Now and Take Command!

bluejetty:00062290:ios.name: Homes by Tinybop
bluejetty:00062290:ios.summary: Play in faraway places! Wander into unique homes around the world. Make meals, decorate, and play games. Investigate electricity and utilities, but watch out! Wires spark and toilets bubble. Clean up, or make a mess. From NYC to Mongolia, Y
bluejetty:00062290:ios.description:
Play in faraway places! Wander into unique homes around the world. Make meals, decorate, and play games. Investigate electricity and utilities, but watch out! Wires spark and toilets bubble. Clean up, or make a mess. From NYC to Mongolia, Yemen to Guatemala, make yourself at home. 
*** Parents’ Choice Gold Award winner ***
“If all apps were like Tinybop’s, we wouldn’t worry so much about our kids staring at screens. In fact, we might even encourage it.” — WIRED
Homes is No. 3 in Tinybop’s Explorer’s Library series, designed for curious kids ages 4+ to dive deep into big ideas. The apps in this series have won Best of the App Store, App Store Editors’ Choice, Parents’ Choice, and Children's Technology Review Editor’s Choice awards.
Features
 * Explore 4 interactive homes: a brownstone in Brooklyn, a ger in Mongolia, an adobe home in Guatemala, and a tower house in Yemen. 
 * Play in 20 different rooms, inside and outside
 * Make each home your own: decorate with your photos and see your reflection in mirrors.
 * Investigate working models of plumbing, electricity, and other utilities in every home.
 * Learn how rural and urban landscapes, architecture, division of space, and materials shape the construction of each home.
 * Learn about cultures around the world: each home is full of unique foods, books, animals, and decor.
 * Celebrate seasonal holidays in Brooklyn.
 * Learn new vocabulary in 50+ languages with removable and affixable labels.
 * Intuitive, safe, and kid-friendly design.
 * Entertaining for kids and adults alike.
 * Interactive animations reward curiosity. No rules. No levels. 
FREE handbook
Our expert-reviewed handbook is full of facts, interaction hints, and discussion questions to support learning in this app, in the classroom or at home. Download in your app or at: http://tinybop.com/handbooks. 
Privacy Policy 
We take your and your child’s privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your child, nor do we allow any third-party advertising. 
When the camera, microphone, and other services are used within an app, your information is neither collected nor distributed outside of the app.
Read our complete privacy policy at tinybop.com. 
Tinybop, Inc. is a Brooklyn-based studio of designers, engineers, and artists. We make toys for tomorrow. We’re all over the internet.
Visit us: www.tinybop.com
Follow us: twitter.com/tinybop
Like us: facebook.com/tinybop
Peek behind the scenes: instagram.com/tinybop
We love hearing your stories! If you have ideas, or something isn’t working as you expect it to, please contact us: hi@tinybop.com.
BTW. It's not Tiny Bop, or Tiny Bob, or Tiny Pop. It's Tinybop.

Our app is the perfect too
bluejetty:00082391:ios.description:
Stop worrying about losing your Bluetooth gadgets! Bluetooth Scanner is your ultimate solution for tracking down misplaced Bluetooth devices, whether they're headphones, earphones, fitness bands, or even pencils.
Our app is the perfect tool for locating lost Bluetooth devices.
If you've misplaced your device, this app allows you to use your paired iPad or iPhone to help find it. Simply install the app, open it, and let it guide you to your missing device. The app works by attempting to connect wirelessly to your device's unique signature.
Your missing device may enter sleep mode shortly after being lost, so it's crucial to download the app and start searching immediately to increase your chances of recovery.
KEY FEATURES:
• Locate any of your lost Bluetooth devices
• Step-by-step guidance to help you find them
• Approximate location and triangulation
• Sleek user interface
Our app offers a subscription program for users to have unlimited access to features.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the time of purchase confirmation. Subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00092799:ios.summary:
Co-Tasker is your go-to all-in-one platform where you can conveniently book home and local services.
Book reliable, reviewed, and ID-verified contractors who want to offer you their skills and help you with a wide range of tasks.
On Co-Ta
bluejetty:00092799:ios.description:
Co-Tasker is your go-to all-in-one platform where you can conveniently book home and local services.
Book reliable, reviewed, and ID-verified contractors who want to offer you their skills and help you with a wide range of tasks.
On Co-Tasker, you can book:
- Freelancers and companies - Such as professional handypeople, cleaners, movers, drivers, painters, plumbers, furniture assemblers and more.
- Helping hands - When you need quick assistance with general tasks!
No matter the task, on Co-Tasker, there's always somebody around the corner that can help you.
Here's how to book services on Co-Tasker in 3 simple steps:
1. Post
Create your FREE task ad in less than 1 minute, with a description, location, and budget. Then, sit back and watch the offers come in!
2. Book
Check out offers sent to you by local professionals. Compare profiles, reviews, quotes, and book your preferred Co-Tasker.
3. Get it done
Once you're satisfied, release payment to your super helpful Co-Tasker, and leave them a review!
What can you expect?
- On Co-Tasker, you don't need to waste time calling and waiting for generic quotes; instead, you can book fast and affordable local services in just a few taps.  
- All Co-Taskers are ID-verified before they can work on the platform and reviewed by the community members after every completed task. A Reliability Rating is also applied to help build our transparent community.
- Co-Tasker provides a safe payment method so that your money is safe and secure at all times. You release your payment only when the job is completed. Plus, no cash handling!
- Known for our stellar customer service: Co-Tasker is here to help and support you throughout your experience.
Are you looking for flexible local work opportunities?
Co-Tasker is a local community marketplace where your neighbours are looking for professional services and help with everyday tasks.
If you're self-employed or a company that's looking to find new clients, then you're in the right place! Co-Tasker has many attractive benefits for professionals:
- Registering, becoming a Co-Tasker, and giving quotes to clients is FREE of charge.
- You choose when, where, and how much you want to charge for your work.
- Co-Tasker offers a safe payment system that reserves your payments before you start work. So no matter what happens, you always get paid for your hard work!
- We're here to help you! We bring the clients directly to you. Our marketing and customer service efforts mean that you don't need to waste time, money, and energy hunting for new clients. We also send you automatic invoices!
So if you're interested in an easier way of finding flexible new work opportunities around your schedule: Download the app, get verified, build your profile with your professional experience, send offers on task ads, and start earning money as a Co-Tasker!
We hope that you find all the help you need and feel empowered to earn money by using your skills. We wish you the best experience on Co-Tasker!
Co-Tasker is available in 23 cities across Germany!
Berlin, Munich, Frankfurt, Potsdam, Hamburg, Cologne, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf, Leipzig, Dortmund, Essen, Bremen, Dresden, Hanover, Nürnberg, Bochum, Duisburg, Wuppertal, Bielefeld, Bonn, Münster, Mannheim, and Karlsruhe.
We look forward to your feedback at support@co-tasker.com.

bluejetty:00135980:ios.description:
Create infinite RPG stories with cutting-edge AI! AI Dungeon is the world's most popular AI-native RPG and text-adventure generator. Jump into a prebuilt scenario or customize one your way. Then, play just like you would around a table with your friends— the AI responds realistically to your inputs and endlessly creates a compelling world for you to adventure in.
Join our vibrant community of millions of players and start your adventure now for FREE— no ads!
Be Anyone. Go Anywhere. Do Anything.
---
ENDLESSLY DEEP ADVENTURES
- AI-native text adventures that respond realistically to your inputs. Endless possibilities for overcoming challenges, discovering new places, and an ever-evolving cast of NPCs.
FREE TO PLAY WITHOUT ADS
- Our free models give you a generous amount of context right out of the gate so you can experience dynamic storytelling without spam for as long as you want.
- When you’re ready to level up your adventures, try premium for a week without paying a dime.
THE MOST POWERFUL AI MODELS, CUSTOM TUNED
- Our team of AI researchers and engineers is building the most advanced system for AI-native adventuring on the market. AI Dungeon has features that other games just can’t match.
- The robust AI memory system uses Story Cards and Memory Banks to store context-dependent info and bring it up only when relevant.
- We pair with AI image generators to let you create unique AI images on the fly that enhance the gameplay experience and bring your worlds to life.
YOUR NEW FAVORITE TABLETOP RPG— WITHOUT THE TABLE
- Our custom-trained AI finetunes mean our models deliver a better roleplaying experience than anything else out there with real challenge, no cliches, and plenty of context to do what you want.
- Choices really matter to the worlds you play in and the characters that live in them; the AI can adapt to anything you choose to do. But don’t worry, if you want to rewind a decision, you can do so anytime. It’s your world, after all!
JOIN A LARGE, VIBRANT COMMUNITY OF CREATORS
- Discover thousands of scenarios written by other players in sci-fi, romance, fantasy, horror, and every other genre-- or create and share your own!
- Adventure together with your friends in a multiplayer session, and adventure collaboratively— or not. However you want to play, the AI will keep driving the story forward.
WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?
Write, direct, and be the hero of your own story. Endless variety is at your fingertips-- download AI Dungeon now!

bluejetty:00086768:ios.description:
O controle do seu negócio cabe no seu bolso: com o aplicativo Omie, você tem acesso a várias funcionalidades do seu sistema de gestão a qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar.
O aplicativo permite que clientes Omie acessem com facilidade as informações do negócio: finanças, estoque, vendas, contratos e muito mais, tudo sem complicações e diretamente no seu celular!
Conheça os benefícios do aplicativo Omie, o assistente do sistema de gestão Omie:
- Gestão financeira na palma da mão
Dê a atenção que seu financeiro precisa, a qualquer momento. Com o aplicativo Omie e a Conta Digital Omie.Cash, você realiza pagamentos via boleto, Pix ou TED diretamente pelo app, sem precisar de outros bancos.
- Mais visibilidade em tempo real
Com o aplicativo Omie é possível acompanhar o status de notas fiscais diretamente no celular.
- Controle de estoque eficiente
Tenha suas informações de estoque sempre à mão! Consulte e atualize seu estoque com ou sem a leitura de códigos de barras.
- Gestão de serviços mais simples
Gerenciar serviços recorrentes e vários contratos ao mesmo tempo não precisa ser um desafio! Com o aplicativo Omie você consulta detalhes de ordens de serviço e contratos.
- Seu negócio sempre em conformidade fiscal e tributária
Estar em conformidade é um desafio para muitos empreendedores. Assim como no sistema de gestão, no aplicativo Omie seu negócio recebe lembretes sobre obrigações fiscais.
- Tomadas de decisões em qualquer lugar
Você precisa de dados precisos para decidir os próximos passos da sua empresa. Com o aplicativo Omie, é possível acessar dashboards gerenciais onde estiver.
Vale lembrar que o aplicativo Omie não substitui seu sistema de gestão, já que nem todas as funcionalidades estão disponíveis no app.

bluejetty:00040921:ios.description:
TunyStones is created by piano educators for piano educators and their students.
- Works with any piano or keyboard.
- Supports teachers and motivates pupils
- Teaches from scratch - no previous knowledge required!
- Enhances creativity with reading, composition and improvisation features 
- Allows you to compose your own music 
- Turns music reading into a great adventure and your piano into a game-controller
- This smart app automatically adjusts to different learning types/speeds
- Includes introduction levels to provide a general understanding for music notation
- The game is nonverbal: you play and understand how it works, while playing!
Content:
- Melodies by Beethoven, Mozart, Haydn and popular tunes
- Specially conceived Music Reading Exercises
- 126 levels + the possibility to create your own levels!
How it works:
- Place your tablet (iPad) on your piano or keyboard.
- Meet Tuny, the main character of the game, whose movements you control with your music
- The piano is now your game-controller: play sounds and Tuny will move accordingly
- Have fun: swim along rivers, cross rapids, jump on stones
- Without even noticing you will progress in reading music very quickly!
Try it for free! 
TunyStones is a widely tested, science-based method developed by music educators at the Hochschule für Musik FHNW in Basel, Switzerland.
It is produced by the SwissMusic Lab GmbH.
We are always striving to improve your playtime. Please contact us with any questions, feedback or suggestions!
Contact: info@tunystones.com
Additional Information for Music Educators on the didactic content:
Cleff Mountain I – the Mountain with one peak
Start learning with Cleff Mountain I.
- Establishes a general orientation in the notation system
- Introduces music intervals: prime, second and third
- Contains: „Ode to Joy“, „Kuckuck“, Haydn‘s „Surprise Symphony“ and specially conceived Music Reading Exercises
Cleff Mountain II – the Mountain with two peaks
Continue learning with Cleff Mountain II, after you have completed all levels of Cleff Mountain I. 
- Trains content from Cleff Mountain I
- Introduces music intervals: fourth and fifth
- Contains: „Frère Jacques“, „Happy Birthday“, „Eine kleine Nachtmusik“, „Twinkle, Twinkle little Star“ (original version and variation by Mozart) and specially conceived Music Reading Exercises.
Composition Mountain – the Mountain with multiple peaks
- Allows the creation of your own melodies
- Enhances creativity
- Enables you to jump along your own melodies with Tuny
- This feature encourages everybody to compose
- Can be used by teachers to compose for your own students and by students to compose their own melodies/levels
For further information, please see our Terms of Use: https://tunystones.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00187124:ios.description:
Economic Calendar for forex and stock traders. This is a useful tool both for long-term and day traders. 
It features hundreds of macroeconomic indicators, which daily influence financial symbol quotes, including currencies, stocks, bonds, futures and options, among others. Whatever financial market you choose, Tradays can help you improve your trading strategy. 
600+ INDICATORS OF LARGEST GLOBAL ECONOMIES 
Financial news and the calendar of the most important events relating to the ten largest global economies: USA, European Union, Japan, UK, Germany, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Switzerland and China. Even minor changes in these regions' economic policies may have a significant impact on many financial instruments. 
If you are trading stocks of well-known companies, forex currencies (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, EURCHF, etc.) and other financial symbols, this economic calendar will be extremely useful for you. 
REAL-TIME DATA 
You can instantly track all event releases, since related data is collected in real time directly from public resources. Events and indicator releases appear in Tradays without delays and can be used in trading 24/7. 
HISTORY AND DATA CHARTS 
Historical, current and forecast values, as well as importance characteristics are available for each indicator. To enable comprehensive analysis, all economic indicators are provided alongside historical data, outlined in charts and tables. 
NOTIFICATIONS 
Never miss an important economic event with Tradays alerts. Being informed in advance, you can perform effective trading operations. In the application, you can configure any number of alerts and form your own portfolio of events. 
SUPPORT FOR 9 LANGUAGES 
Detailed descriptions in 9 common languages can aid in understanding the impact of events and indicators on various financial instruments. Such comprehensive functionality makes the application extremely useful, even for beginners.

The updated version of PMK-EE co
bluejetty:00186304:ios.description:
The Professional Military Knowledge Eligibility Exam (PMK-EE) app is a convenient way for Sailors to study and take the retired exam as part of the enlisted advancement process for E4 through E7 pay grades.
The updated version of PMK-EE consists of 100 questions spread across five sections: Career Information, Leadership & Character, Naval Heritage, Professionalism, and Warfighting & Readiness. Sailors must achieve a passing score of 80 percent or higher on each section in order to pass the PMK-EE. Failure to pass a section will require that section to be retaken. Individuals must also achieve an overall passing score of 80 percent or higher on the PMK-EE for the next higher pay grade to be eligible to take the Navy-Wide Advancement Examination (NWAE) and Rating Knowledge Exams (RKE) for that pay grade.
When a Sailor exits the app before completing a section, the app bookmarks that spot. The next time the app is opened, it returns to the bookmarked location, allowing the Sailor to continue with the exam from that point.
certificate.
KEY FEATURES
     -- Available anytime, anywhere – no CAC required
     -- Displays topics and bibliography content from any compatible device
     -- Presents randomly selected exam questions each time a Sailor is tested on a section
     -- Permits retaking any section as often as necessary to achieve passing score of 80 percent
     -- Allows Sailors to submit course completion certificate to Navy Training Management Planning System (NTMPS) via the app
RECENT UPDATES
Updated Item Banks for E4-E7 assessments:
     -- New questions
     -- New publications
     -- New topics

bluejetty:00064792:ios.summary:
The Debt Payoff Planner app is the simplest way to stop feeling overwhelmed and start having a specific, step-by-step plan for paying off your loans.
Today is the day to make a plan with a loan calculator and beginning paying down debt. Re
bluejetty:00064792:ios.description:
The Debt Payoff Planner app is the simplest way to stop feeling overwhelmed and start having a specific, step-by-step plan for paying off your loans.
Today is the day to make a plan with a loan calculator and beginning paying down debt. Required inputs for calculating your debt free date are the current balance of the loan, the annual percentage rate (APR), and the minimum payment amount. That's the only requirement to getting a customized debt repayment schedule.
Easy steps to becoming debt free:
 - Enter your loans and debts
 - Enter your additional monthly payment budget to pay down faster
 - Choose a debt payoff strategy
 * Dave Ramsey's Debt Snowball (lowest balance first)
 * Debt Avalanche (highest rate first)
 * Debt Snowflake (one-time extra payment toward loans)
 * Custom debt free payoff plan
Debt Payoff Planner and Loan Calculator determines the optimum payment plan and how long it will take until you will be debt free. You tell the app how much you want to budget toward paying off your debt and we'll tell you how. We recommend the Debt Snowball strategy because we believe that paying off individual accounts faster will help you stay focused on your financial goal of debt elimination. A payoff plan is only useful if you stick with it!
Your ability and willingness to pay more than the minimum payments is how you will become debt free in less time than you imagined. Budgeting your income will help you to get a regular monthly amount to pay down the debt faster. The payoff chart will show two payoff scenarios: only paying the minimum amounts, and the repayment schedule when you pay more the the minimum ever month.
Creating an account enables you to have a secure backup and your information is immediately available if you start using a new device. Getting out of debt is hard, so we try to allow you to take baby steps toward this goal.
We believe that becoming debt free requires an easy starting point and making sure every dollar is leveraged perfectly. The loan calculator has minimal inputs in order to make your money management easy to follow.
The Debt Payoff Planner and Calculator is also used for tracking payments and updating the time-frame for becoming debt-free. Inputting payment information is as simple as typing in the amount and the date the payment was made. The goal of payment tracking is to see your progress over time and affirm that you are staying focused on your financial goals.
In addition to being a debt tracker and loan calculator, we are also trying to help point out some possible next steps with articles focused on how to pay off student loans, auto loans, and credit cards faster. Also, there is some tips on credit card balance transfers as well as strategies for debt consolidation.
We support eight loan categories:
 * Credit Cards like Capital One, Citicard, Chase, etc.
 * Student Loans like Navient, Sallie Mae, Great Lakes, etc.
 * Auto/Car Loans
 * Medical Loans
 * Mortgages like Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, etc.
 * Personal Loans to friends and family or other individuals
 * Taxes like IRS or local municipalities
 * Other category could be anything from a paycheck loan to a hard money loan
In addition to the Debt Snowball calculator and the Debt Avalanche method, many users like to do a custom sorting of their debts. This customization is available for users that want to be their own debt manager.
We allow the ability to provide a Debt Snowflake payoff as well. A Debt Snowflake is a one-time payment from things like a bonus at work, a tax refund, an extra payday, etc. This additional capability allows you to have tighter control over every dollar you are budgeting.
Terms of Service: https://www.debtpayoffplanner.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.debtpayoffplanner.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00124240:ios.description:
Simply the best Classic Solitaire experience for your tablet! Classic Solitaire is the most customizable Solitaire Klondike card game available for iOS tablets. This unique version of Solitaire lets you create your own card design from your tablet’s camera roll or choose from over 40 beautiful HD themes. Play it your way with Basic, Vegas, and Timed scoring and one or three card drawing options. Enjoy a classic card game that is perfect for taking a quick break, commuting, or unwinding at the end of the day.
—Features— 
Train your brain with over 50,000 winnable games
Play draw-one or draw-three style
Choose between Basic, Vegas, and Timed Scoring
Avoid confusing menus or unnecessary options
Select auto-move or manual drag & drop controls
Easily switch between landscape & portrait orientation 
Set gameplay to be left or right handed 
Enjoy universal iPhone and iPad support
Celebrate each season with seasonal theme packs 
Track your wins with in-app Statistics 
Celebrate each win with fun animations
—How to Play—
Choose your game play mode: Basic, Vegas, or Timed & one or three card draws
Tap or drag cards to organize them into descending order with alternating colors
Move cards into the foundation as you can from Ace to King, when you have all the cards in your foundation, you win!
If you get stuck, tap the Hint button to reveal your next move
Need help or have feedback? Message us at contact@maplemedia.io for fast and friendly support.

bluejetty:00115347:ios.name: Path of Mage
bluejetty:00115347:ios.developer: 广州方尖碑网络科技有限公司
bluejetty:00115347:ios.summary: Welcome to Part of Mage! This is an insanely addictive "dark pixel-style" tower defense game! In this world brimming with magic and strategy, you’ll step into the shoes of an adventurer, recruit heroes from diverse classes, forge god-tier g
bluejetty:00115347:ios.description:
Welcome to Part of Mage! This is an insanely addictive "dark pixel-style" tower defense game! In this world brimming with magic and strategy, you’ll step into the shoes of an adventurer, recruit heroes from diverse classes, forge god-tier gear for them, and craft unbeatable builds (BDs) to fend off endless hordes of monsters!
【Dark Pixel Aesthetics】
Breaking free from traditional dark fantasy tropes, we’ve reimagined the magical realm with intricate, moody pixel art. It’s a clash of retro charm and fresh innovation, serving up a visual feast unlike any other!
【Deep Build Crafting System】
Endless Affix Arsenal: Every looted piece of gear comes with 3-6 random stats—from "Vampiric Crit" to "Elemental Chain." With 200+ affix combinations, the possibilities for creating your perfect loadout are literally infinite!
Mana Forging Workshop: Dismantle and rearrange affixes at will. Stack attack speed builds to "god-tier" levels of rapid-fire chaos, or turn control-focused setups into 100% slowdown force fields—your strategy, your rules!
Dynamic Skill Synergy: Choose from heroes like the Forest Ranger, Frost Mage, Shadow Assassin, and Thunder Conjurer, spanning 6 unique class systems. Pair their abilities with gear effects to trigger epic chain reactions: Frost Nova detonating burning DoTs, Elemental Mages spamming ultimate abilities nonstop—the chaos is yours to command!
【Three-Tiered Strategic Progression】
Dragon Lord’s Vault: A dynamically scaling dungeon where every 10 floors unlock new affix pools and legendary sets. The deeper you go, the deadlier (and more rewarding) it gets!
Demon Realm Expeditions: Roguelike-inspired random boosts mean every run lets you craft a one-of-a-kind playstyle. No two expeditions feel the same!
Peak Rush: Compete on global leaderboards. Prove your custom BD is the best by racing to the top—fame (and bragging rights) await!
【Innovative Tower Defense + AFK Gameplay】
Smart Battle Automation: Skills and ultimates cast automatically, making level grinding and loot farming a breeze. Sit back, relax, and watch your team dominate!
Fortress Siege: Strategically place magic turrets and hero guards to defend your stronghold against monster onslaughts. It’s all about outsmarting the horde!
Resource Loop: AFK play yields forging materials, so you can level up without endless grinding. Progress at your pace—no burnout, just fun!
Ready to embark on your magical adventure? Dive in now, build the ultimate hero squad, and conquer the dark continent!

bluejetty:00070768:ios.description:
Die SpardaBanking App der Sparda-Banken Augsburg, Baden-Württemberg, Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Hessen, München, Nürnberg, Ostbayern, Südwest und West bietet Ihnen ein intuitives Design und umfangreiche Funktionen.

Kurz und kompakt:
- einfach, modern und TÜV geprüft sicher
- alle Konten im Überblick – auch von anderen Banken
- Direktfreigabe mittels Push-Benachrichtigungen der Freigabe-App SpardaSecureGo+
- Postfach – die Kontoauszüge und Nachrichten der Bank immer griffbereit
- Fotoüberweisung
- UnionDepot
- Mobile Payment* – mit Apple Pay
- Wero* – einfach Geld an Freunde senden
- Multibanking* – alle Ihre Konten auf einen Blick
- Mobiles bezahlen - Schnell und sicher den Einkauf mit dem Smartphone bezahlen
*bei teilnehmenden Sparda-Banken
Kontoüberblick
Mit der SpardaBanking App alle Konten, auch von anderen Banken, schnell im Überblick und damit immer informiert über die Kontostände und Umsätze. 
Banking – bequem mit dem Smartphone
Eine Überweisung von unterwegs aus durchführen, einen Dauerauftrag anlegen, ändern oder löschen? Mit der SpardaBanking App unkompliziert und einfach.
Postfach – immer dabei
Die letzten Kontoauszüge oder Nachrichten Ihrer Sparda-Bank, alle direkt in der App über das Postfach abrufbar. Die Kommunikation erfolgt im Hintergrund sicher und verschlüsselt.
UnionDepot

bluejetty:00092382:ios.description:
O aplicativo "FAZ - Rotativo Digital BH" foi criado para substituir a folha em papel do estacionamento rotativo da Faixa Azul da cidade de Belo Horizonte / BH. Em apenas alguns toques, o usuário da capital consegue comprar um Rotativo Digital. É simples e prático!
Cadastre-se e pague com Cartão de Crédito, Débito ou Boleto.. 
Baixe agora e tenha em mãos o aplicativo FAZ - Rotativo Digital BH!
- O que é o Rotativo Digital?
O app FAZ - Rotativo Digital BH é uma ferramenta para substituir a folha em papel da Faixa Azul em BH. Agora, o motorista escolhe a vaga no estacionamento rotativo e rapidamente pode ativar um Rotativo Digital.
- Como funciona o FAZ - Rotativo Digital BH?
Em apenas 4 passos, você compra tempo de estacionamento rotativo na Faixa Azul da capital: 
> Pare seu carro na vaga escolhida da Faixa Azul BH; 
> Cadastre-se no aplicativo em menos de um minuto; 
> Insira a placa, regra e o tempo de permanência; 
> Pague por cartão de crédito, débito ou boleto. 
Pronto! Você acabou de comprar um Rotativo Digital!
- Serei avisado se meu tempo estiver terminando?
Não se preocupe! 
O app da Faixa Azul Digital BH avisa quando o seu Rotativo Digital estiver perto de expirar!
- E o preço?
Toda essa praticidade pelo mesmo preço! O valor para comprar Rotativo Digital é o mesmo da folha em papel. É moderno e sem complicações! E você não paga nenhuma taxa adicional para terceiros. 
- Como é feita a fiscalização?
A fiscalização também é digital! Você não precisa deixar mais nada no para-brisa do seu veículo ao encontrar vagas para estacionar.

bluejetty:00147226:ios.description:
* Zealthy: Your Complete Health Companion for Modern Care *
Meet Zealthy, the easy-to-use app that connects you with doctor-trusted treatments and personalized health plans — all without waiting rooms, insurance hassles, or long delays. Whether your goal is to lose weight, manage anxiety, refresh your skin, or stay on top of daily wellness, Zealthy brings modern healthcare right to your phone.
* Weight Loss with GLP-1s — Safe, Effective & Accessible *
If you’ve been struggling to lose weight, Zealthy makes clinically effective, science-backed GLP-1 medications available in a simple, affordable way. No Insurance Needed. No In-Person Visits Required. Get FDA-Approved Medication prescribed by U.S.-licensed providers who understand your goals and tailor your treatment plan.
Zealthy’s weight-loss program uses GLP-1 medications like Semaglutide — the active ingredient in Ozempic®, Wegovy®, and Zepbound™ — proven to help people lose an average of 15–20% of their body weight. Choose brand-name or affordable compounded options with once-weekly dosing and supplies included, so it’s easy to stay consistent.
At Zealthy, you can access GLP-1s Without Insurance and start for just $39 your first month. Our care team helps you maximize insurance coverage (reducing Semaglutide from $1,349 to as low as $25/month with insurance, or $151/month without).
Get a personalized treatment plan (if Rx’d) based on your goals, progress, and lifestyle — plus refill reminders, in-app check-ins, and real human support every step of the way. With Zealthy Weight Loss GLP-1 Meds, you’re getting more than a prescription — you’re gaining a trusted partner in your transformation.
* Convenient, Connected Care — Without the Red Tape *
Skip office visits and pharmacy lines — everything happens in the app. Message your provider anytime, track shipments, and manage your care from home. Zealthy makes healthcare affordable, fast, and private so you can focus on results, not red tape.
* Comprehensive Care Beyond Weight Loss *
Your health journey doesn’t stop at weight management. Zealthy also supports your broader wellness needs:
Mental Health: Support for anxiety, depression, and ADHD.
Birth Control & Women’s Health: Pill, patch, or ring — delivered discreetly.
Men’s Vitality: Energy, performance, and overall wellness programs.
Hair & Skin Care: Proven dermatology solutions shipped to your door.
Primary Care: Everyday medical support, labs, and prescription renewals.
Every plan includes direct messaging with your provider, easy refills, and personalized care built around you.
* The Zealthy Difference *
Zealthy makes expert healthcare accessible, transparent, and affordable for everyone — with or without insurance.
No Insurance Needed — Straightforward, low-cost pricing.
No In-Person Visits Required — 100% virtual consultations.
FDA-Approved or Compounded GLP-1 Options — Licensed U.S. pharmacies only.
Personalized Plans — Tailored to your goals and medical history.
Continuous Care — Ongoing access to your care team for motivation and follow-up.
Thousands of people are transforming their health with Zealthy — reporting 15–55 lbs of weight loss, reduced cravings, more energy, and better confidence.
Whether you’re starting a GLP-1 program, improving your mood, refreshing your skin, or staying proactive about wellness, Zealthy makes better health easier, smarter, and more accessible than ever.

bluejetty:00016835:ios.description:
Get the latest UK Lottery results within seconds of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app shows the National Lottery numbers, prize breakdown information and jackpots for the following lotteries:
Lotto
EuroMillions (including UK and European Millionaire Maker)
Powerball
Thunderball
Set For Life
Lotto HotPicks
EuroMillions HotPicks
The following features are also included:
QR Ticket Scanner
--------------------------------------
For lottery tickets purchased in shops, simply scan the QR code printed on your ticket using your phone’s camera to see if you have won a prize.
Ticket Checker
--------------------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customisable Notifications
--------------------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
--------------------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on Lucky Dip numbers!
Results Archive
--------------------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
--------------------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
--------------------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at support@lottery.co.uk.

bluejetty:00044680:ios.description:
The American Bank Montana mobile app makes it easy to manage your money anytime, anywhere. It’s fast, secure and packed with convenient tools to help you stay in control of your finances.
Here’s what you can do with the American Bank Montana mobile app:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.

Meet our hero Boris - an ordinary guy with no money in his pocket and a huge thirst for adventure. Ivan, Boris's brother, was closed by the police, and Boris was forced to leave his hometown.
Now he must find his way. He couldn’t find a job and went down a crooked path: he ended up in the sixes of the local Mafia Boss. He became a car thief.

- Network mode with various activities and tasks, as well as role-playing
- Great opportunities for exploring locations: you can fight, shoot, get into and steal cars, ride a motorcycle, take a bus and even take a tram!
- Detailed, realistic cities and villages with many recognizable landmarks
- Unique system of road traffic and traffic lights
- Simple and intuitive transport controls (arrows, accelerometer or steering wheel)
- Detailed graphics of both cars and locations
- Public transport system - buses, trams, and also taxis!

- A well-developed system of police and police chases for violators of public order

- Unique character leveling system
- More than 100 different vehicles from cars to trucks, as well as military vehicles, planes and helicopters
- Full customization of the main character - dress him to your liking!
- More than 40 different weapons from a simple knife to a cool sniper rifle
- A huge number of part-time jobs: from a taxi driver to a professional car thief
- Full-fledged car tuning - body color, tinting, suspension adjustment, spoilers, changing wheel rims from more than 20 options
- Fully detailed open world - you choose what to do
Do you want to help Boris in his difficult criminal case? Then go ahead! Criminal Russia 3D. Boris is your choice!

bluejetty:00031153:ios.description:
Readwise helps you get the most out of what you read by making it fun & easy to revisit your highlights from all your favorite reading platforms in one place. 
Quickly synchronize your highlights from Kindle, Apple Books, Instapaper, Pocket, Medium, Goodreads, and even paper books. Then start building a daily review habit using the app and daily email. By reviewing your highlights every day, you'll retain dramatically more and you'll finally stop forgetting all the details from books you just finished!
---
“Readwise is my favorite new service this year. Save highlights from Kindle, Instapaper, and now tweets... one of the best long-term personal learning tools I’ve come across.” — Caleb Hicks
“Besides my Kindle, Readwise has been the most influential tech for improving my reading process.” — Blake Reichmann
“If you use Kindle or Instapaper or just enjoy keeping and reading highlights, please sign up to Readwise. It will become one of your cherished services.” — Christopher Galtenberg
---
ACTUALLY USE YOUR HIGHLIGHTS
Highlighting is great, but why bother if you're never going to see any of your highlights again? Readwise makes it easy to quickly liberate all your highlights into one place, ensuring that you'll actually see and use them, including highlights from:
• Amazon Kindle
• Apple iBooks
• Instapaper
• Pocket
• Medium
• Goodreads
• Twitter
• Physical Books (using OCR)
• Manual Input
• CSV Upload
STOP FORGETTING WHAT YOU READ
How often do you finish a book, only to forget the key ideas two weeks later? We don't remember things by just reading them once.
Readwise solves this problem using scientifically proven learning techniques called Spaced Repetition and Active Recall. Readwise resurfaces the right highlights at the right times using a daily email and an app. Readwise even makes it possible to convert your best highlights into flashcards for added retention.
TAG, NOTE, SEARCH, AND ORGANIZE
With your highlights all in one place, Readwise enables you to organize and connect these ideas in new ways. Use search to find a highlight instantly; use tag to organize highlights within your library; use notes to add your own annotations.
HIGHLIGHT PAPER BOOKS
Readwise also makes it possible to take highlights from your physical books and papers using your phone’s camera. Just snap a pic, highlight with your finger, and have your favorite highlights saved forever.
---
If you are not already a Readwise subscriber, you can get started immediately with a 30-day free trial with no credit card upfront. At the end of the trial, you will not be charged unless you choose to subscribe to Readwise Full or Readwise Lite. Price may vary by location. Manage your subscription from your dashboard.
---

Privacy Policy: https://readwise.io/tos

bluejetty:00034494:android.description:
Blocks Daily Break: Your Ultimate Block Puzzle Game Experience
Welcome to Blocks Daily Break, the ultimate block puzzle game that combines relaxation, and brain-training fun. Whether you're looking to unwind or challenge yourself, Blocks Daily Break is the perfect companion. Dive into this engaging block puzzle game where your skills and strategy will be put to the test! Feel the excitement of block smash as you clear the grid.
Why Blocks Daily Break
Easy to Play: Blocks Daily Break is designed to be intuitive, making it perfect for players of all skill levels. Simply drag and drop blocks to complete rows or columns in this block puzzle game, and enjoy the satisfying block smash when you clear lines.
Train Your Brain: Sharpen your mind with each move. Blocks Daily Break encourages problem-solving, providing a great mental workout through its block blaster challenges.
Relax: The soothing gameplay and lack of time limits make Blocks Daily Break an ideal choice for relaxation. Take your time and enjoy the process of fitting the pieces together in this block puzzle game.
Prove Your Skills: Challenge yourself to reach higher scores and improve your block blaster strategies. The more you play, the better you'll get at block smash moves!
Perfect Time Killer: Blocks Daily Break is the perfect way to pass the time with its engaging block puzzle game mechanics.
How to Play Blocks Daily Break:
Drag and Drop: Move the blocks onto the 8x8 grid. Arrange them strategically to complete horizontal or vertical lines in this block puzzle game.
Clear Lines: When you fill a row or column, it clears, making room for new blocks.
Endless Fun: The game continues until there is no more space for new blocks. Keep your grid clear to keep playing!
No Rotations: Blocks cannot be rotated, adding an extra layer of challenge in this block puzzle game.
Benefits of Playing Blocks Daily Break:
Boosts Cognitive Skills: Regular play can improve your spatial awareness through this block puzzle game.
Stress Relief: The calming gameplay helps reduce stress.
Keeps Your Mind Sharp: Engaging with Blocks Daily Break regularly can help keep your brain active.

 • Easy access to all training data anytime, anywhere
 • Stay accountable with workout and task reminders
 • Sync with Apple Health to update their metrics instantly
Join us now — and let’s get fit!

bluejetty:00035377:ios.summary: Galea Photo Editor is a photography app that uses artificial intelligence to create spectacular images from a photo you take or choose from your gallery. Through an incredibly intuitive interface, you will have at your disposal from the mos
bluejetty:00035377:ios.description:
Galea Photo Editor is a photography app that uses artificial intelligence to create spectacular images from a photo you take or choose from your gallery. Through an incredibly intuitive interface, you will have at your disposal from the most basic photo editing features, to options that will make the design of your images and photos go to the next level. You don't need to be a professional photographer to get quality results in seconds.
- Simple photo editor with incredible results
- Art filters, pencil drawings, turn your image into fire and many other styles.
- Edit the background of your image with the background changer.
- Use our templates to create amazing photo montages
- Add stickers and text to your image
More than 800 styles
Apply styles and filters that will make your image have nuances that will not leave you indifferent. You can apply them to the whole image or choose whether to apply them to the person or the background, thanks to Artificial Intelligence.
Pencil drawing: You can become an artist by creating a pencil sketch of your photos. You will be surprised by the more than 50 pencil effects with which you will make your images have a unique pencil style. In addition to pencil filters, among the more than 800 styles, you have painting, watercolor, manga, poster and many more. 
Art filters: Turn your photos into masterpieces with a single click. In galea you have options to apply artwork filters, mosaic style, fire, silhouette, tenebrous and many more.
Filters for social networks: In galea you also have styles that subtly change the photo to enhance it. In addition, you can regulate the intensity of any of the available filters with the slider on the main screen, to see live and instantly the changes you are making.
Auto cropping
In Galea we have created an artificial intelligence model to detect and cut out people from an image. This automatic people cropping functionality is fast and accurate and will allow you to apply filters and styles to the background and the person(s) in the photo separately.
Edit background / Change background / Remove background
Thanks to automatic cropping, you can change the background of your photos and replace the background of your image with one of our recommended backgrounds, select it from your gallery or download it from the Internet to use it. It is very simple, with a single click you can edit the background of the image, cut your background and paste one that will make it look like you are in the place you want. 
With this tool, you can surprise your friends. Edit for free and professionally with this effective and easy to use background changer.
Photomontage
Use our templates and you can be the cover of the most famous magazines, be on a "Wanted" poster and ideas that will surprise you.
Simple and easy photo editing
Crop, rotate and prepare the image you have selected to apply the incredible styles and functionalities that you will have at your disposal in Galea. You can adjust your photos and resize them to fit any social media platform.
Stickers
Apply fun stickers to complement your image editing among the different categories that Galea App has prepared.
Add text to the photo
You can choose between different fonts and colors. You can also adjust the size and rotate the text you have added to make your image look perfect.
Meme generator
Search for the image you want to use, change the background, add stickers, text and share the results with your friends and family.
Terms of use: https://galeaphotoeditor.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy policy: https://galeaphotoeditor.com/privacy-policy/

First part of the game is where you have to build your own rocket and launch it in the launch area!
There are three stages: small stages, medium stages and larg stages. You can combine all parts of different size and make a big rocket that you can travel and discover planets further and further.
Most interesting part of the game is the ability to build a Space Station in space by attaching every single part that you bring from earth. Size of Space Station is unlimited you can also add controllers to make it controllable.
Satellite is another object that you can launch in space. You have many different satellites. The Game has all planets with their moons that exist in our solar system which all of them have different characteristics.
Now is time for you to try it!

bluejetty:00016279:ios.summary: This is the official mobile app of the Detroit Lions, presented by Ford. Make your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch a unique part of your game day experience for Lions games. Catch breaking news of the team. Navigate your way around Ford Field wi
bluejetty:00016279:ios.description:
This is the official mobile app of the Detroit Lions, presented by Ford. Make your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch a unique part of your game day experience for Lions games. Catch breaking news of the team. Navigate your way around Ford Field with an Interactive Stadium Map. Become a part of an Interactive Lightshow. Explore augmented reality experiences. See real-time statistics for every drive. Watch video-on-demand clips of press conferences and player interviews. Follow pre-game previews and matchups.
Stay in touch with the Lions anytime, anywhere, on your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch.
  Features include:
News: Real-time breaking news from the Lions, previews of upcoming matchups, post-game blogs
Video: Video-on-demand clips of the Lions’ press conferences, coach and player interviews
Photos: Gallery of game-time action
Stats: Real-time statistics and scores from the official NFL stats engine, head-to-head stats of the matchup, player stats, drive-by-drive stats, box score, out-of-town scores around the league
Standings: Division and conference standings
Fantasy: Keep track of your favorite fantasy players
Depth chart: Shown by offense, defense and special teams
Social media: Aggregated twitter of the Lions’ official tweets, check in to the stadium on game-day, one-click tweet of all media items, one-click facebook posting of all media items
Schedule: Schedule of upcoming games, and scores/stats of previous games from the season, ticket purchase for games
Evolving home-screen: Pre-game, in-game, post-game, off-season countdown, draft-day
Interactive Stadium Map
Augmented Reality 
Live In-Stadium Camera Angles
Follow us @yinzcam on Twitter for updates or to ask questions and provide feedback.
Please note: This app features Nielsen's proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen's TV Ratings. Please see https://priv-policy.imrworldwide.com/priv/mobile/us/en/optout.html for more information.

bluejetty:00149536:ios.description:
MadeYu is an AI image and video generation app. Enter a text prompt or upload a reference image and turn your idea into AI-generated art in a variety of styles — or generate your own AI videos. Pick from a wide catalog of real-world and anime-style options, bring your own characters into the mix, and build multi-scene videos one shot at a time.
〖All Users〗
－Daily login rewards: 5 credits on regular days, 15 credits on Day 7 of your cycle (~180 free credits per month).
－Generate images from text prompts in seconds.
－Pay-as-you-go video generation with credits.
〖Pro Membership〗
－200 image credits every month for image generation, ad-free.
－1 diamond on Day 7 of your login cycle — redeemable for one 5-second video.
〖Pro+ Membership〗
－400 image credits every month for image generation, ad-free.
－1 diamond on Day 7 of your login cycle — redeemable for one 5-second video.
〖Unlimited Membership〗
－Unlimited image generation from your prompts, ad-free.
－5 daily diamonds for video generation from your prompts — 5 short videos per day. 
－Day 7 bonus: +3 extra diamond.
〖Unlimited Plus Membership〗
－Unlimited image generation from your prompts, ad-free.
－10 daily diamonds for video generation from your prompts — 10 short videos per day.
－Day 7 bonus: +6 extra diamond.
－Best value for video-heavy creators.
In addition, MadeYu also provides the following features for all users:
》Character Space: Upload one photo of your character and generate unlimited image and video variations from just text prompts.
》Story Flow: Build multi-scene videos one shot at a time and combine them into a single story.
》Daily Login Rewards: Free credits every day, bigger reward on Day 7 of your cycle.
》Push Notifications: Get pinged the moment your generation is ready — image, video, or character.
》Prompt Ideas Feature: Get inspired or spark creativity.
》Image Storage Feature: Save generated images in the app's album without occupying phone storage.
》Image Download Feature: Download generated images to your phone album for easy saving and sharing.
MadeYu lets you enjoy the fun of AI painting, unleash your imagination, and fulfill your interests!
Privacy Policy
- https://madewatoo.com/privacy
Terms of Use
- https://madewatoo.com/terms

bluejetty:00089229:ios.description:
Big Whiskey’s offers classic American food including hand cut steaks, juicy burgers, fried & grilled chicken, celebrated sandwiches, signature wings, seafood, pasta, tasty appetizers, satisfying sweets, and so much more! Enjoy a truly delicious experience with rapid delivery directly to you.
Big Whiskey’s App Features:
- Use biometrics to login
- Quickly modify and add food to your cart
- Enhance your online ordering experience with beautiful product and ingredient imagery
- Enable geolocation to find your nearest Big Whiskey’s restaurant
- Order food for delivery
- Save credit and debit cards for faster checkouts
- Apply coupons to order online
- Reorder past orders
How to Order Big Whiskey’s:
- Enter your delivery address and choose from the delivery locations in your area
- Choose a category and add an item or modify an item to add to your cart
- After you’ve finished adding items to your order, select checkout from your cart
- Proceed through the checkout flow, and monitor your delivery progress from your order confirmation screen

Train your brain with a great variety of free brain games for adults. Enjoy 40+ games in four categories: memory, logic, math, and focus!

bluejetty:00184388:ios.description:
Mit der kostenlosen photoTAN App geben Sie Transaktionen im Online-Banking sicher und schnell frei. 
# So funktioniert das photoTAN-Verfahren über den Computer:
Sie führen eine Transaktion auf einem anderen Gerät durch; z. B. einem PC. 
Ihre Transaktion wird automatisch in die comdirect photoTAN App übertragen und auf Ihrem Smartphone erscheint eine Benachrichtigung. Bei Tippen auf die Nachricht öffnet sich die photoTAN App. Prüfen Sie die Transaktion und geben Sie die TAN frei, indem Sie den Pfeil von links nach rechts schieben.
Die gewohnte Scan-Funktion der comdirect photoTAN App bleibt erhalten. Das empfiehlt sich zum Beispiel dann, wenn Ihr Smartphone nicht mit dem Internet verbunden ist. Wählen Sie dazu auf dem Computer das photoTAN-Verfahren „photoTAN Grafik“ und öffnen dann auf dem Smartphone in der comdirect photoTAN App die Scan-Funktion links unten.
# So funktioniert das App2App-Verfahren:
Sie führen eine Transaktion in einer anderen comdirect-App durch. Im Freigabe-Prozess für Ihre Transaktion öffnet sich automatisch die photoTAN App. Bestätigen Sie Ihren Auftrag, indem Sie den Pfeil von links nach rechts schieben. 
Folgende comdirect Apps unterstützen das App2App-Verfahren:
- comdirect App
- comdirect trading App
- comdirect Young
# So aktivieren Sie die photoTAN App vor der ersten Nutzung:
Loggen Sie sich in den Persönlichen Bereich von comdirect mit Ihrer Zugangsnummer und PIN ein und folgen der Anleitung „photoTAN aktivieren“ bis die Aktivierungsgrafik angezeigt wird. Laden Sie sich die comdirect photoTAN App auf Ihr Smartphone und folgen Sie der Anleitung in der App. Sobald die App aktiviert ist, können Sie die beiden oben genannten Verfahren nutzen.
FAQ „Welche Berechtigungen verwendet die App?“
Die Berechtigung „Kamera“ wird im Standardverfahren zum Scannen der photoTAN Grafik benötigt.
FAQ "Funktioniert die App mit mehreren comdirect Konten"?
Sie können die App mit bis zu 8 Konten verbinden. Für jedes Konto benötigen Sie einen eigenen Aktivierungsbrief.
Gestalten Sie die Zukunft mit uns!
Teilen Sie Ihre Vorschläge in der comdirect Community und verbessern die App.
Weitere Informationen zur photoTAN erhalten Sie unter www.comdirect.de/photoTAN

bluejetty:00187299:ios.description:
Reach is a quick and efficient personalized messaging app for the iPhone. It makes it easy and simple to communicate with masses of people as if texting one on one (the recipient's do not see each other, just like a BCC)
** Downloaded by over 250,000 users! **
- Runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac* -
Featured on Gizmodo:
"The best we've found is Reach, which works with iMessage or plain SMS, and can even personalize each message for you"
Features:
• Set up distribution groups
• Send messages with ease
• Each message is sent individually (recipient's do not see each other)
• Sync between devices
• Backup your data to your iCloud
• Import/Export CSV files
• Google Voice integration
• Supports setting up groups, contacts, and messages on Mac*
Download now for free!
*Mac support - only with Apple sillicon. Does not support sending texts, only setting up groups, contacts, and messages. Sending must be done from iPhone/iPad.
~~AS EASY AS 1-2-3~~
1. Add contacts to a group
2. Write a message
3. Send via Text, SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp, Email, and more! 
Msg & data rates may apply.
~~ADDITIONAL FEATURES~~
• Message Templates -- personalize each message with the recipient’s name.
• Translation of Text -- have your texts be automatically translated into the recipient's preferred language.
• CSV Importing -- import your contacts from a spreadsheet (Excel, Apple Numbers).
• Google Voice support -- use your Google Voice account to send SMS in the U.S. and Canada for free (G Suite Business is not yet supported).
• Carbon Copy Recipient (CC) - add a CC recipient to always receive a copy of each individual text sent (use case: an accountability contact who must be present in all one-on-one conversations)
~~WHY REACH?~~
Reach is the best group texting app to communicate with people on individual level. Unlike messy group chats, Reach lets you create separate groups of people from your contacts list and send them personalized SMS or text messages, iMessages, emails, or even WhatsApp texts, effortlessly. The recipient's get a personal message from you, and do not see the other recipient's in the list.
Messaging with Reach is always better because the app ensures none of the recipients see other recipients in the groups. Create groups based on personal contacts, professional contacts, and more and keep them organized with Reach. Improve workflow productivity by creating reusable recipient groups, and easily blast personalized texts and email messages.
Reach lets you receive responses from each recipient in an organized manner. Continue private messaging with each recipient once you receive replies on respective platforms. To include more people in your individual conversations, add Carbon Copy (CC) Automatic recipient in any group.
~~REACH UNLIMITED SUBSCRIPTION~~
The free version of the app allows sending messages up to 8 contacts and 2 groups. You may subscribe to the Reach Unlimited monthly subscription which enables the following features: 
• Unlimited texting
• Unlimited contacts and groups
• Customer Support
• Backups in the Cloud
By installing the app you agree with the Standard EULA, and our Terms of Use in the following link https://reachtheapp.com/terms-of-use/
The subscription terms and conditions:
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
To see the full Terms and Conditions, please follow the link below:
https://www.reachtheapp.com/privacy-policy/

Exit Strategy literally shaves minutes off every subway trip.
Imagine the subway train pulls into your destination and you're DIRECTLY in front of the exit...every time! 
This app eliminates the guesswork from your ride, making your life easier and faster...and all for less than the cost of a roundtrip subway ride! Plan where to stand and shave minutes off your trip!

(Works offline in the subway, no internet required)

- Official MTA subway map (zoomable, scrollable and interactive!)
- Official MTA Bus Maps for all five boroughs
- Comprehensive MAP OF MANHATTAN showing address ranges and popular destinations created from the official MTA Neighborhood Maps. (Works offline when other map apps don't!)
- Exit Strategy diagrams help you plan where to stand ("Should I be at the front or back of train?"). Literally shaves minutes off every trip!
- Diagrams include locations of exits, transfer spots, and elevators, in most cases down to the optimal DOOR!
- Diagrams show the hours for exits that close. 
- NO PHONE SERVICE OR INTERNET CONNECTION REQUIRED; use it on the subway!
=======================================
All subway, bus, and street maps are property of the MTA.

bluejetty:00061954:ios.description:
+++ FULL Game no additional purchase is required+++
What does the lion say? where does the sheep live? and what animals live underwater? 
Welcome to the animal theatre! This theatre show will take your toddler to an exciting journey to visit lots of animals in their natural living environment. Beautifully illustrated, this game is both enjoyable and educational, allowing your child to explore animal characteristics such as sound, special appearance, living environment and much more. An adorable game that triggers curiosity and caring for all living things. 
Game features:
---------------
- ToyaTap easy play: specially designed interface for easy play by babies and toddlers
- 24 beautifully illustrated animals, 7 different living environments. 
- Fun facts about the animals 
- Encouraging thinking and exploring.
Game didactic values:
----------------------
- Develop auditory, visual and fine motor skills.
- Increasing vocabulary
- Recognize animals.
- Explore the unique characteristics of each animal.
- Trigger curiosity and caring for living creatures. 
The game is beautifully illustrated. Your child will visit many living habitats that spark the curiosity and imagination and make learning a fun experience.
living area : 
- Farm - rooster, cow,pig, horse 
- Savannah - lion, giraffe, elephant
- Sea - fish, shark, whale
- Forest - fox, monkey, owl, tiger
- Arctic - polar bear, penguin, seal
- Home - dog, cat, rabbit
- Field - butterfly, ladybug, bee
About ToyaTap Educational games:
At ToyaTap we are dedicated to creating high quality learning experiences that children and parents can enjoy together.
We hope you and your child will enjoy playing this game as much as we enjoyed creating it!

At CSOB, we believe that managing your finances should be convenient, modern, and secure at the same time. That is why we bring you the ČSOB SmartToken mobile application, designed for secure login and authorization of operations in the bank’s digital services.
With the application, you can easily and securely:
• confirm payments and other active operations
• log in to electronic banking
• authorize online card payments (3D Secure)
• activate the ČSOB SmartBanking application
After activation, the application also works offline, without an internet connection – depending on the type of operation, you can confirm it directly in the app or by scanning a QR code and entering an authorization code.
After installation, the app will guide you through the activation in just a few steps.
You can choose from several modern and secure activation methods:
• activation using an identity document
• identity verification using facial biometrics
• transfer of activation from an old device to a new one via QR code
• activation via the ČSOB info line
For new clients, the process is even simpler – thanks to new technology, the application can process the provided data and complete the activation conveniently, without duplicate identity verification.
For security reasons, this application is not supported on unofficially modified operating systems and devices.
Biometric authentication is supported only on selected devices and for selected types of transactions.

bluejetty:00069514:ios.description:
Want to know if people are reading the emails you send? iTrackMail will let you know whenever someone opens your email!
Tell iTrackMail the subject of your email, write your email like you usually would, and press send! iTrackMail will do the rest! When someone reads your email, iTrackMail will send you a push notification! Yes--it is that easy!
iTrackMail will automatically record the date and time of the receipt as well as rough estimates of the Country, Region, Platform, and Browser of the recipient. You will be able to tell if more than one person read your email!
iTrackMail is FREE, so try sending an email and you will be pleasantly surprised!
Note: Not every email client is compatible with iTrackMail's methods. In some cases, the recipient will have to agree to "display all images" for your email.

bluejetty:00025691:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform to find and sell new and used cranes, including boom trucks, truck-mounted cranes, crawler cranes, rough terrain cranes, tower cranes, mini cranes, and other lifting and hoisting equipment. Whether you’re a buyer, private seller, or equipment dealership representative, CraneTrader is ready to streamline your online crane buying and selling experience and make connecting with buyers and sellers in the industry fast, easy, and secure. 
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF CRANE LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
Browse thousands of listings for boom trucks, crawler cranes, rough terrain cranes, truck-mounted cranes, all-terrain cranes, tower cranes, mini cranes, and other cranes. Plus, find crane attachments and components to keep your operations running smoothly. 
Once you’ve narrowed your search, dive into detailed photos and videos of your desired crane. Contact sellers directly to secure the best deal and explore financing and delivery options offered by CraneTrader’s trusted financing and shipping partners, CurrencyFinance and FR8Star.
The CraneTrader app features advanced search tools that allow you to filter listings by type, make, model, location, condition, lifting capacity, boom length, and other specifications. Save time with personalized search filters and find exactly what you need. 
EASILY TRACK CRANES YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite cranes, or post a “Want-to-Buy” ad to let sellers know what you’re searching for. Stay updated with new listings and personalized alerts via email, and browse category pages updated daily with fresh inventory. 
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
Whether you’re a crane dealer or an independent seller, CraneTrader connects you with thousands of qualified buyers actively searching for cranes and other hoisting equipment. 
Consign your inventory with CraneTrader to reach a global audience. Click the "My Inventory" button in your CraneTrader app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app, your trusted, easy, and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go-right from your iOS device. 
CHOOSE THE CRANETRADER APP TO BUY OR SELL CRANES ONLINE
Whether you’re upgrading your equipment or selling a crane, CraneTrader connects you with a vast inventory of lifting machinery and tools and a large buyer audience.
As part of Sandhills Global, CraneTrader links you to a network that includes Machinery Trader, Truck Paper, LiftsToday, ForestryTrader, AuctionTime, and other trusted platforms. Access listings from top manufacturers such as Liebherr, Manitowoc, Grove, Tadano, Terex, Link-Belt, and others. 
GET THE CRANETRADER APP NOW 
Thousands of contractors and sellers trust CraneTrader to manage their crane operations. Download the app today to find your next crane or sell with ease!

bluejetty:00187654:ios.summary: Fourth is the world's leading provider of innovative software services to the hospitality industry and the Fourth App is the mobile gateway to access all of Fourth's and our partner's capabilities. Using our purpose built platform, where te
bluejetty:00187654:ios.description:
Fourth is the world's leading provider of innovative software services to the hospitality industry and the Fourth App is the mobile gateway to access all of Fourth's and our partner's capabilities. Using our purpose built platform, where team collaboration is at the center of everything we provide, the Fourth App brings to life the processes required to run an efficient and effective hospitality business that customers love. 
Evolving the employee experience while at and away from work, Fourth has a variety of mobile apps, which help run your business with our Workforce Management, and Purchase-to-Pay and Inventory solutions. Allowing employees to collaborate with each other, apply for holidays, view and manage their scheduled shifts, count stock, order and receive deliveries, and much, much more. 
Fourth’s Workforce Management solution:
Makes the lives of your managers and employees easier. Managers save hours every week by quickly building accurate schedules, and approving shift changes at the touch of a button. They can also publish open shifts, keep connected and stay on top of business performance on the go. Employees get more exact schedules, and can quickly and easily requests swaps, suggest unavailability, volunteer for open shifts, request time off and view payroll information, while staying connected with the business, their managers and their colleagues. Managers get out of the back office so they spend more time with their teams and customers, and employees feel happier and more engaged with the business, improving productivity, company culture and employee retention.
Fourth’s Purchase-to-Pay and Inventory Management solution:
Keeps operators on top of inventory by ensuring regular valuations are quickly and easily captured. Placing orders, completing inventory counts and goods receiving are completed on mobile devices, saving hours of time and eliminating errors caused by re-keying data. Actual Cost of Sales (COS) is easily calculated, and the gap between actual and theoretical is effectively highlighted and can be driven down as actual COS factors in all transactional data, daily sales and other account transfers and inventory movement. The result is better inventory management, ensuring you have sufficient products to meet demand while reducing waste and removing unnecessary administration.
Getting started with the Fourth App:
The Fourth App requires a Fourth Account to login, your employer needs to have given you access through an activation email and if you have any problems with access you should contact your line manager.

bluejetty:00071542:ios.name: Queryable - Photo Search App
bluejetty:00071542:ios.summary:
Find any photo in your library by describing it in a sentence, or by the words that appear in it.
A product that has reached #1 on the front page of Hacker News and topped the paid tools chart across all European countries, while ranking #
bluejetty:00071542:ios.description:
Find any photo in your library by describing it in a sentence, or by the words that appear in it.
A product that has reached #1 on the front page of Hacker News and topped the paid tools chart across all European countries, while ranking #2 in the US on the same day.
Queryable is an open-source, offline photo album search tool unlike anything you've used before.
Search your photos with natural descriptions like "two people by the sea," "a blonde woman holding a glass of red wine," "a girl in red on the lawn," or even emotional moments like "We fell in love." Queryable understands longer, more human descriptions instead of only simple tags. You can type in your own language: non-English queries are translated on your device before searching.
NEW: SEARCH THE TEXT IN YOUR PHOTOS
Turn on text recognition and Queryable also finds photos by the words in them: a Wi-Fi password in a screenshot, the total on a receipt, a dish on a menu, a line on a lecture slide. Switch between Visual and Text search with one tap, and copy all the text from any photo. Recognition uses Apple's on-device engine at its highest accuracy. It is off by default, so building your index stays as fast as before.
ALSO IN QUERYABLE
• Search by photo: pick or take a photo to find similar ones
• Clean up duplicates and similar shots group by group, with space estimates
• Filter results by date, select in bulk, and share full-resolution originals
• Videos and Live Photos play with sound, even in silent mode; GIFs animate
• A redesigned interface with your recent searches one tap away
Pay once and use it forever. No ads, no subscription. Queryable works completely offline after download, protecting the privacy of your photo library.
FAQ:
1. What languages can I search in?
 You can describe photos in your own language. Queryable translates your query on device, while keeping the accuracy of the English search model. The first time, iOS asks once to download your language for offline translation; you can also do it anytime in Settings. Text search looks for the words exactly as they appear in your photos; it reads English and, where Apple's engine supports it, your device language. The app interface is available in 18 languages.
2. How is my photo privacy protected?
 Queryable works completely offline. You can even disable the app's network permissions. The only time it uses the network is when you choose to download the full-resolution original of a photo stored in iCloud.
3. How do I use it?
 After downloading, build an index for your photos. This takes a few minutes depending on your library and device, and is only required once. When you add new photos, you can update the index at any time. Text recognition is optional and slower than the visual index; you can pause it and continue later.
4. Why can't Text search find some photos?
 With "Optimize iPhone Storage" turned on, many photos are kept on your iPhone only as small previews that are too small to read. Open such a photo and download the original, and its text is recognized automatically.

- Twitter: @immazzystar
- GitHub: https://github.com/mazzzystar/Queryable
