FAQ:

1. What languages can I search in?
   You can describe photos in your own language. Queryable translates your query on device, while keeping the accuracy of the English search model. The first time, iOS asks once to download your language for offline translation; you can also do it anytime in Settings. Text search looks for the words exactly as they appear in your photos; it reads English and, where Apple's engine supports it, your device language. The app interface is available in 18 languages.

2. How is my photo privacy protected?
   Queryable works completely offline. You can even disable the app's network permissions. The only time it uses the network is when you choose to download the full-resolution original of a photo stored in iCloud.

3. How do I use it?
   After downloading, build an index for your photos. This takes a few minutes depending on your library and device, and is only required once. When you add new photos, you can update the index at any time. Text recognition is optional and slower than the visual index; you can pause it and continue later.

4. Why can't Text search find some photos?
   With "Optimize iPhone Storage" turned on, many photos are kept on your iPhone only as small previews that are too small to read. Open such a photo and download the original, and its text is recognized automatically.

bluejetty:00145680:ios.description:
Welcome to Mindset, the daily self-care app that is changing the way people take care of their mental well-being. Our app offers a range of self-care tools and resources, including meditations, sleep stories, journaling prompts, community reflections, expert tips and advice, guided breathing exercises, and exclusive content from your favorite celebrities. We also have a signature daily check-in experience that helps you takes actionable steps to improve your mental health and practice self-care in just 5 minutes a day.
Mindset is also your go-to destination for exclusive, intimate audio collections featuring personal mental health stories and life lessons from your favorite artists and celebrities, such as Joshua of Seventeen, Vernon of Seventeen, Mingyu of Seventeen, DK of Seventeen, Eric Nam, Tablo of Epik High, Woosung, Keshi, 6LACK, Summer Walker, B.I, Paul Wesley, Amine, Raisa, Catriona Gray, Armaan Malik, Julia Michaels, Tori Kelly, Bobby of iKON, Minnie of (G)I-DLE, Soyeon of (G)I-DLE, Jinhwan of iKON, Bea Miller, JAY B, Huddy, Ashley Choi, slowthai, and BM of KARD.
Features and Content:
The Daily Mindset: a daily episode that aims to provide you with a dose of mindfulness to start your day off on the right foot. Each episode features a different theme or topic related to self-care and mental health, and is designed to help you cultivate a positive and healthy mindset. 
Daily Check-in: a daily experience to help you take actionable steps towards improving your mental health and practicing self-care in just 5 minutes a day
Daily Motivational Quotes: a great way to start your day on a positive note, and can help you stay motivated and inspired throughout the day.
Daily Mood Tracker: an easy and convenient way to track your mood on a daily basis. 
Daily Gratitude Journal: a simple and effective way to cultivate gratitude and positivity in your daily life.
Daily Reflections: a space for you to share your thoughts, feelings, and experiences with the Mindset community. Each day, you can participate in a new reflection prompt and read the responses from others in the community. 
Daily User Streaks: a way for you to track your progress and consistency with using the Mindset app. 
Expert-Led Content: expert content in the Mindset app offers you access to professional tips and advice on self-care and mental health from trusted professionals. These resources are provided by experts in the field, and cover a wide range of topics related to mental well-being.
Celebrity Mindset Collections: Our Celebrity Mindset Collections feature exclusive content from top artists and celebrities, who share their own experiences and insights on mental health and well-being. These collections offer a unique and relatable perspective on a variety of topics, such as self-care, positivity, and overcoming challenges. With these collections, you can get an inside look at how some of your favorite celebrities approach their own mental health and find inspiration and guidance for your own journey. 
Mood Boosters: designed to help lift your mood and improve your emotional well-being. These episodes feature exclusive content from top artists and celebrities, and are meant to help you feel more connected and uplifted. Each episode is carefully curated to bring you positive and inspiring messages that can help boost your mood and bring some joy into your day. 
More exciting features and artists coming soon!

Stress management
Anxiety
Depression
Burnout
Grief and loss
Sleep disorders
Eating disorders
Self-care practices
Boundaries and self-compassion
Coping with change and uncertainty
Building healthy relationships
Goal setting and motivation
Time management and productivity
Managing emotions
Building resilience
Building self-esteem and self-confidence.
Celebrity mental health stories

bluejetty:00137121:ios.summary:
Dual Chat allows you to use WhatsApp on your iPad or access the same WhatsApp account on two devices.
You can also manage two different WhatsApp numbers on a single iPhone.
Similar to WhatsApp Web, this app serves as an extension of your ph
bluejetty:00137121:ios.description:
Dual Chat allows you to use WhatsApp on your iPad or access the same WhatsApp account on two devices.
You can also manage two different WhatsApp numbers on a single iPhone.
Similar to WhatsApp Web, this app serves as an extension of your phone, mirroring your WhatsApp messages and conversations. 
Your messages remain securely stored on your phone.
Using two WhatsApp accounts can be useful in various situations:
- Separating personal and work communication – one account for personal chats, another for work.
- Using a local and an international number – convenient for travelers and business professionals.
- Managing a business – one account for customers, another for the team.
- Keeping social circles separate – for example, one account for family and another for friends.
- Marketing and sales purposes – different accounts for different business activities.
How It Works:
1. Open Dual Chat to generate a QR code.
2. Scan this QR code using WhatsApp on your phone to sync your chats.
3. Find this option within WhatsApp under "Linked Devices."
Features:
* Secure access with Face ID and Touch ID.
* QR Code Scanner for quick setup.
* Dual chat functionality. 
Important
* Your phone must remain connected to the internet for Dual Chat to function properly.
* A subscription is required for full access to app features. 
Disclaimer
Dual Chat is an independent tool designed for use with WhatsApp. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp Inc. 
Subscription Details
* Limited functionality is available without a subscription.
* Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
* Manage subscriptions in your iTunes account settings.
* Unused portions of free trials are forfeited upon subscription purchase. 
Privacy Policy: 
https://digitalhero.tech/application-privacy-policy
 Terms of Use: 
https://digitalhero.tech/terms-of-usage
 Support: 
https://digitalhero.tech/application-support

bluejetty:00021682:ios.summary: Discover all the benefits of My Rituals – our exclusive and free membership programme – in the palm of your hand with the Rituals App. Enjoy shopping with 10% off your first order and get access to premium content like our magazine, masterc
bluejetty:00021682:ios.description:
Discover all the benefits of My Rituals – our exclusive and free membership programme – in the palm of your hand with the Rituals App. Enjoy shopping with 10% off your first order and get access to premium content like our magazine, masterclasses, podcasts, recipes and yoga and meditation exercises. Get more of what you love, to live a soulful life and boost your personal wellbeing. 
My Rituals doesn’t just offer our members inspiration on slowing down and living more soulfully. Like a true friend, we also want to support the growth and development of your wellbeing—from physical and mental, to spiritual and emotional—and to help you find moments of meaning throughout your day through our products, editorial content and expert guidance. Along the way you’ll pass through different phases of your journey. Each phase unlocks unique rewards, benefits, and experiences. You’ll enjoy exclusive gifts, invitations to VIP events, tips & tricks to living more purposefully, and lots of other things we think you’ll love.
We want to help make your life as easy as possible, which is why shopping with our app is so simple. In a few clicks, you’ll have your favourite Rituals luxuries delivered to your doorstep: from home fragrance to body care to advanced and clean and conscious skincare. Improved navigation, product advice and a seamless ordering process: with the Rituals app, it’s all in your hands.
We’ve teamed up with several industry experts – like Mo Gawdat and Dr. Shelby Harris – to create masterclasses for you to follow. Whether it’s finding more positivity in your daily life or learning to improve the quality of your sleep, we’ve got the videos, tips and tricks that show you the way.
Our team of yogis have designed yoga classes to suit your every need—be it more energy, better balance or even de-stressing after a hectic workday. With a few simple swipes of your phone, you can discover different yoga styles and what fits best into your daily routine. 
We’ve also incorporated many different guided meditations into our app: to help you find your centre whenever and wherever you happen to be. The app not only teaches beginners how to meditate, it also includes meditation techniques for people who have been practicing for years. Meditate your way to higher self-esteem, more positivity and even a calmer mind. Imagine inhaling a sense of inner peace, then exhaling and letting go of stress. This is what the Rituals app can do for you.
Gifting is easier than ever before with meaningful moments, providing a fuss-free way to remember special moments with your family and friends. Mark a meaningful moment and receive a reminder of your loved ones’ birthdays, anniversaries, or a special day of your choice. With the option of adding a special gift, meaningful moments are easier than ever before.

bluejetty:00157451:ios.name: Handbid
bluejetty:00157451:ios.summary: Mobile iOS Client for the Handbid® Silent Auction service. This client allows bidders who are invited to Handbid® powered silent auctions to bid on items from their mobile device, manage bids and proxy bids, purchase items, checkout, issue
bluejetty:00157451:ios.description:
Mobile iOS Client for the Handbid® Silent Auction service. This client allows bidders who are invited to Handbid® powered silent auctions to bid on items from their mobile device, manage bids and proxy bids, purchase items, checkout, issue payment, and get a receipt.
Handbid has powered hundreds of events and delighted thousands of bidders in the process. With native apps for iPhone well as a kiosk app available for the iPad for non-smartphone users, there is not a better experience and solution for running your silent auction or fundraising event. 
Here are 3 great reasons to use Handbid for your next event:
1. Our mobile app experience is second to none. Your bidders will love it! And yes, they WILL download an app on their phone! 
2. Handbid is built for AUCTION HOSTS by AUCTION HOSTS. Handbid has been powering silent auctions since 2011 and we have been running auctions ourselves much longer than that. We know how hard it is and we have built this system to make it EASY for you, your volunteers, and your guests. 
3. Our commitment to service is as great as our software. We get as many (if not more) compliments on our customer service as we do on our software. You can be assured we will do everything we can to make your experience as smooth and easy as possible. 
Common questions about Handbid:
- Can people pay though Handbid
Yes! We have integrated payments in the app so that at the end of the night, your guests can view and pay their invoice without having to stand in line. Our system supports all major credit cards as well as Apple Pay! Can you accept payments outside of Handbid? Sure (cash, check or your own CC system)
- Do you provide on-site support?
Yes we can do that. We have built Handbid to be easy enough to use where you can train and do it yourself, but we certainly do offer onsite experts who can do it all for you or even just provide extra "tech support" the day of your event. 
- How much does it cost?
We offer a number of fixed price packages that are based on the size and number of events you run. Please contact us or visit our website to view all of our pricing. 
- It looks cool, but is it worth the investment? 
Absolutely. Sure, you expected to hear us say that. But remember, we run auctions for our own organizations. We know you are on a tight budget and you want to maximize dollars for your program services. Handbid more than pays for itself. Most of our clients see anywhere from a 30% to 50% increase over what they did before on paper. Some even higher. 
Put it this way, this is one investment that will generate more revenue at your event. You can't say the same for your caterer, venue or even the band. 
What are you waiting for? Download the app already? Sign up! It's free to check out. Just go into our demo auction and start to bid around. Trust us, we won't make you pay for what you bid on there! 
Check out our iPad kiosk app, also in the iTunes App Store. Play with both of them!
Have fun, play around, then give us a call and lets get started! Your bidders are waiting for an awesome auction experience. Don't deny them what they deserve! 
With love - 
The Handbid Team

bluejetty:00096259:ios.developer: Loom Games Oyun Yazilim ve Pazarlama Anonim Sirketi
bluejetty:00096259:ios.summary: Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, i
bluejetty:00096259:ios.description:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

bluejetty:00099775:ios.description:
Thomas & Friends: Let’s Roll+ invites kids to drive their favorite engines and build their own tracks, fueling big imaginations and tons of hands-on fun. Perfect for preschoolers ages 2-6 and thoughtfully made for all kids to enjoy! 
• Drive around the Island of Sodor to enjoy lots of exciting journeys! 
• You can pick a different engine for each journey, including Thomas, Bruno, Percy, and more. 
• Even very young children can enjoy a rewarding driving experience with our kid-friendly driving controls.
• The TRACK BUILDER feature lets you build a train track and drive a toy train on it! 
• You can enhance your track with lots of fun and interesting scenery options. 
• Watch your trains chug along the track and the landscape you created! 
• This app helps kids develop spatial awareness, fine motor skills, and self-expression. 
FUN FOR EVERYONE 
Designed for ALL kids, (especially little neurodivergent engineers) this app brings expert input from autistic writer Jody O'Neill to create a playful, inclusive experience. Kids set their own pace, are offered clear choices, and can safely explore alongside Bruno the Brake Car, a neurodivergent friend from Sodor. Designed for repeated play sessions, this app will offer joy and comfort to kids, over and over again! 
JOURNEYS 
The Old Mine, Whiff’s Recycling Plant, Norramby Beach, McColl’s Farm, and Winter Wonderland 
CHARACTERS 
Thomas, Bruno, Gordon, Percy, Nia, Diesel and Kana
FEATURES 
- Safe and age-appropriate
- Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age
- Regular updates with new content
- No third-party advertising. 
SUPPORT
For any questions or assistance, please reach out to us at support@storytoys.com.
ABOUT STORYTOYS
Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.
PRIVACY & TERMS 
StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you would like to learn more about the information we collect and how we use it, please visit our privacy policy at https://storytoys.com/privacy.
Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms/
© 2026 Gullane (Thomas) Limited. The Thomas name and character and the Thomas & Friends™ logo are trademarks of Gullane (Thomas) Limited and its affiliates and are registered in many jurisdictions throughout the world.

Whether you’re leading a running group, book club, pickleball team, or parent o
bluejetty:00042098:ios.description:
Heylo is the platform for community groups. Heylo gives leaders the tools to be more organized with events, chats, and payments in your own branded group space.
Whether you’re leading a running group, book club, pickleball team, or parent organization, Heylo gives you the tools to build a thriving community and meaningful group experiences.
The result? Happier members and a stronger, more engaged community.
WITH HEYLO, YOU CAN…
ORGANIZE EVENTS
Create events and broadcast all the details by push notification and email
Keep everyone connected with dedicated event group chats
Customize event registration, set caps, offer early access, and invite guests
Control event visibility—keep some events private for members, while showcasing others to the public.
Track attendance and celebrate participation with event milestones
STREAMLINE COMMUNICATION 
Create chats for members by topic and for events
Add icebreakers and introductions
No more juggling DMs or emails—everything your members need is in one place
Pinned chat for leaders to reach everyone with integrated push notifications and emails
COLLECT PAYMENTS AND WAIVERS
Skip the awkward conversations and simplify member contributions. Flexible recurring membership options, from monthly to scholarship
Add a price to an event and collect payments in advance
Showcase sponsors and partners with discounts behind a membership paywall
Protect yourself by collecting waivers
BRAND YOUR SPACE
Customize your group’s page with your group’s colors, logo, and a custom URL you can share on your socials.
Add custom links to share essential information. There’s no limit to the number of links you can add, and you control the visibility.
Your group page automatically displays all your upcoming events and group information, keeping your page fresh and up-to-date without any extra effort.
HAPPIER MEMBERS
Members can choose how they stay connected via the web, app, or email.
They manage their memberships, profiles, connections, and payment information by themselves.
PLUS HEYLO IS…
FREE TO USE
No paywall to get started, no usage limits, and no ads. Heylo makes money by collecting a small percentage when you collect payments.
A SAFE SPACE
Make your entire group private, host private events accessible only to selected members of your group, and screen new members before allowing them to join.
Collect private member information securely, whether you're hosting brunches and need to know dietary restrictions, or signing up for running races with age and gender requirements.
Remove or delete anything in your group, including messages, members, or events. You have control. Export your member info anytime.
WHAT GROUP LEADERS SAY
“In our first year on Heylo, paid members increased 3x to over 600. We had to set a cap. I can’t believe how seamless Heylo is.” - Steve Finley, Brooklyn Track Club
“Super user-friendly. There are even some older players—in their 70s—who use Heylo without issue. Heylo has made a tremendous impact on how much the group plays—a great thing for everyone.” - Mike Smith, Ragle Beach Volleyball
“Collecting payment in advance of our classes brought our no-show rate down from 50% to zero.” - Romain, San Francisco Beach Volleyball

bluejetty:00063454:ios.description:
GoTV allows you to watch live TV channels on your iPhone or iPad. Simply add a link to an M3U playlist or paste it into the app to start watching online TV. IPTV technology allows you to watch live TV from your cable provider or free live TV channels wherever you are. The game follows the Singapore’s twist on the popular table game, Mahjong.

Unravel the mysteries and secrets hidden within these traditional buildin
bluejetty:00039078:ios.description:
In southern Italy, the picturesque town of Alberobello features rows of charming, cone-shaped houses. These white stone structures stand out against a clear blue sky.
Unravel the mysteries and secrets hidden within these traditional buildings, overcome their clever mechanisms, and make your escape from the fairytale land of Alberobello.
【Features】
・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!
・There are Hints, so Don’t worry!
・Auto-save function!
・No need for paper and pen! Swipe left from the right edge of the screen to take notes!
【How to play】
Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.
【Jammsworks】
programmer：Asahi Hirata
Designer：Naruma Saito
Produced by two of us.
Our goal is to produce a game that would be fun for the users.
If you like this game, please play other games!
【Provide】
Music is VFR：http://musicisvfr.com
Pocket Sound : http://pocket-se.info/
icons8：https://icons8.com/

bluejetty:00184977:ios.description:
Are you ready to be a part of an elegant indoor court basketball game? Get ready to play the best sports game of the year. This game is specially designed for you to get trained and become a sports champion. Play in training mode to get your rough skills polished. Be a part of the tournament and win against your rivals.
3D basketball gameplay in the elegant indoor basketball court. The gameplay is designed in two different game modes. Either practice your skills in training mode or play tournament and compete tournament playing teams. The global leaderboard is integrated into the game, you can score at your best level and compete with players from all around the world.
The game has very responsive controls that will allow you to fully control the movements of your players. A quick match mode allows you to play with random teams and you donot have to waste your time picking out a time. The global leaderboard is within the game allows you to keep your scores in check so that you can upgrade your game and win against your opponents around the world. Get incentives after winning and be ready for the next match.
Game Features
- Responsive game controls to get control of your player in gameplay
-Invite friends to play game
-Share your score with friends on Facebook
-Shout on social media when you manage to beat your opponent team in a match
-Quick Match Game Mode sets the match with a random team.
-Tournament Game Mode Play tournament, win matches and qualify to the final
-Make your place on the global leader board and compete with players from all over the world
-Get incentive stars on winning a game
-3 Stars will be rewarded if you manage to beat an opponent with more than 3 goals
-2 Stars will be rewarded if you beat an opponent with 2 goals
-1 Star will be rewarded if you beat an opponent from 1 goal
-Realistic sounds and stunning graphics
If you have any suggested features or improvements please leave a comment. In case something is not working correctly please let us know, We’ll be glad to fix that.
Please post comments and feedback. When posting a low rating please describe what is wrong to give the possibility to fix that issue.

bluejetty:00175891:ios.description:
This app is designed to be used with the Scream Game from Funko Games. This cooperative board game is played in real time. It's a fun, tense and fast-paced experience! Work together to play cards as fast as you can. Rush to draw and trade for the cards you need to complete your scene. If you complete all the scenes before time runs out, and before any player is killed, you all win! If not, Ghost Face gets you and you all lose!
Ghost Face (voiced by Roger L. Jackson) will call you using this app to taunt, threaten, or stalk players during the game as described in the instructions and how to play video. Make sure to keep working together and prevent players from becoming Ghost Face's next victim!
Need more of a challenge? Select Hard Mode in the Settings and Ghost Face calls more often and you have less time to win.
The game defaults to Moderate language, but you may choose Strong language for more graphic and intense narration from Ghost Face.

bluejetty:00152222:ios.description:
Cook Sort 
Step into the thrilling world of Cook Sort, where speed, strategy, and observation combine! Your mission is simple: swiftly organize colorful food items into their correct lines, turning chaos into order. Are your decision-making speed and dexterity ready for the challenges ahead? Embark on this exciting kitchen-sorting journey and unlock the gates to the next level!
Cook Sort perfectly blends addictive puzzles, rapid reflexes, and deep strategy. This game will keep you hooked for hours, ensuring the fun never ends. Get ready to dive into the rhythm of food, sorting, and merging; download now and build your own kitchen empire!
With difficulty levels suited for every player, Cook Sort never leaves you unchallenged. Hone your skills in beginner stages, then prove you're a true sorting master in expert mode. Keep the excitement at its peak with additional game modes like endless sorting or time trials!
Game Features:
Fluid and Addictive Gameplay: An immersive experience that will keep you captivated for hours.
Dynamic Difficulty Levels: Continuously test your skills with levels that progressively increase in challenge.
Intuitive and Precise Controls: Simple, smooth touch controls that players of all ages can easily adapt to.
Diverse Food Types: Never get bored with a deep gameplay experience featuring food items varying by color, size, and type.
Speed and Accuracy Focused: Race against the clock to sort food items flawlessly, rewarding you for your speed and precision.
Power-ups and Special Abilities: Unlock special power-ups that will help you in tough moments or earn bonus points.
Progression and Achievement System: Unlock new stages with every successful level and advance on the game map. Take pride in your accomplishments by completing special missions or reaching milestones.
Cook Sort is more than just a game; it's an adrenaline-fueled adventure that trains your eyes and brain, sharpens your reflexes, tests your strategy, and rewards your precision. Whether you're looking for a quick gaming fix or a long-lasting arcade experience, Cook Sort has it all.

bluejetty:00068130:ios.description:
Over 160 million illustrations, manga, and novels to explore right now!
This is the official iOS app of pixiv, Japan's largest creative community with over 119 million registered users.
With this app, you can easily discover and enjoy amazing works anytime, anywhere.
pixiv is a platform designed to "accelerate creativity".
From anime and manga to fine art, creators from all backgrounds share their work here.
Start exploring and find your next favorites today!
■ About pixiv
▶ Illustrations
○ Browse
Discover illustrations posted every day, 
and enjoy them in high quality!
○ Post
Share your artwork with the world
and collect Likes!
▶ Manga
○ Browse
Enjoy original manga you can't read anywhere else! 
Don’t miss out on trending stories.
○ Post
Post your manga
and grow your audience!
▶ Novels
○ Browse
From romance and fantasy to sci-fi and more,
find stories that match your taste!
○ Post
Share your writing on pixiv 
and connect with readers everywhere!
■ Key Features
○ Recommended Works
・View recommended works based on pixiv's most popular posts, ratings, and your own Likes and Bookmarks.
・The more works you like, the better pixiv learns what you love!
○ Rankings
・Browse what's trending across the community.
・Find trending works over the past day, week, or month.
・Enjoy various ranking categories such as "Popular with Males", "Popular with Females", and "Original Works".
○ New Works
・Check out new works from the users you're following.
・See new works from all pixiv users and spark your creative inspiration!
○ Search
・Search for works with your favorite keywords.
・Search illustrations by tags or titles and novels by tags or body text. You can even find stories featuring your favorite characters!
・Search for creators—your favorite artist might be on pixiv! Follow them to stay updated.
・Quickly access frequent searches from your history.
・See the latest trends on pixiv with "Featured Tags".
■ pixiv Premium
○ About pixiv Premium
pixiv Premium is a subscription service that gives you access to the following features on pixiv:
・Search by Popularity: Find the most popular works from over 160 million submissions.
・Hide Ads: Enjoy a faster, cleaner viewing experience without ads.
・Browsing History: See a list of all the works you’ve viewed in the past 180 days.
・Mute: Hide works or tags you'd rather not see for a more comfortable browsing experience.
To learn more, go to My Page > Join pixiv Premium or My Page > pixiv Premium Features in the pixiv app.
○ Pricing
・$4.99 per month auto-renewing subscription.
○ Subscription Period
Your subscription is valid for one month from the date you sign up.
Unless canceled at least 24 hours before the renewal date, your plan will automatically renew, and the subscription fee will be charged to your Apple ID.
○ How to Check or Cancel Your Subscription
To check your subscription status or cancel auto-renewal:
Go to the Settings app > Your profile icon > Subscriptions > pixiv Premium
You can view or cancel your subscription from this screen.
○ Cancellations and Refunds
Cancellations and refunds for the current month are not available.
If you wish to cancel your subscription, please turn off auto-renewal before the next billing cycle.
○ Restoring Purchases or Re-subscribing to pixiv Premium
pixiv Premium is linked to your Apple ID.
You can only restore your subscription or re-subscribe using the pixiv account you originally registered with.
To subscribe with a different pixiv account, you will need to use a separate Apple ID.
○ Terms and Conditions
Please review the following before using pixiv Premium:
・Privacy Policy
https://policies.pixiv.net/#privacy
・pixiv Premium Terms of Use
https://policies.pixiv.net/

bluejetty:00080873:ios.name: Hidden Objects: Carnival F2P
bluejetty:00080873:ios.summary: Dive into the enthralling world of "Magic City Detective: The Carnival Begins," a free-to-play game that combines the allure of detective challenges, hidden object hunts, and mysterious puzzles into one captivating adventure set against the
bluejetty:00080873:ios.description:
Dive into the enthralling world of "Magic City Detective: The Carnival Begins," a free-to-play game that combines the allure of detective challenges, hidden object hunts, and mysterious puzzles into one captivating adventure set against the vibrant backdrop of New Orleans during Mardi Gras. Enjoy murder mystery games challenges that will test your abilities to find hidden objects, solve puzzles, brain teasers and mystical riddles lurking behind New Orleans’ festive facade!
New Orleans is trembling! The city is decked out in holiday colors as Mardi Gras festivities are in full swing! Talented half-blood wizard Elizabeth is ready to lend a helping hand, but are her intentions really so pure? Meanwhile, the world of Men and Others is frozen in anticipation.... Something big is coming, something that could turn everything upside down! And you, Magical Detective, are at the center of all these events! After all, no murderer can resist you and no evil spirit can hide! But be careful... Even you can feel the pull of temptation... And what if it's already crawled deep into your heart?!
Hidden Objects Games: Immerse yourself in levels meticulously designed for hidden object enthusiasts. Each location will challenge your observational skills and contributes to your overall crime-solving journey!
Authentic Crime City Atmosphere: Experience the dual vibes of celebration and secrecy. Navigate through a city buzzing with Mardi Gras festivities meshed with dark, mysterious undertones!
Puzzles and Brain Teasers: Beyond finding objects, test your intellect with a variety of puzzles and brain teasers that are seamlessly woven into the gameplay, enhancing the crime investigation experience!
Decide the Fate: Your choices and detective abilities will shape the outcome of the mystery games f2p adventure. Can you handle the responsibility of maintaining the balance between the magical and human realms?
Casual Games for All Skill Levels: Whether you are a veteran of detective games or new to the genre, "Magic City Detective" offers a balanced gameplay experience that caters to all levels of players!
Play for Free: Experience the full thrill of being a detective with no cost. Solve puzzles, search and find games and brain teasers without any initial investment!
Join the f2p adventure and unleash your detective skills in "Magic City Detective: The Carnival Begins." Play now and make your mark on the magical history of Mardi Gras!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00135678:ios.name: Dive & Sushi
bluejetty:00135678:ios.summary: Grab your scuba mask and dive into an underwater world of Dive & Sushi, a casual game that combines underwater exploration, fishing, and restaurant management simulation. In here, you can explore different mysterious seas and encounter vari
bluejetty:00135678:ios.description:
Grab your scuba mask and dive into an underwater world of Dive & Sushi, a casual game that combines underwater exploration, fishing, and restaurant management simulation. In here, you can explore different mysterious seas and encounter various rare fish species to catch. At the same time, you can use the fish you've caught to make sushi and other delicious dishes. Earn money to expand your restaurant and upgrade your diving equipment. In Dive & Sushi, you can not only enjoy the intense battle with fierce fish, but also experience the pleasure of running a restaurant.
Explore The Underwater World
In Dive & Sushi, players can freely explore different underwater worlds, uncover precious treasures, catch rare fish species, and engage in battles with fierce marine creatures.
Unique Roguelike Mechanics
As you explore the unknown seas, you can continuously go fishing to level up and have a chance to randomly enhance your skills, harpoon enchantments, and equipment upgrades. You can also discover precious underwater treasures.
Run a Restaurant, Earn Big Bucks
In Dive & Sushi, in addition to going out to sea to fish, you also need to manage a sushi restaurant. Hire skilled chefs and waiters, develop new menu items, and provide great service to every customer. Earn money from running the sushi restaurant to upgrade your equipment and weapons.
Mysterious and Perilous Seas
Don't think you can easily explore the ocean depths - you will encounter many aggressive fish. As you dive deeper, you will also encounter powerful sea monsters that you will need to defeat with your own strength and luck!
Gear Up, Support Your Expeditions
Be sure to upgrade your diving equipment and weapons - they are crucial for your survival in the sea. Oxygen tanks can help you stay underwater for longer, diving suits can help you dive deeper. Weapons can help you battle the ferocious sea creatures.
Dive & Sushi is a must-play game that combines thrilling ocean exploration and restaurant management. Whether you're a fan of exciting adventures or simulation gameplay, you can find enjoyment in Dive & Sushi. What are you waiting for? Download and try it out!

bluejetty:00177406:ios.name: BMCI Connect
bluejetty:00177406:ios.developer: Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie SA
bluejetty:00177406:ios.summary:
BMCI Connect vous donne accès à divers services pour vous permettre de réaliser vos opérations bancaires en toute sécurité et en toute autonomie:
- Vos Comptes
- Consultez le solde de vos comptes 
- Consultez l’historique de vos opérations
bluejetty:00177406:ios.description:
BMCI Connect vous donne accès à divers services pour vous permettre de réaliser vos opérations bancaires en toute sécurité et en toute autonomie:
- Vos Comptes
- Consultez le solde de vos comptes 
- Consultez l’historique de vos opérations
- Catégorisez vos opérations selon vos besoins
- Téléchargez l’historique de vos opérations à votre guise 
• Vos Virements
- Gérez vos bénéficiaires: ajoutez-les, modifiez-les ou supprimez-les en toute autonomie
- Effectuez vos virements vers vos comptes, les comptes BMCI ou les comptes confrères
- Consultez l’historique de vos virements et suivez leurs statuts
• Vos Cartes
- Consultez la liste de vos cartes bancaires
- Configurez vos plafonds de retrait et vos plafonds de paiement 
- Activez ou désactivez vos paiements sans contact et vos paiements en ligne 
- Opposez votre carte en temps réel
- Bloquez provisoirement votre carte et débloquer là en temps réel 
- Consultez vos dotations Touristique & Internet
- Consultez l’historique de vos opérations effectuées par carte
• Vos Paiements
- Payez vos factures, vos taxes et vos vignettes en quelques clics
- Rechargez le solde de votre ligne téléphonique pour vous ou vos proches
- Consultez à tout moment l’historique de vos paiements
- Téléchargez vos reçus de paiement selon vos besoins
- Ajoutez vos factures en favoris pour gagner du temps lors de vos prochains paiements
• Vos Services en ligne
- Commandez vos chéquiers directement depuis votre application mobile
- Suivez l’historique de vos commandes de chéquiers
- Effectuez vos retraits sans carte 
- Consultez l’historique de vos retraits sans carte 
- Consultez votre RIB et télécharger-le en cas de besoin
- Consultez l’aide en ligne (FAQ) pour une meilleure prise en main de BMCI Connect
• Contactez la BMCI
- Faites-vous rappeler en cas de besoin par l’un de nos Conseillers BMCI
- Trouvez une agence BMCI ou un Guichet Automatique Bancaire BMCI à proximité de votre localisation ou partout au Maroc
- Découvrez nos produits en quelques clics
• Paramètres
- Gérez les seuils de vos différents comptes 
- Gérez le plafond des virements vers vos bénéficiaires dans la limite de 50 000 dhs
- Demandez la modification de vos données personnelles depuis votre application mobile pour un traitement plus rapide
- Consultez le Guide Utilisateur BMCI Connect et découvrez pas à pas les nouvelles fonctionnalités proposées par la BMCI
- Activez l’authentification biométrique pour accéder à vos comptes en ligne via Touch ID ou Face ID
- Générez en toute autonomie votre premier mot de passe ou bien un nouveau mot de passe en cas d’oubli
L’application BMCI Connect permet également, sans saisir ses codes d’accès, de bénéficier des fonctionnalités suivantes :
- Trouvez une agence BMCI ou un Guichet automatique BMCI à proximité de votre localisation ou partout au Maroc
- L’assistance concernant l’aide à la connexion
- L’accès au FAQ de la banque
- Se faire rappeler par un Conseiller BMCI
- Accédez aux plateformes Digitales de la BMCI (web & mobile)
Les équipes BMCI restent à votre écoute pour faire évoluer l’Application Mobile BMCI Connect.

bluejetty:00031445:ios.summary:
24/7 VIRTUAL CARE THAT SAVES YOU TIME AND MONEY

bluejetty:00031445:ios.description:
24/7 VIRTUAL CARE THAT SAVES YOU TIME AND MONEY
Gia is available 24/7, so you can get care, help with a health condition, support to get healthier, or answers to medical questions whenever and wherever you need it. Even better, Gia saves you money. In fact, it’s free for most MVP Members. *
URGENT AND EMERGENCY CARE: Gia connects you to urgent and emergency care, including behavioral health care, in minutes. It’s the fastest way to find out if you need treatment or an in-person visit.
TEXT A DOCTOR 24/7: Text a doctor 24/7 for virtual primary and specialty care, provided by MVP’s partner, Galileo. Use Galileo for preventive care, medical questions, chronic conditions like diabetes, or prescription refills.**
SAME-DAY TREATMENT FOR HEALTH CONCERNS: Doctors are available 24/7, no appointment needed, through our partnership with Galileo. So you can get same-day treatment for nearly any health concern.**
BEHAVIORAL HEALTH: Manage your medications and get help with conditions like anxiety, depression, trauma, and others. Schedule virtual therapy and psychiatry appointments, no referrals needed. Connect via video chat with qualified specialists. Members can also get help for urgent Behavioral Health needs within 20 minutes, no appointments or referrals necessary.**
--- FIND THE RIGHT IN-PERSON CARE
Gia connects you to lots of options for in-person care, so you can find the right care for almost any situation. 
FIND A DOCTOR: Search for in-network doctors by name or specialty, or care facilities (like hospitals and urgent care centers) by name or type. 
ESTIMATE YOUR COSTS: Estimate costs for more than a million health care services. Avoid surprise bills and find the most competitive prices (including $0 preventive care) for the care you need.
--- FAST ACCESS TO YOUR PLAN
Gia has lots of helpful information about your health plan, so it’s easy to stay up to date.
ID CARDS: View and share your MVP ID cards with doctors, family members, or anyone you wish.
PHARMACY SEARCH: Search for in-network pharmacies and set one as your primary. 
DRUG SEARCH: Find drug costs based on your plan, formulary, deductible, and OOP maximum. Plus compare generic and brand name drugs, see options for mail order or in-store pick up, and find out whether your drug requires a prior authorization. 
CLAIMS: See detailed information about medical, dental, and pharmacy claims. 
DEDUCTIBLES AND LIMITS: See progress toward deductibles and limits for any member of your plan across current and prior plan year.
PAYMENTS AND BILLING HISTORY: Pay your premium, view your payment history, manage your wallet, and set up Auto Pay so you never have to think about paying your premium again. 
PREVENTIVE CARE REMINDERS: Get proactive, personalized recommendations to keep you and your loved ones healthy. 
BENEFITS OVERVIEW: Get an overview of your coverage, including medical, dental, vision, and pharmacy plans.
SECURE MESSAGING: Connect with an MVP customer care representatives without leaving Gia. 
WELL-BEING REIMBURSEMENTS: Easily submit your well-being reimbursements for the plan year (if this is a plan benefit).
--- OTHER FEATURES
COMMUNICATION PREFERENCES: Update to paperless delivery or customize how you’d like to receive different kinds of information. 
SECURE, FLEXIBLE SIGN IN: Sign in using your password or biometrics (facial or fingerprint scan), plus a unique code sent to your phone. 
HELPFUL HINTS: Helpful explanations are available throughout the app, so you don’t have to search for unfamiliar terms. 
*MVP virtual care services through Gia are available at no cost-share for most members. In-person visits and referrals are subject to cost-share per plan. Exceptions exist for self-funded plans. Gia telemedicine services will be $0 after the deductible is met on MVP QHDHPs beginning January 1, 2025, upon plan renewal. 
**May require a separate app download

bluejetty:00184890:ios.description:
Reversi is a classic game that you can play solo or against a real opponent using either our local or online multiplayer mode; play with a friend on the same device or find an opponent from anywhere in the world! 
Trap your opponent’s pieces between your own to conquer them (of course your opponent will do the same!). Have fun seeing the pieces turn and change sides (colours) dozens of times, while you wage war for conquering the board. You’re the winner if you've got the most pieces when no more pieces can be played.
If you like Chess, Checkers, Go and strategy games, give it a try! You will have hours of fun and challenge. and best of all, it's Free! It's also great for brain training.
Key features: 
- Choose between 3 AI difficulty levels
- Play against real humans online (multiplayer)
- Challenge your friends on the same device (2 players mode)
- Climb the leaderboards
- Collect Game Center achievements
- Enjoy hours of fun with colourful themes
- Easy to get, hard to master
- Fun for all ages
Thanks for playing!

Trap your opponent’s pieces between your own to conquer them (of course your opponent will do the same!). Have fun seeing the pieces turn and change sides (colours) dozens of times, while you wage war for conquering the board. You’re the winner if you've got the most pieces when no more pieces can be played.

If you like Chess, Checkers, Go and strategy games, give it a try! You will have hours of fun and challenge. and best of all, it's Free! It's also great for brain training.

Key features: 
- Choose between 3 AI difficulty levels
- Play against real humans online (multiplayer)
- Challenge your friends on the same device (2 players mode)
- Climb the leaderboards
- Collect Game Center achievements
- Enjoy hours of fun with colourful themes
- Easy to get, hard to master
- Fun for all ages

Thanks for playing!

bluejetty:00024621:ios.description:
Touchpix is the complete photo booth solution for event professionals. Run 360° spinners, Magic Mirror booths, iPad stations, sharing stations, slomo booths or DSLR setups with total flexibility and pro results. Perfect for weddings, corporate events, birthdays, graduations, parties, and more.
One unified platform for iOS, Mac and Windows. Build the exact booth you need using the Apple devices and computers you already own.
Print like a pro — without extra hardware
 We offer dedicated Print Servers for Mac and Windows. Simply connect all your devices to the same network and turn any Mac or Windows computer into a smart Print Server. Full Jumbo Strip support (6×18, 6×20, 6×24 and 8×32) using our printing solution Printpix, or WCM. Bigger, bolder strips that make your events unforgettable.
Design freedom at your fingertips
 Advanced overlay designer: create any template with animated backgrounds, stickers, text, props and branding — layer by layer.
Cinematic video effects that wow guests
 Capture stunning 360 photos & videos, video testimonials, boomerangs, burst GIFs, traditional slow motion, and our powerful Super Slow Motion (Super Slomo) — record above real-time frame rates and slow it down dramatically for cinematic, high-contrast video effects that stand out on any event.
What makes Touchpix different
• Revolutionary Scanpix™ — internet-free QR sharing that works offline
• True offline AI: background removal + effects + AI Sketch Bot (drawing-style art)
• Photomosaic sessions (create beautiful collage-style photos combining multiple images, with or without AI)
• Video Guest Book / Confessional Mode with customizable prompts, instant review, and automatic compilation
• Full GoPro 7-13 support with Live View + Nikon, Sony & Canon DSLR
• Real-time sync, AirPlay cast to TV (live session or QR slideshow), triggers and roaming booth ready
• Branded online gallery + event dashboard
• Built-in Paywall: easily monetize with per-photo, per-print or digital share charges
Everything works offline with smart queuing so you never miss a moment. The reliable all-in-one tool that grows with your business.
Professional Version
Start with the free trial, then continue with unlimited events via Professional subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly). New flexible yearly option: pay your annual plan in convenient monthly instalments.

Terms: https://touchpix.com/general-terms-and-conditions-of-touchpix/

Take
bluejetty:00015187:ios.description:
Attendance Tracker - Take roll in seconds. See patterns at a glance.
Attendance Tracker is built for teachers, coaches, and instructors who need to record who’s present without fighting their app. Tap a name, pick a status, move on.
Take attendance fast 
- One-tap status cycling per student
- Set every student to the same status with one button
- Reorder by first or last name
- See live counts of present, absent, late and any custom status
Set up your classes once
- Add students manually or import from a CSV file
- Save students once and reuse them across courses
- Set a recurring schedule and the app generates upcoming classes for you
- Each class gets its own date, time and notes
Customize the statuses you actually use
- Edit the default statuses: Present, Absent, Late, Excused — or create your own
- Color-code each status
- Choose which statuses count as a missed class so reports stay accurate
Reports that make sense to admin
- Daily attendance and a list of who was missing
- Per-student attendance history with a visual breakdown
- Full-term and summary reports across any date range
- Email any report directly to parents or colleagues, or share via the iOS share sheet
Per-student records
- Photo, contact details, and any custom fields you need
- Add dated observations and notes — useful for parent meetings or end-of-term reviews
- Email a single student’s full record in one tap
Extras teachers actually use
- Random student picker for cold calls
- Random group generator, up to 30 per group, for activities
- iCloud sync keeps your classes consistent across iPhone and iPad
- Passcode lock for the times your phone leaves your hand
Privacy
Attendance data is stored on your device and synced through your private iCloud account. We don’t see it, and we don’t sell it.
Subscription terms:
- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy policy and Terms of Use: https://applorium.com/privacy-easy-attendance

bluejetty:00090867:ios.description: Introducing the HawkEye® FishPod® Series; smart fish finders based on our Boat Mount and Portable technologies that are designed to evolve as you evolve. When we set out to create an app based fish finder, we didn’t just hire an app developer and make a “pretty-little” app that looked good, but was light on function. We started with our highly successful FishTrax™ sonar technology, combined it with our nearly 20 years of experience in designing, manufacturing and supporting marine electronics, and finished by trying to break them day in and day out using our network of real life beta testers. bluejetty:00151902:ios.name: Mahjong Hybrid®: Match & Relax
bluejetty:00151902:ios.summary:
Mahjong Hybrid: Match & Relax
Discover a fresh way to enjoy Mahjong with Mahjong Hybrid: Match & Relax, a relaxing tile puzzle adventure designed for players who love thoughtful challenges and satisfying gameplay. Inspired by classic Mahjo
bluejetty:00151902:ios.description:
Mahjong Hybrid: Match & Relax
Discover a fresh way to enjoy Mahjong with Mahjong Hybrid: Match & Relax, a relaxing tile puzzle adventure designed for players who love thoughtful challenges and satisfying gameplay. Inspired by classic Mahjong, this unique experience introduces an original way to solve puzzles by sliding tiles, creating matching pairs, and clearing beautifully designed boards through observation and strategy.
Whether you're looking for a peaceful way to unwind after a busy day or a rewarding puzzle that keeps your mind engaged, Mahjong Hybrid delivers a perfect balance of relaxation and challenge.
A New Way to Play
Unlike traditional tile puzzles, Mahjong Hybrid encourages you to think ahead and discover creative solutions. Every move matters as you slide tiles across the board, create identical pairs, and gradually clear each level.
The controls are simple to learn, making the game accessible for beginners while offering enough depth to keep experienced puzzle fans engaged.
How to Play
• Choose the difficulty that fits your play style.
• Slide tiles vertically or horizontally.
• Create identical tile pairs to remove them from the board.
• Use empty spaces to build new matching opportunities.
• Clear every tile to complete the puzzle.
Every level rewards careful observation, logical thinking, and smart planning rather than fast reactions.
Relaxing Puzzle Experience
Beautiful tile artwork, smooth animations, and calming visual effects create a peaceful atmosphere that makes every session enjoyable.
Play for a few minutes during a break or spend a relaxing evening solving puzzle after puzzle. There are no unnecessary distractions—just satisfying gameplay designed to help you slow down and enjoy the experience.
Challenge Your Mind
Every puzzle encourages you to improve important thinking skills through enjoyable gameplay.
• Strengthen logical thinking.
• Improve concentration.
• Develop pattern recognition.
• Practice memory and observation.
• Discover new strategies with every puzzle.
As the levels become more challenging, you'll continue developing new ways to solve increasingly interesting puzzle layouts.
Features
• Original Mahjong-inspired puzzle mechanics
• Slide tiles to create matching pairs
• Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle levels
• Progressive difficulty for every skill level
• Beautiful tile artwork
• Smooth animations and relaxing backgrounds
• Helpful tools for challenging puzzles
• Daily rewards and regular updates
• Auto-save your progress
• Offline play for puzzle fun almost anywhere*
*Some features may require an internet connection.
Designed for Puzzle Lovers
Mahjong Hybrid is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing puzzle games, matching challenges, logical thinking, and casual gameplay.
Whether you're solving a quick puzzle during a coffee break or enjoying a longer play session at home, every level delivers satisfying decisions, rewarding progress, and a calm playing experience.
Enjoy a refreshing tile puzzle adventure where every move counts. Slide, pair, think, and relax as you discover a modern interpretation of classic Mahjong-inspired gameplay.
Download Mahjong Hybrid: Match & Relax today and begin your next puzzle adventure.

bluejetty:00129313:ios.description:

Want to switch from recording your voice to recording a song? Our app is perfect as a karaoke microphone! The built-in KARAOKE MODE allows you to upload any track and sing along with perfectly synced lyrics in any language!
- Main features -
ONE-TAP RECORDING
> Record audio instantly with our simple, one-click button. 
OUTPUT OPTIONS
> Select your preferred audio output source – connect to external speakers and headphones via AirPlay, or use your device’s built-in audio.
EQUALIZER & EFFECTS
> Achieve perfect sound with our equalizer (15 kHz - 300 Hz);
> Add depth and dimension with concert hall reverb, echo, choir, flanger, and distortion;  > Customize effects with adjustable settings like delay time, repetitions, depth, and frequency.
MICROPHONE VARIETY
> Choose from a wide range of microphone types with unique settings – dynamic, condenser, stage, valve, studio, and vintage.  
PORTABLE MEGAPHONE
> Boost your voice for clear communication in any environment.
AI ENHANCEMENT
> Improve recording quality by reducing noise and enhancing vocals with AI.
SONG COLLECTION
> Enjoy a handpicked collection of popular songs as background music for your speech recordings and other creative projects.
IMPORT FROM CLOUD
> Record over your favorite music! Upload audio files directly from your device storage, or access your recordings from popular cloud service:  
- iTunes 
- Google Drive 
- Dropbox 
- OneDrive
- Yandex Disk

bluejetty:00041627:ios.name: Morse Money
bluejetty:00041627:ios.summary: Morse is the global account for expats, freelancers, nomads, and remote workers. Whether you recently moved abroad, have family in another country, or live across borders, your bank probably wasn't built for it. Morse was. Spend anywhere wi
bluejetty:00041627:ios.description:
Morse is the global account for expats, freelancers, nomads, and remote workers. Whether you recently moved abroad, have family in another country, or live across borders, your bank probably wasn't built for it. Morse was. Spend anywhere with a Visa card, move money between your accounts worldwide, send money to 150+ countries, and get paid from companies abroad in USD and EUR. Sign up in minutes and add money via bank account, Pix, CLABE, Google Pay, or Apple Pay. Best exchange rates, low fees, no surprises. 
SPEND ANYWHERE WITH YOUR MORSE CARD.
Get a virtual debit card linked to your Morse balance and spend anywhere Visa is accepted. Travel anywhere and pay in dollars, euros, or local currency. No markups, no conversion surprises. Pay for subscriptions, add to Apple Pay and Google Pay, and earn cashback on your spending. 
MOVE MONEY BETWEEN YOUR OWN ACCOUNTS.
Got accounts and wallets spread across the world? Morse connects them all. Move money between your own accounts without the usual cross-border transfer costs. Whether you get paid abroad, just landed somewhere new, or split life across countries. International transfers in seconds, not days. 
THE REAL EXCHANGE RATE. ALWAYS.
Morse uses the mid-market exchange rate. The same one banks use with each other. No markups. No hidden fees. What you see is exactly what gets sent. Convert USD to MXN, USD to BRL, EUR to USD, and more. Compare that to what your bank charges. 
GET PAID FROM DEEL, UPWORK OR COMPANIES ABROAD.
Working for companies abroad? Get local USD, EUR, MXN, and BRL account details so clients and employers can pay you like a local. Get paid from Deel, Upwork, and more directly into your Morse account. They send a normal bank transfer, you receive international payments in Morse and use it however you want in a few taps. SEND 
MONEY TO FAMILY AND FRIENDS IN 150+ COUNTRIES.
Send for free, in seconds, to anyone on Morse. Send to Mexico, Brazil, and 150+ countries. Support your loved ones from wherever you are. 
TRUSTED. REGULATED. SECURE.
Morse is a regulated, secure money app trusted by hundreds of thousands of people and built with bank-grade security from day one. Morse is self-custodial, which means only you can access your wallet. ISO 27001 certified, and protected with strong customer authentication, 24/7 fraud monitoring, Verified by Visa and Mastercard SecureCode. Need help? A real person is always available.

bluejetty:00060724:ios.description:
EGW Writings 2 application enables you to read, search, and listen to the complete published writings of Ellen G. White. Multiple additional resources are available such as 14 Bible versions, including the King James Version of the Bible. Plus, several Dictionaries including 1828 Noah Webster’s American Dictionary. With over 800,000 pages of resources available in the EGW Writings 2 app, it is the most complete Adventist resource available. The app continues our line of successful EGW Writings free apps for iPhone, iPad, iPad Pro, and iPod Touch developed by the Ellen G. White Estate.
What’s new in Version 7:
* Syncing of Study Center data and user history through EGW Cloud
* My Library
* Updated bookshelf layout
* Updated reader layout
* New reader toolbar
* Additional color themes and much more
* Advanced Search:
 - search in collections: All Collections, Compilations, Lifetime Works
 - ordered search
* New Book Covers
* Numerous bug fixes
About the Author:
Ellen G. White (1827-1915) is considered the most widely translated American author. Her works having been published in more than 160 languages. Guided by the Holy Spirit, she exalted Jesus and pointed to the Scriptures as the basis of one’s faith. Ellen White wrote on a wide variety of spiritual and practical topics, from spiritual, to health, education, ministry, financial and marital advice. Her best known most translated work is Steps to Christ, followed by the 5 Conflict of the Ages series: Patriarchs and Prophets, Prophets and Kings, Desire of Ages, Acts of the Apostles, and The Great Controversy. Ellen G. White is also credited as one of the 3 cofounders of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
Materials Available:
* 120 Ellen G. White title’s
* Complete Published Writings title list: https://www.whiteestate.org/cdrom/cdrom.asp
* 6-volume Ellen G. White biography
* 21 Ellen G. White Devotionals
* 167 Ellen G. White Pamphlets
* 5,000 Ellen G. White Periodical articles
* 9347 Letters and Manuscripts Files (in 25 bound volumes)
* 13 Ellen G. White Miscellaneous Collections
* 21-volume Ellen G. White Manuscript Releases
* King James Version Bible (plus 11 other versions)
* 1828 Noah Webster’s American Dictionary
App Features:
* App now supports 137 languages
* Read or search either online or offline
* Sync reading and listening history with EGW Cloud
* Sync Study Center with EGW Cloud
* New Bookshelf layout with customizable display
* 4 major Collections all color coded
 *EGW in Blue
 *Reference in Gold
 *Bible in Burgundy
 *APL in Green
* Access to 14 Bible translations
* Quick direct access to an EGW book/page or paragraph using search 
(e.g. Education or Ed; Education 57 or Ed 57; Education 57.2 or Ed 57.2)
* Vertical or horizontal reading view available
* Quick reference access to the Bible using the abbreviated book codes. Also, you can go exactly to the chapter and verse if desired. (e.g. Jn, Jn 3, Jn 3:16)
* Navigate to any Bible verse quickly by tapping on the header while in the Bible to move to another verse.
* Horizontal left/right swipes to navigate to next/previous chapter
* Copy and paste text into other applications
* Add bookmarks to any Bible verse or EGW paragraph
* Search for highlighted words or phrases.
* Book reference location is always visible in the title bar.
* Search for words or “phrases” in the entire EGW library or KJV Bible
* Fast indexed search results with easy-scroll access to hits
* Easy navigation to search results highlighted within the chapter
* Daily Devotional Readings
* In EGW books all Bible references are hyperlinked
* Look up definitions in Dictionary
* Study Center: Bookmarks, Highlights, Notes
* Highlighting with 16 million colors
* Add bookmarks and highlights to topic folders
* Reading and audiobooks history
* Email or share a quote on Facebook, Twitter or other supported social networking apps

bluejetty:00156236:ios.name: Idle Funeral Tycoon
bluejetty:00156236:ios.summary: Idle Funeral Tycoon is an mortician simulator, a game in which you have to make money as well as organize the controls. Show everyone that you are a skillful manager and help your city at the same time! Build your funeral empire and have yo
bluejetty:00156236:ios.description:
Idle Funeral Tycoon is an mortician simulator, a game in which you have to make money as well as organize the controls. Show everyone that you are a skillful manager and help your city at the same time! Build your funeral empire and have your coffins ready!
Not a single dead person will be left without a grave: Morticians and their hearses patrol the city! In this game you can:
- Managing the mortuary is no easy task, your morticians should always be ready! It's time to update them, because a funeral home is not just a hearse and a doctor. Spend idle money, invest income to upgrade and build! You can buy equipment rooms and vehicles. Do not forget to level up so workers have the highest quality tools. Every decision you make affects what your strategy is, how you expand, and whether your morgue is up to it. Preparing corpses for burial will be a real adventure! Bury people with dignity!
- Hire employees - every mortician strives for maximum productivity. Good management can help with this: Automate the process and bury everyone! Find out which strategy is the best, show which of you is the manager in this Idle Funeral Tycoon simulator, build an empire. Mortician and manager at the same time! At the same time, this is not a clicker: you do not have to endlessly press the screen, as in other idle simulators.
What will you do?
- Manage the team: as an mortician and as a manager. Bury every resident of the city (military, billionaire, superhero and many others). The new dead? Hearse - go!
- Hearses, coffins, shovels - a real mortician must be technically equipped! When people in town have a new corpse, the hearse is already on its way.
- Improve management: hire managers and improve your business. A city full of corpses is a bad city.
- Build a system: as soon as a new corpse, a hearse, every mortician is ready to bury people.
- Every mission is a challenge! The secret to success is to earn unused money and invest it. If you are a good manager, you can use the earnings and benefits to upgrade the tools and equipment in the rooms!
Idle Funeral Tycoon - Mortician Simulator Manager - Features:
- The more you earn, the better your empire will be
- Bury and do not forget to upgrade your graveyard.
- Upgrade your equipment! The embalming table, the farewell room - all that needs to be built and mission accomplished!
- With this simulation of the mortician you can idly earn money both online and offline! An example of a good economic game! Better than Clicker!
Have you heard that there is a new corpse in town? It's time to send in the hearse and bury a human with dignity! The coffin is ready!

bluejetty:00115153:android.description:
LuaCoder - Script Maker is the ultimate tool for developers, server owners, and gamers who want to bring their ideas to life without struggling with complex coding. Designed for simplicity and flexibility, LuaCoder allows you to generate Lua scripts tailored to your needs across multiple platforms:
FiveM (GTA V Multiplayer) - Create client, server, or combined scripts for commands, vehicles, jobs, and roleplay features.
Roblox - Build custom systems like shops, GUIs, and game mechanics for your Roblox creations.
RedM (Red Dead Online) - Develop immersive scripts for roleplay servers with ease.
Discordia (Discord Bots) - Automate tasks, welcome users, and enhance your community with Lua-powered bots.
Garry’s Mod - Generate tools, props, and gameplay features for your servers.
World of Warcraft (Addons) - Design quest trackers, custom UI features, and gameplay improvements.
Factorio - Streamline your factory with logistics helpers, automation systems, and more.
With LuaCoder, you can:
Select your platform and script type (client, server, or both).
Configure script details like name, description, and purpose.
Instantly generate clean, functional Lua code with error handling.
Download all files (client, server, manifests, configs) neatly packaged and ready to use.
Access quick templates to jump-start common systems such as car spawners, shops, bots, and quest trackers.
Whether you’re a beginner learning Lua or an experienced developer looking to speed up your workflow, LuaCoder saves time and boosts creativity by turning ideas into scripts in just a few clicks.

The latest installment of the hugely popular "Neko Atsume" series with over 33 million downloads!
"Neko Atsume 2 (meow)" is here, with even more of what makes Neko Atsume so great!
● New features for even more fun!
Not only can you observe cats playing with toys, but now there are more features to enhance your Neko Atsume experience!
"Going Out"
You can visit other users' yards or invite them to your own yard. Plus, you might meet new cats while going out...!?
"Cat's Club Support"
Get some help from cats to make your Neko Atsume life more comfortable! You can welcome support cats called Helpers who assist you, or even a special cat that could become your ideal Myneko.
● Start with 2 with confidence! How to play Neko Atsume
The gameplay remains the same! Collect cats with easy controls!
"The 2 Steps of Neko Atsume"
Step 1: Place playthings and snacks in your yard.
Step 2: Wait for cats to visit!
Attract cats with food and then watch them romp with your toys! More than 40 varieties of cats-white and black, tabby and calico-might stop by. Rare cats are rumored to roam the neighborhood too, but you'll need particular items to entice those elusive felines. Each visitor is logged in your Catbook. Become a master kitty collector and fill it up!
* Note: Cat's Club Support is a subscription-based service.
* Some features require internet connectivity, and data charges may apply.
If you encounter any issues or have any questions, please contact our support team.

Join millions of players worldwide and showcase your skills in Survival Arena. Be ready for insane battles and an exhilarating journey in a post-apocalyptic world where your strength and skill will decide every fight.

bluejetty:00139073:ios.summary: We offer you a fascinating App for improving your power of observation. The game "Find Differences" is a cognitive puzzle in which players have to look for 5 differences between two pictures. All images, at first glance, are completely iden
bluejetty:00139073:ios.description:
We offer you a fascinating App for improving your power of observation. The game "Find Differences" is a cognitive puzzle in which players have to look for 5 differences between two pictures. All images, at first glance, are completely identical, and only the most attentive will notice the catch.
Do you want rest productively? Download Find the differences 500+ to your mobile phone and play, completely for free.
This puzzle fits both children and adults, since the range of images for finding differences has both simple and more complex. There are interior pictures, architectural objects (houses and buildings), people, animals, landscapes and much more. Choose whatever is to your liking and immerse yourself in a fascinating and fun game.
App features Find the differences 500+:
• Multiple difference search modes.
• Different task levels.
• Infinite number of prompts.
• Excellent image quality.
• Zoom in function.
• Automatic save of the differences found.
The App itself is very bright and colorful, the interface is very friendly and easy to use. There is a "settings" button where you can set the language, color, game view mode, portrait or landscape modes, turn sound on or off.
Select time-limited modes or play without a stopwatch. There is such a function in Find the differences 500+ as well.
Are you ready to train your brain, work on concentration and feel like a real detective? Take a magnifying glass, carefully examine both images and find all five differences between them. Move to a new level, earn bonuses, become the best among other players in the Find the differences 500+ App.

Bonhams, founded in 1793, is one of the world's largest auctioneers of fine art and antiques. The present company was formed by the merger in November 2001 of Bonhams & Brooks and Phillips Son & Neale. In August 2002, the company acquired Butterfields, the principal firm of auctioneers on the West Coast of America. Today, Bonhams offers more sales than any of its rivals, through two major salerooms in London: New Bond Street and Knightsbridge; and a further three in the UK regions and Scotland. Sales are also held in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Carmel, New York and Connecticut in the USA; and Germany, France, Monaco, Hong Kong and Australia. Bonhams has a worldwide network of offices and regional representatives in 25 countries offering sales advice and valuation services in 60 specialist areas.

bluejetty:00072891:ios.description:
ACT Test Prep 2026 is an application that has been carefully designed and developed by industry exam experts. With more than 1,600 high-quality test questions and answer explanations, multiple test modes and a scientific analysis system, it helps you practice efficiently anytime, anywhere, making it more likely that you will pass the ACT test on your first try!
ACT Test Prep 2026 now supports the American College Testing (ACT) exam preparation. Our experts will update and revise the content based on the latest exam syllabus provided by the ACT Examination Committee.
ACT Test Prep 2026 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied previous exam content and the latest exam requirements, and have expertly categorized all subjects on the exam so you can practice more specifically for your situation.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 1,600 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for the ACT test can be difficult, but with the help of ACT Test Prep 2026, if you are determined to pass the certification exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so, we are confident that we can help you achieve your goals!
Don't feel confused or frustrated about preparing for the ACT test, effective change takes time and effort, follow in the footsteps of ACT Test Prep 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started right now!
***
Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to gain access to all features, courses and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term of the subscription plan you choose. Subscribers' accounts will be charged an automatic renewal fee 24 hours before the end of the current term.
You can manage your subscription after purchase by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Use: http://www.supertest.vip/Terms-of-Service.html
Privacy Policy: http://www.supertest.vip/Privacy-Policy.html
If you have any questions or suggestions regarding use, please feel free to contact us via email at contact@supertest.vip.
LEGAL NOTICE:
We are NOT affiliated with any testing agency, certificate, test name or any trademark. All Trademarks are the property of respected trademark owners.
DISCLAIMER :
All the features we provide are for your practice or study before the exam only. Your success on these questions or quizzes does NOT necessarily mean that you will pass the certification or that you will perform well on the exam.

bluejetty:00135717:ios.summary: Embark on an adrenaline - fuelled adventure in the icy landscapes of Snow Rider 3D! Brace yourself for the ultimate snowboarding experience as you carve your way down breathtaking mountains, conquer challenging slopes, and pull off jaw-drop
bluejetty:00135717:ios.description:
Embark on an adrenaline - fuelled adventure in the icy landscapes of Snow Rider 3D! Brace yourself for the ultimate snowboarding experience as you carve your way down breathtaking mountains, conquer challenging slopes, and pull off jaw-dropping tricks in this immersive winter sports game.
Key Features:
1. Spectacular 3D Environments:
Immerse yourself in stunning, realistic 3D environments featuring snow-covered mountains, dense forests, and thrilling downhill courses. Experience the beauty of winter landscapes as you ride through meticulously crafted snowscapes.
2. Intuitive Controls:
Master the art of snowboarding with easy-to-learn controls. Tilt your device to steer, tap to jump, and swipe to execute mind-blowing tricks. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned rider, Snow Rider 3D offers a seamless control system that enhances the overall gaming experience.
3. Thrilling Courses:
Conquer a variety of exhilarating courses, each presenting its own set of challenges and obstacles. From steep descents to icy halfpipes, test your skills on diverse terrains that keep the excitement levels high.
5. Customisation and Upgrades:
Personalise your snowboarder with a range of customisation options. Choose from a variety of boards to make your rider stand out on the slopes. Earn in-game currency to unlock snowboards and boost your performance, allowing you to take on even more challenging courses.
Get ready to experience the rush of downhill snowboarding like never before in Snow Rider 3D. Strap in, hit the slopes, and become the king or queen of the mountain!
