Combine the
bluejetty:00015474:ios.description:
Supercharge your productivity with OneNote. Organize thoughts and ideas, and simplify planning important moments with your digital note-taking. Smart notes on your phone can sync across all your devices with Microsoft OneNote.
Combine the power of digital ink with the natural feel of a pen to help you sketch out your inspirations. Take smart notes and capture every detail with voice transcription. Our writing tools make it easy to capture your notes, review your content later, and access AI studying.
Take smart notes, share writing ideas, organize note-taking, and collaborate on your creative ideas and writing - all with Microsoft OneNote.
ONENOTE APP FEATURES: 
AI-POWERED COPILOT NOTEBOOKS
• Make sense of your files with AI chat
• Summarize meetings, classes, and discussions easily from your notes
• Listen to audio overviews, created directly from the notes you take
AI NOTE-TAKING WITH HOMEPAGE AND QUICK CAPTURE
• Streamlined writing: Find notes from your connected accounts in one place to easily create, find, & act on your notes. Now with Samsung Notes integration.
• AI workflows with Copilot: Capture text, voice, ink or images to your notepad with Quick Capture
• Smart notes: Capture smart notes in ink. Click the pen button & write down thoughts
• Write smart notes, draw & clip things from the web to add to your writing notebook
SCAN PICTURES & EXTRACT TEXT FROM WRITING
• Note-Taking Scanner: Scan documents, pictures, or files to extract writing
• Capture images to extract text from documents & more
• Apply different filters to change colors, add ink, crop images & more
SMART NOTES & AUDIO TRANSCRIPTION
• Voice smart notes: Take accurate notes with voice dictation
• Click the Mic button to record, then click it again to end recording & save the file
• Dictate smart notes in 27 languages (note some languages are in preview) & use Auto-Punctutation to format
NOTE-TAKING THAT HELPS YOU ACHIEVE MORE
• Organize writing using to-do lists, follow-up items, marks for what’s important & custom labels
• Use OneNote as a notebook, journal or a notepad for work or AI studying
• Notepad badge hovers on screen & lets you quickly write your thoughts down any time
• NEW Sticky notes - Make quick memos & note-taking
COLLABORATE WRITING & SHARE SMART NOTES
• Write meeting notes, brainstorm projects, & draw attention to important points
• Take notes & save ideas across your favorite devices, no matter what device your team likes to use
BETTER TOGETHER WITH MICROSOFT OFFICE
• OneNote is part of the Office family & works great with your favorite apps, such as Excel or Word, to help you do more
Write notes, save ideas & keep up with your to-do list with Microsoft OneNote.

Workz360 is an app exclusively for the Independent Professional to find opportunities, get connected and manage their work. Inclusive to the following types of independent professionals; all looking to add more freedom to their lives:
 -part-timer - working less than 30 hours per week or supplementing income
 -sole proprietors - owns an unincorporated business by themselves
 -solo entrepreneurs – owns an incorporated business with employees
Our easy-to-use app makes it convenient for independent professionals to pick up on-demand work and create their own schedule. Our network provides opportunities targeted to your specific skillset allowing you to negotiate, request, and accept invitations. The app provides you with a network to connect within the job market where you will be able to view upcoming opportunities and current work postings that you can select on the go! Find long-term or short-term work that fits your lifestyle. You are paid at the completion and approval of the work directly from the app! Be your own boss and take control of your work life balance and earn income on the go.
Workz360 is revolutionizing the way the Independent Professional, Small Business and Enterprise connect. Workz360 provides a complete ecosystem that fosters a business community relationship. Within our network, the independent professional can connect and find support options for business insurance, health insurance, financial planning, retirement benefits, accounting & tax services, legal services, coaching and training, as well as a generous reward program. The more you work, the more you are rewarded, which means higher quality candidates who are more committed to their work. 
Work has never been more flexible, convenient, and available! Our opportunities range from all industries including accounting & finance, administrative support, creative writing & interpretation/translation, customer service, dental, design & creative, engineering & manufacturing, executive consulting, inspectors, IT Field Service, Legal, Logistics, Marketing, Medical, Project Management, Retail and more.
Download the app today! You can learn more about our app’s services and benefits on Workz360.com
You can also contact us at info@workz360.com
Why Workz360?
 -The network & platform are completely free to Independent Professionals—fees are paid by the enterprise that hires you.
 -You set your own rates and timeframe for work to be completed.
 -Independent Professionals are paid instantly once the project is completed and approved.
 -One network for all your skills in one platform, eliminating the need to be on multiple gig platforms.
Workz360 supports Independent Professionals through education, resources including support to successfully building your own independent business including partner companies to provide coaching, insurance, accounting/tax, financial planning and legal services.

bluejetty:00021782:ios.description:
haptik – a silent, beautiful, mesmerising yet simple haptic metronome for your music practice.
WHY HAPTIK?
haptik is for musicians who loves sound-less metronomes. While the beats are delivered through haptic touches, you can focus on your music without the beeping distractions.
AT A GLANCE
• Always-On haptic metronome, even if you turn your arm
• Record your ideas and practice with a single tap
• Connect your band by linking up multiple devices
• Beautiful themes to customise your experience
• Screen and camera flash option on iPhone
• Shazam a song and get its tempo instantly 
FEATURES IN DEPTH
Always-On haptic:
You'll continue to receive the haptic beats, even if your Apple Watch goes on standby or when your arm turns away while playing a musical instrument. 
Link & Play Together:
When you are rehearsing as a group, connect everyone’s devices using haptik-link. It runs on Bluetooth and with our specially designed algorithm, we make sure everyone is on the same “beat”.
Record:
haptik is also your handy recorder when you are practising, or writing your next big music idea. You might not know when the Eureka moment comes, but be well assured the record button is right at your fingertips. Your recordings are synchronized via iCloud on both Apple Watch and iPhone.
Themes:
haptik comes with different beautiful color options, each of them are handpicked for a mesmerising animation experience. We have no words for this, you have to feel this yourself – glaze your finger around the metronome on the iPhone.

bluejetty:00074130:ios.name: VPN Windscribe: Fast & Secure
bluejetty:00074130:ios.summary: Windscribe VPN is a privacy-focused VPN app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, built by Windscribe Limited, an independently owned company founded in 2016 and based in Toronto, Canada. Windscribe encrypts your traffic, replaces your IP add
bluejetty:00074130:ios.description:
Windscribe VPN is a privacy-focused VPN app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, built by Windscribe Limited, an independently owned company founded in 2016 and based in Toronto, Canada. Windscribe encrypts your traffic, replaces your IP address with one from 69+ countries, and unblocks sites and streaming libraries restricted in your region.
WHO WINDSCRIBE IS FOR
 • Travellers who need a home-country IP abroad, or a US IP from anywhere.
 • Anyone using public Wi-Fi in airports, hotels or cafes.
 • Streamers who want Netflix, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, HBO Max, Peacock, Paramount+, ESPN+, Sling TV, BBC iPlayer, DAZN and FuboTV from other countries.
 • Students and staff on restrictive networks, where Stealth and Wstunnel work when standard VPN traffic is blocked.
 • People who want a free VPN with no credit card, no ads and no email required to sign up.
FREE VS PRO
Starter (free): 10 GB of data per month and servers in 10 countries (US, Canada, UK, France, Germany, Netherlands, Switzerland, Norway, Romania and Hong Kong), with AES-256 encryption, kill switch and the full ad and tracker blocker. No credit card. No ads. No email required. P2P and port forwarding are not included. 
Pro (paid): unlimited data, 69+ countries, P2P file sharing without throttling, and port forwarding for game servers and remote device access.
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
 • Protocols: WireGuard, OpenVPN UDP, OpenVPN TCP, IKEv2, Stealth, Wstunnel.
 • Encryption: AES-256 with Perfect Forward Secrecy. Post-quantum encryption on WireGuard protects today's traffic from future decryption.
 • 10 Gbps server ports for 4K streaming, large downloads and low-latency gaming.
 • DNS leak protection and an always-on kill switch that cuts all traffic if the tunnel drops.
 • R.O.B.E.R.T.: a configurable DNS-level blocker for ads, trackers, malware and phishing domains.
 • Speed: TechRadar's April 2026 tests ranked Windscribe the fastest free VPN (1,594 Mbps on WireGuard) and third fastest paid VPN overall (2,263 Mbps).
WHAT WINDSCRIBE STORES
Windscribe does not log your IP address, browsing history, DNS queries, connection timestamps or traffic. It stores three non-identifying data points: date last used, bandwidth used in the last 30 days, and activated app versions.
INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
 • Court-tested: on 11 April 2025 a court in Athens, Greece dismissed criminal charges against Windscribe co-founder Yegor Sak. Windscribe had no user data to hand over; the no-logs policy held as a legal defence.
 • Infrastructure audit: PacketLabs audited the server stack in June 2024, covering 20 repositories and roughly 80,000 lines of code, plus pen testing.
 • Open source: the full iOS app source code is published at github.com/Windscribe/iOS-App.
 • Transparency report: every DMCA and law enforcement request is published in real time.
 • PCMag Editors' Choice, rated 4.5 out of 5, August 2025.
SERVER LOCATIONS (PRO)
Albania, Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Bosnia, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Ecuador, El Salvador, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, Iceland, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malaysia, Mexico, Moldova, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, North Macedonia, Norway, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, UAE, UK, Ukraine, United States, Uruguay, Vietnam.
ONE ACCOUNT, EVERY DEVICE
One account covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, plus Windows, Linux, Android TV & phones, and browsers.
Connect free in under a minute, or go Pro for unlimited data.
WireGuard is a registered trademark of Jason A. Donenfeld.

bluejetty:00032233:ios.description:
Any brings every file you own into one calm, beautiful place: the files on your iPhone and iPad, iCloud Drive, your photos, music and contacts, and the servers and NAS you use at home or at work.
A HOME THAT'S YOURS
Your tools, folders, favourites and the files you opened last, on one page that feels like a notebook. Reorder it, hide what you don't use and pin the tools you love in Edit Home.
FIND ANYTHING
One search for everything. Type a few letters and Any finds files by name, the words inside your documents, tools, settings, Smart Folders and tags, then videos, music, news and pages from the web. Save any search as a Smart Folder. Pull Home down to start.
A PRIVATE AI ASSISTANT
Ask in plain words: "Where is my invoice?", "Move notes.txt into Work", "What did I open yesterday?". The assistant runs on Apple's on-device model, with Private Cloud Compute on supported devices, and works only through Any's own tools. Anything that changes your files shows Run or Don't Run first, and every change can be undone.
EVERY PLACE, ONE APP
• On this iPhone or iPad, iCloud Drive, Photos, your music library and Contacts
• Network servers: WebDAV (Nextcloud, ownCloud, Synology, QNAP), SFTP and FTP/FTPS
• Copy, move and paste between any of them, with transfers that resume
TOOLS FOR REAL WORK
• PDF: sign where you tap, highlight, rotate, remove, extract and merge pages
• Scan documents to searchable PDFs and record audio straight into a folder
• Trim videos, make GIFs, extract audio, remove a photo's location
• Convert images, PDFs and text from the file menu
• Zip and unzip, tags, favourites, file versions and a Trash with Undo
• Storage: see what takes space and clean up spare copies, old downloads and large files
• Wi-Fi Share: open a folder on any computer's browser with a link or QR code
• Nearby Share to send files to devices around you
• A real Terminal with find, grep, zip, du and many more commands, plus SSH to your servers
• A built-in browser that downloads straight into your files
• Vault: an encrypted, passphrase-protected folder with Face ID
VIEW EVERYTHING
Photos and videos, music, PDFs, code and text with an editor, web pages and property lists, each in a viewer made for it. Show any folder as a list, icons, columns or an album.
MADE FOR IPAD AND MAC
Open folders, viewers and tools side by side in as many windows as you like, float one in Slide Over, and use keyboard shortcuts: ⌘K to search, ⇧⌘N for a new folder, ⌘I for info.
ANY PREMIUM
Core file management is free, always. Any Premium removes all ads and keeps the Pro tools: more than one network server, more than 3 Smart Folders, video and photo tools, PDF editing and signing, Convert To and Wi-Fi Share. Every Pro tool is free for your first 15 days, no subscription needed.

listings.name: Any: File Explore & Viewer
listings.description:
Any brings every file you own into one calm, beautiful place: the files on your iPhone and iPad, iCloud Drive, your photos, music and contacts, and the servers and NAS you use at home or at work.

A HOME THAT'S YOURS
Your tools, folders, favourites and the files you opened last, on one page that feels like a notebook. Reorder it, hide what you don't use and pin the tools you love in Edit Home.

FIND ANYTHING
One search for everything. Type a few letters and Any finds files by name, the words inside your documents, tools, settings, Smart Folders and tags, then videos, music, news and pages from the web. Save any search as a Smart Folder. Pull Home down to start.

A PRIVATE AI ASSISTANT
Ask in plain words: "Where is my invoice?", "Move notes.txt into Work", "What did I open yesterday?". The assistant runs on Apple's on-device model, with Private Cloud Compute on supported devices, and works only through Any's own tools. Anything that changes your files shows Run or Don't Run first, and every change can be undone.

EVERY PLACE, ONE APP
• On this iPhone or iPad, iCloud Drive, Photos, your music library and Contacts
• Network servers: WebDAV (Nextcloud, ownCloud, Synology, QNAP), SFTP and FTP/FTPS
• Copy, move and paste between any of them, with transfers that resume

TOOLS FOR REAL WORK
• PDF: sign where you tap, highlight, rotate, remove, extract and merge pages
• Scan documents to searchable PDFs and record audio straight into a folder
• Trim videos, make GIFs, extract audio, remove a photo's location
• Convert images, PDFs and text from the file menu
• Zip and unzip, tags, favourites, file versions and a Trash with Undo
• Storage: see what takes space and clean up spare copies, old downloads and large files
• Wi-Fi Share: open a folder on any computer's browser with a link or QR code
• Nearby Share to send files to devices around you
• A real Terminal with find, grep, zip, du and many more commands, plus SSH to your servers
• A built-in browser that downloads straight into your files
• Vault: an encrypted, passphrase-protected folder with Face ID

VIEW EVERYTHING
Photos and videos, music, PDFs, code and text with an editor, web pages and property lists, each in a viewer made for it. Show any folder as a list, icons, columns or an album.

MADE FOR IPAD AND MAC
Open folders, viewers and tools side by side in as many windows as you like, float one in Slide Over, and use keyboard shortcuts: ⌘K to search, ⇧⌘N for a new folder, ⌘I for info.

ANY PREMIUM
Core file management is free, always. Any Premium removes all ads and keeps the Pro tools: more than one network server, more than 3 Smart Folders, video and photo tools, PDF editing and signing, Convert To and Wi-Fi Share. Every Pro tool is free for your first 15 days, no subscription needed.

bluejetty:00099162:ios.description:
Unscrew Frenzy 3D is an exciting, brain-teasing 3D screw puzzle game. Twist, sort, and dismantle intricate models, enjoying the satisfying feeling of every screw you turn. 
No timers, no pressure – just the pure joy of transforming complex models into neat screws. Step into a stunning 3D world and embark on your stress-free puzzle adventure!
What's Inside:
-Hundreds of Intricate 3D Models
From airplanes to cozy homes, each screw puzzle presents a unique challenge.
-Stunning Visuals & Smooth Animations
Vibrant colors and smooth animations bring every screw, pin, and nut to life.
-Immersive ASMR Click Sounds
The crisp, soothing sounds of every twist help melt away stress while you play.
-Full Control at Your Fingertips
Rotate, zoom, and examine every screw pin jam puzzle from all angles to discover the smartest sorting strategy.
-Collect & Showcase
Unlock exquisite models and build your personal collection while enjoying the satisfaction of mastering unique puzzles.
How to Play:
-Rotate 360° to examine colorful screws, pins, and nuts from all angles.
-Remove screws of the same color and place them into matching boxes.
-Plan the right order – one wrong twist can block your progress!
-Use drills, brooms, and hammers to free stuck bolts.
-Dismantle the entire model step by step to unlock new challenges.
Why You'll Love It:
-Relax Anytime – Perfect for coffee breaks, commutes, or winding down before bed.
-Exercise Your Brain – Challenge logic and strategy in a calming, pressure-free experience.
-Relieve Stress – Satisfying clicks turn chaotic models into organized calm.
-Fun for All Levels – Whether you're new or a seasoned pro, every level is engaging.
Download Unscrew Frenzy 3D now, turning chaotic models into calm – one satisfying twist at a time!

bluejetty:00071396:ios.description:
Would you like to record the carbohydrate intake of your daily meals?
This app is an app that allows you to easily record your carbohydrate intake.
If you fill in the food name and amount of carbohydrates on the home screen and tap it, the carbohydrate intake of the day will be recorded.
If you tap the favorite icon, you will be able to enter the carbohydrate amount immediately from the favorite from the next time.
The "History" screen displays the food name and carbohydrate amount for the date selected in the calendar. You can modify the data by double-tapping the data. You can add data that you forgot to record by clicking the "Add" button.
The Analysis screen shows graphs of your weekly, monthly and yearly carbohydrate intake. It also displays your average daily carbohydrate intake for that period.
On the "Settings" screen, you can set your target carbohydrate intake for the day and the first day of the week on the calendar. You can choose to start Monday or Sunday.
In the free version, you can create up to 10 favorites and check the history for one week. If you want to create unlimited favorites and check the entire history, please consider purchasing the premium version within the app.

bluejetty:00096885:ios.description:
Ever spent more time scrolling through streaming services than actually watching something? Meet us, your personal movie curator who transforms the way you discover films.
Think of this as your movie cookbook. Instead of endless scrolling, you pick your ingredients—genres you're craving, the decade that speaks to you, ratings that matter, streaming services you have, and even the language you prefer.Our app mixes these together and serves up personalized movie recipes tailored exactly to your mood.
Select up to 5 genres that match your vibe tonight. Action and Comedy? Drama and Thriller? The combinations are endless. Add your favorite streaming platforms from over a dozen supported services. Slide through decades from the golden age of cinema to today's blockbusters. Set your minimum rating. Pick your language. Hit Mix Recipe, and watch our app work.
Found a gem? Save it to My Cookbook along with the exact recipe that discovered it. Each saved movie remembers the ingredients you used—the genres, decade, rating, and providers that led you there. It's like keeping notes on your favorite dishes, so you can recreate that perfect movie night experience again or share it with friends.
Not sure what you want? Browse curated collections:
• Tonight Showcase - Fresh picks updated daily
• Hidden Gems - Overlooked masterpieces waiting to be found
• Streaming Hits - What's trending on major platforms
• Family Magic - Beloved favorites and animated adventures
• Sci-Fi Universe - Journey beyond the stars
• Laugh Out Loud - Comedy gold guaranteed
• Edge of Your Seat - Thrillers that grip you tight
Each section is handpicked and regularly refreshed, so there's always something new to discover.
Know what you want? Our search cuts through the noise. Type a title, and get instant results with ratings, runtime, release year, and where to stream it. No ads cluttering your screen, no unnecessary recommendations—just what you asked for.
Found something amazing? Use Cine-Drop to share complete movie recipes with friends nearby. They get the movie plus the exact mix of filters you used to discover it. It's like passing along a secret recipe, except for movies.
We built this for people tired of decision fatigue. No more "I don't know, what do you want to watch?" conversations that eat up your evening. No algorithm trying to keep you scrolling forever. Just smart, fast discovery that respects your time.
If you're exhausted by endless scrolling, frustrated by irrelevant recommendations, or just want a smarter way to find your next favorite. Download now and start mixing.
Your perfect movie night is just one recipe away.

bluejetty:00065842:ios.name: Buttons and Scissors
bluejetty:00065842:ios.summary: Cut off the sewing buttons in the logic game Buttons and Scissors! To cut off the buttons, select two or more buttons of the same color. You can select buttons only on the same horizontal, vertical or diagonal line. Cut off all the buttons
bluejetty:00065842:ios.description:
Cut off the sewing buttons in the logic game Buttons and Scissors! To cut off the buttons, select two or more buttons of the same color. You can select buttons only on the same horizontal, vertical or diagonal line. Cut off all the buttons from the scrap of denim to complete the level. Try to complete each level in the shortest time possible to get a better score.
You cannot cut off a single button, so plan your strategy in advance! Buttons and Scissors is a fun way to improve your logical thinking and train your brain.
Tutorial:
When you begin playing the game for the first time, there will be a tutorial level. You will be presented with a scrap of denim and a number of different colored buttons. Each current move will be displayed as a white arrow. Touch the first button and move your finger to the last button of the same color you wish to select in that line, and then release your finger. All selected buttons will then be cut off with a scissors, if selected correctly.
Main features:
- Realistic sewing buttons and scissors
- 5x5, 5x6, 6x6 and 7x7 levels
- Unlimited Undo
- iCloud support
- Leaderboard
- Solutions for levels
IMPORTANT: No real buttons were cut off in the making of this game!

bluejetty:00014224:ios.name: Rig Finder - GeoActivity
bluejetty:00014224:ios.summary: Find active drilling rigs, locate oil and gas wells, and navigate to wellsites across North Dakota and Western Canada with GeoActivity Rig Finder. Pro adds offline maps and navigation, truck-optimized routing, and offline rig and well searc
bluejetty:00014224:ios.description:
Find active drilling rigs, locate oil and gas wells, and navigate to wellsites across North Dakota and Western Canada with GeoActivity Rig Finder. Pro adds offline maps and navigation, truck-optimized routing, and offline rig and well search.
Built for drilling contractors, operators, engineers, truck drivers, and field crews, Rig Finder brings rig locations, well information, land locations, and drilling activity together in one app. Choose the subscription that fits your work:
ESSENTIALS: FIND RIGS AND FOLLOW DRILLING ACTIVITY
• Search current drilling rig locations and get directions to active drilling sites.
• Find wells and navigate to DLS/NTS and lease locations.
• View well information and operator data.
• Search wells by Well name, lease, operator and/or API.
• Discover nearby licenses and permits, with filtering by operator.
• Review rig activity by spud date and drilling contractor.
• Filter rigs by region or drilling contractor.
• Save favorite rigs and receive notifications when drilling activity begins.
PRO: TAKE YOUR WORK OFFLINE
Pro includes everything in Essentials, plus:
• Offline maps and navigation: Access downloaded maps and navigate when cell service is unavailable.
• Truck-optimized routing: Plan routes for truck travel to rigs and wellsites.
• Offline rig search and filtering: Find and filter downloaded rig data without an internet connection.
• Offline well search and filtering: Search and filter downloaded well data while working beyond cell coverage.
Download the maps and data you need before heading into areas without service. An internet connection is required to download or refresh offline content and receive new rig activity notifications.
COVERAGE
Rig and well data for North Dakota, Alberta, Saskatchewan and British Columbia.
Whether you are checking where a rig is working, reviewing nearby permits, or heading to your next wellsite, Rig Finder helps you prepare for the work ahead.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Rig Finder offers two subscription levels: Essentials and Pro. Available subscription durations and prices are shown in the app before purchase.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.riglocations.ca/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.riglocations.ca/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00034624:ios.name: Easy Words - Word Puzzle Games
bluejetty:00034624:ios.summary:
Easy Words is a fun and addictive word game to train your brain. Make words with letters to get as many points as you can! Take a break and show off your logic skills while competing with opponents for a higher score!
Take turns to compose
bluejetty:00034624:ios.description:
Easy Words is a fun and addictive word game to train your brain. Make words with letters to get as many points as you can! Take a break and show off your logic skills while competing with opponents for a higher score!
Take turns to compose words with the letters from the deck. Each letter has its own points. The main goal of the word game is to reach the highest score by making words on the board with your letters.
The rules of Easy Words are quite simple:
- The game is played on a 13x13 board.
- You and your opponent receive 7 tiles with letters on them from a tile bag. You have to connect letters in different ways and place the tiles on the board to make a word.
- Words can be formed either horizontally or vertically.
- The player who starts the word game should place a word containing at least two letters onto the board with at least one tile placed in the central square.
- There are 44 bonus cells on the board. They allow you to multiply the points you receive either for a letter or the whole word if a tile with a letter is placed on one of them.
- The game is over when either player uses the last tile, or both of them skip two moves in a row, or if either player has no possible moves left.
- The user with the higher score at the end of the game wins.
Easy Words features:
- Word definition. The built-in dictionary provides the definition of all the words added onto the board. This is an excellent opportunity to enrich your vocabulary!
- Hints. If you are stuck solving word puzzles, simply use a hint.
- Swap. If you have run out of ideas and don’t know what you can create with the tiles you have, just swap the tiles in your deck.
- Shuffle. Get a fresh perspective on your letters to form a new word!
Solve your first word puzzle in Easy Words and dive into the immersive game experience! Accept the challenge, make as many words as you can and train your brain!

bluejetty:00148754:ios.description:
Discover, Diagnose, and Care for Your Plants in a Snap.
• Identify Plants Instantly
Snap a photo and get the species name, a confidence score, and fascinating details in seconds. Flowers, leaves, shrubs, trees, herbs, vines, grasses and more.
• Your Digital Garden
Say yes to "Would you like me to take care of this plant with you?" and your plant joins your Digital Garden with a name and a life story from day one. Every plant gets a card showing its photo, health score, and last watered date — your whole collection at a glance.
• Plant Doctor: Diagnose & Cure
Photograph an ailing leaf and get a probability-weighted diagnosis — 70% root rot, 20% overwatering, 10% nutrient deficiency — with a plain-language confidence rating so you always know how sure we are. Then follow a day-by-day treatment plan and check off each step as your plant recovers.
• Chat with Your AI BOTanist
Open a chat from inside any plant's profile and just ask. Your AI BOTanist already knows that plant's photo history, watering log, past diagnoses, and local weather — no re-explaining. Ask the same question twice and it digs deeper instead of repeating itself. Available 24/7.
• Smart Care Schedules
SnapPlant builds a watering and fertilizing cadence from each plant's species and your home environment, then reminds you when it's due. Tap "Mark as done" and it logs straight to that plant's history.
• Weather-Aware Advice
When your local weather shifts sharply, SnapPlant tells you what to change: "45°C this week — your Snake Plant needs less water." Alerts arrive only when your routine actually needs to change, never as daily noise.

bluejetty:00127387:ios.description:
This app is the ultimate lottery app that is all you need to keep tabs on Florida lottery games right from your phone. Scanning physical lottery numbers along with being up to date with updated results haven’t been so much easier before. Check past results any time and save your lottery numbers for future uses.
All within an easy-going, non-eye-hurting, intuitive and clean user Interface.
The latest jackpot winning numbers are loaded with history (Past results) for each game, prize levels/payouts (Ways to Win) and you can also scan physical ticket information for games. The scanning and detection of lottery information albeit works correctly, the user has full independence in reviewing and modifying the numbers before checking results against or storing away in phone storage.
Currently supporting :
- Mega Millions
- Powerball
- Florida Lotto
- Cash4Life, 
- Fantasy5
- Lucky Money
- Pick 2
- Pick 3
- Pick 4
- Pick 5
Why should you download our app :
- SCAN physical tickets and check scanned lottery.
- View PAST RESULTS for the selected lottery.
- Zero fees or commissions.
- YOU collect 100 percent of your winnings!
- Check RESULT against scanned number without storing it!
- Fully REVIEW & modify scanned lottery before you STORE or check result.
- Revisit stored lottery after scanning and reviewing.
- Hands-on INSTRUCTIONS to use the app effectively.
It’s so much fun to dream of what you’d do if you won the lottery, and we want to make the experience of mundane tasks like checking, scanning and storing away lottery information just as fun. We’ve got a lot of other intuitive features in store for you to explore, but if you need help, have a question, or want to suggest a feature, please create a Support Ticket from the app or contact us at info@infancyit.com
This is an ad-supported app. You can buy premium features to mold your experience of the app.
Premium Features:
- Remove Ads forever
- Subscribe to Scan & automatically result matching and notifying feature (Monthly / Half-Yearly / Yearly Auto-renewable)
By downloading and using the app, you are indicating that you have read the privacy policy and agree to the Terms of Service posted at [privacy_link](https://uls.infancyapp.com/ios/florida/privacy.html) and [terms_link](https://uls.infancyapp.com/ios/florida/terms.html) respectively.

bluejetty:00152357:ios.description:
Point Out is a clever directional puzzle where every move matters, designed for fans of brain and mind challenges. Your goal is simple: guide the right arrow through the maze and reach freedom in this smart escape experience.
Rotate arrows, shift tiles, and plan ahead using pure logic and spatial thinking. Smooth flow and responsive tap controls make every decision feel precise and satisfying.
With gradually increasing difficulty and thousands of handcrafted levels, Point Out stands among the best games for iq improvement, training, and problem solving. Each level works like a compact teaser, pushing you to think ahead and adapt.
When a level gets tricky, helpful boosters are there to support you:
Use Zoom to closely inspect complex paths, Hint to reveal a helpful move, Magic Wand to break through difficult situations, Rubber to erase mistakes, and Grid Scale to adjust the board for better visibility and planning.
Game Features
• Direction-based logic puzzles with evolving mechanics
• Relaxing yet challenging brain training games experience
• Thoughtful escape puzzle and shape escape level design
• Offline-friendly play with no wifi games for free
• Precision controls, helpful boosters, and a comfortable dark mode for extended play
Point Out blends brain games, mind games, and smart interaction into a polished experience that rewards patience and clever thinking.
Can you find the way out — or will your arrows go in circles?

bluejetty:00026265:ios.summary: Cube Match Master: 3D Puzzle is a fun and relaxing tile-matching game where you match 3D cubes to solve puzzles and earn rewards. Designed to refresh your mind and provide hours of entertainment, this triple tile puzzle game combines challe
bluejetty:00026265:ios.description:
Cube Match Master: 3D Puzzle is a fun and relaxing tile-matching game where you match 3D cubes to solve puzzles and earn rewards. Designed to refresh your mind and provide hours of entertainment, this triple tile puzzle game combines challenge with relaxation, perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages!
Why Play Cube Match Master?
Match in 3D: Rotate the giant 3D cube in any direction to find and match three identical tiles. Clear the field by matching triplets of colorful objects, animals, toys, food, and more!
This unique 3D mechanic adds a layer of depth and immersion rarely seen in traditional match-3 games.
Unique 3D Tiles: Discover a variety of beautifully designed 3D tiles that add excitement to every level. Each tile collection includes unique objects, making every puzzle fresh and fun.
From cupcakes to animals, every level introduces a new visual theme to keep the gameplay experience dynamic.
Boosters: Struggling with a tough level? Use powerful boosters to clear tiles faster and earn bonus rewards. Strategic use of boosters will help you complete even the most challenging levels.
Boosters are your best friend when it comes to tackling the trickiest combinations — don’t forget to use them wisely!
Relaxing Gameplay: Cube Match Master offers a calm, zen-like experience. Relax, reduce daily tension, and train your brain by solving puzzle after puzzle. It’s the perfect way to unwind!
Whether you’re taking a quick break or settling in for a longer session, the game adapts to your playstyle.
Key Features:
Stunning 3D Visuals: Enjoy vibrant graphics and animations that bring the 3D cube puzzles to life. The game’s polished visuals and smooth controls make it easy to dive in and start matching.
The soothing color palette and elegant design make Cube Match Master both easy on the eyes and deeply engaging.
Addictive Puzzle Mechanics: Rotate the 3D cube, match tiles, and clear the board in this engaging and challenging game. The further you go, the more complex the puzzles become!
Challenge yourself to beat your own best time or find clever combos for maximum efficiency.
Daily Rewards: Log in every day to claim free coins and rewards. Daily challenges will keep you coming back for more.
Keep your streak going and unlock exclusive bonuses that increase as you play.
Play Offline: No Wi-Fi? No problem! Play Cube Match Master anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection.
Perfect for commuting, traveling, or simply enjoying your puzzle time without interruptions.
How to Play:
Rotate the 3D Cube: Use your fingers to rotate the giant 3D cube and examine all angles for matching tiles.
Every turn reveals new tile possibilities — explore all sides before making your move.
Match Identical Tiles: Find and match three identical tiles to remove them from the cube.
Each completed match brings you closer to a perfectly cleared board.
Use Boosters: Activate special boosters to speed up your progress through tough levels.
Combine smart strategy with quick thinking to breeze through even the most complex puzzles.
Clear the Board: Keep matching until all tiles are cleared and you’ve solved the puzzle!
Each board cleared gives a great sense of satisfaction and progress.
Become the Cube Master: Keep matching and challenging yourself to master each level.
Climb through hundreds of levels that grow in complexity and challenge your logic.
Cube Match Master: 3D Puzzle is not just a game—it’s an experience that helps you relax, improve your memory, and sharpen your attention. With its beautiful 3D visuals and relaxing atmosphere, this game offers a refreshing twist on traditional tile matching puzzles.
Whether you’re a casual player or a puzzle enthusiast, Cube Match Master will become your go-to for engaging 3D matching fun.
Ready to take on the challenge? Download Cube Match Master: 3D Puzzle today and immerse yourself in the world of 3D tile matching fun!

SetupVPN takes the hard part out of staying private online. Choose a country, tap once, and your connection is encrypted: on café Wi-Fi, on campus or at the office. The websites you visit see the server's IP address, not yours.
Why people choose SetupVPN
- Simple by design: no settings to learn, one tap to connect and one to stop.

Getting started takes a minute: create your free account in the app and connect.
Use the same SetupVPN account on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows and in the SetupVPN browser extensions.

◆ WARNING ◆
STOCKSPY IS A RESEARCH TOOL. IT IS NOT INTENDED FOR PERFORMING TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OR TRACKING PORTFOLIO VALUE. PLEASE READ THE FULL DESCRIPTION BEFORE BUYING! - The last thing we want to do is trick you into buying something you aren’t actually looking for. That said we think the vast majority of investors will benefit from using StockSpy! 
Now more than ever you need to be on top of what is happening with your investments...
StockSpy for iPhone simplifies tracking stock market news for the companies you follow and allows you to VISUALIZE how the news affects stock prices with NewsCharts!
With StockSpy you can automatically load several top quality RSS news feeds for each of the symbols you're tracking. This provides you with more complete information when making your important investment decisions. Stop losing money because you're not getting all the important news & information about your stocks. Say goodbye to wasting time by manually checking several news websites and still not getting the whole picture on your stocks. Start making more money because you have the information to make smart trades.
NewsChart technology shows you how the news volume changes over time when in landscape mode. As you flick through the news articles the NewsChart highlights the currently active bar for the visible news items in the news list. This means if you find a day which had interesting price change (like a big pop or drop) you can easily find out what news was "driving" the stock. We have taken this great innovation we call NewsCharts from Stock Spy for the desktop (available on PC + Mac! See more details at Stock-Spy.com) and brought it to the iPhone!
StockSpy provides easy access to information from the top Investor websites with Symbol Specific website links. This allows you to browse detailed information about specific stocks having to type a symbol.
StockSpy allows complete customization of news sources. Our innovative feed template system allows you to setup a news feed once and use it for every symbol in your list. You can also add individual feeds to a specific stock. StockSpy uses the extremely popular RSS feed standard. Many popular financial news websites provide RSS news feeds free of charge. Blogs, investor relations sites even the SEC provide RSS feeds which can accessed using StockSpy! ... If you have never heard of RSS news feeds before don't worry. You will still be able to make use of them using StockSpy.
With recent volatility in the global financial markets access to timely investment information is a necessity. With StockSpy on the iPhone this information is at your fingertips.

Stay tuned, because we're always developing new and exciting features for StockSpy. Updates are ALWAYS free!

We LOVE positive feedback! Please be kind in your app reviews, tell others how you use StockSpy.

Remember to mail support@stock-spy.com or use the "App Support" button on this page if for some reason you need help with StockSpy! We are happy to assist.
► Go ahead!
Get your copy of StockSpy today. You won't regret it!

bluejetty:00165755:ios.description:
Chippy Tools is the must-have calculator for carpenters and handy folks looking to simplify math on the job. Whether you're on your iPhone or iPad, Chippy Tools is for you. Its user-friendly design lets you focus on carpentry while the app handles the math.
Perfect for architects, builders, carpenters, construction workers, contractors, designers, engineers, tradespeople, and woodworkers of all kinds, Chippy Tools speeds up common calculations with precision. Save time and cut costs by reducing site errors.
WHAT IS A CHIPPY?
In Australia, carpenters are often called Chippy.
WHY CHIPPY TOOLS?
Our mission at Chippy Tools is to redefine top-notch apps for carpenters. We aim to develop a sustainable business model, adding new calculations to keep saving you time and money.
FEATURES
• Baluster spacing calculator - Quickly calculate spacing for flat runs.
• Flat run attached baluster calculator - Simple, fast calculations for attached balusters.
• Supports millimeters, feet, and inches.
PREMIUM FEATURES (Requires Subscription)
• Square calculator - Ensure structures are perfectly square.
• Concrete calculator - Calculate concrete needed for slabs and posts.
• Dumpy level calculator - Find relative level from benchmarks.
• Equal spacing calculator - Calculate even spacing effortlessly.
• Gravel calculator - Determine gravel volume needed.
• Pitch calculator - Calculate pitch with rise and run.
• Raked wall calculator - Measure raked walls using height or pitch.
• Running calculations - Enter start number and interval.
• Soil calculator - Find soil volume for landscaping.
• Stair calculator - Calculate going, stringer, and rise for stairs.
• Triangle calculator - Solve triangle measurements with ease.
FEEDBACK
Want a new calculator? Email us at feedback@chippy.tools.
NO ADS EVER
We promise no ads in Chippy Tools. Enjoy the best experience for your purchase.
SUPPORT
Got questions or feedback? Contact us for free tech support at support@chippy.tools.
If Chippy Tools aids you, please leave an App Store review to help others find it.
Subscription Terms of Service: https://chippy.tools/terms/
Proudly made in Brisbane, Australia.

Welcome to CookieRun: Witch’s Castle, a tap-to-blast puzzle adventure full of fun, mystery, and Cookies!

Help GingerBrave escape the Witch’s Castle by solving fun and challenging puzzles. Match and blast colorful blocks to unlock rooms, collect treasures, and decorate your castle. Plus, enjoy exciting mini-games for extra rewards and surprises!

Features:
■ Puzzle gameplay: Tap, blast, and match to clear levels.
■ Powerful boosters: Unlock special boosters to clear obstacles and help solve puzzles.
■ Charming Cookies: Team up with GingerBrave and other lovable Cookie characters.
■ Castle Decoration: Unlock rooms and decorate your castle with cozy designs.
■ Mini-games: Play exciting mini-games to earn extra rewards!
■ Offline play: Take your adventure anywhere, no Wi-Fi needed.
■ Engaging storyline: Discover the secrets hidden within the Witch’s Castle.
■ Special events: Participate in time-limited events for exclusive rewards.

Download CookieRun: Witch’s Castle now and enjoy puzzle fun and rewards!

bluejetty:00179405:ios.description:
Met deze app heb je Studio Brussel altijd op zak. Zo kan je snel, betrouwbaar, eenvoudig en in hoge kwaliteit jouw favoriete Studio Brussel-programma’s en digitale streams beluisteren, waar en wanneer je maar wil.

Voor onze podcasts kan je voortaan terecht in onze VRT MAX app.

bluejetty:00182520:ios.description:
Whether you are at home, in the office, or on-the-go, dashboards, tickets, notifications and powerful analytics make it effortless to monitor and optimize experiences in real time.
Use the Qualtrics XM app to:
1. Monitor important experience metrics (e.g. NPS, CSAT, Employee Engagement) with role based dashboards and filtering
2. Reassign, respond, and close the loop on support tickets
3. Receive real-time notifications so you can act before it’s too late
4. View open ended customer responses and activate team members by sharing key insights via text, email, apps, and more
5. Explore powerful analytics like key drivers, trending topics, focus areas, experience journeys, and text analytics to drive impact
The XM mobile app is included in your Customer Experience (CX) or Employee Experience (EX) license. After you download the app, please enter your Qualtrics login and password to get started. Then share the good news with a few of your teammates so you can win XM together!
About Qualtrics:
Qualtrics, the leader in customer experience and creator of the Experience Management (XM) category, is changing the way organizations manage and improve the four core experiences of business––customer, employee, product, and brand. The Qualtrics XM Platform™ is a system of action that helps over 12,000 businesses around the world close experience gaps.
Have questions?
If you are a Qualtrics customer please contact your Customer Success Manager. If you are not a Qualtrics customer but would like to learn more, please request a demo on this page: https://www.qualtrics.com/platform/mobile/

bluejetty:00140475:ios.description:
Makeup Organizer 3D is an engaging and satisfying organizing game that lets you sort and categorize makeup in a virtual world, unlocking your inner organizing skills. With a relaxing ASMR experience, you can enjoy the pleasure of turning clutter into order in a 3D environment. Whether you’re placing lipsticks, foundations, or organizing eyeshadow palettes, each level is filled with challenges and fun.
In this game, you’ll experience the joy of neatly arranging makeup products, just like organizing a closet or stocking a fridge. Drag and drop beauty items into the makeup box to complete each level’s challenge. Whether you're looking to relieve stress or improve your organizing skills, this game has something for everyone.
Key Features:
Challenging levels that test your organizing and sorting skills.
Soothing ASMR effects for an ultimate relaxation experience.
3D visuals that bring the joy of organizing to life in a virtual space.
Simple drag-and-drop mechanics, perfect for players of all ages.
Refresh your virtual vanity by organizing makeup products.
Ready for the challenge? Download Makeup Organizer 3D now and enjoy the fun of organizing makeup while becoming the ultimate organizing master!

bluejetty:00187504:ios.description:
Get secure anytime, anywhere access to your computers from your iPad or iPhone.
LogMeIn Pro & Central gives LogMeIn Pro and Central subscribers remote access to PCs and Macs over Wi-Fi or mobile data. 
Note: to use this free app you must first have a LogMeIn subscription on the computer(s) you want to access. 
****************
How to use:
1. Install the app
2. Go to the PC or Mac you want to access and install the LogMeIn software.
3. Launch the app from your iPhone or iPad to access your computer
For detailed step-by-step instructions, please read the LogMeIn Getting Started Guide. 
With LogMeIn Pro & Central you can:
• Access your home and work computers on the go
• Control your Mac or PC as if you’re sitting right in front of it
• Get to your computer files and edit them from your iPad/iPhone
• Remotely run any application on your computer from your iPad/iPhone
Features include: 
• Mouse and screen settings – choose your preferred method of remote control with scroll mode
• Magnifying glass and zoom slider – zoom by mouse, slide or with your fingers
• Quick access to your files with File Manager – save files directly to your iPhone or iPad so you can work on them offline, or move and copy files between devices.
• Change display color, resolution and network speed to maximize remote control performance. 
• HD video and sound – watch videos located on your computer in HD and sound stream remotely
• Photo App Management – easily access and transfer photos
• Attach any number of files, including photos and emails
• Multi-monitor view – shake your device or three-finger swipe to switch between monitors
****************
We love your feedback!
X/Twitter: @GoTo

bluejetty:00073666:ios.description:
Invoice Fly is the easiest way to create and send professional invoices to your clients. It’s perfect for small businesses, freelancers and contractors. Whether you need to create and invoice or estimate, Invoice Fly is the #1 invoice app for the job.
Keep your finances organized with Invoice Fly, where you can easily create, send and track invoices on your phone.
You will be able to configure as many details as you need, adding payment information, taxes, withholding, due dates, extra images, discount, signature and more. Also, you will be notified when the customer receives and opens your invoice.
Features:
-Create invoices in less than a minute, anywhere you are.
-Generate invoices from estimates with a tap.
-Choose from different invoice templates and customize them.
-Attach images and additional notes.
-Discounts per item or total.
-Taxes per item or total.
-Add signature.
-Share or print invoices on the go.
-Quickly setup clients from your phone contact list.
-Sync all your devices with the same account.
-Track your incomes with easy to use reports.
-Get notified when the client receives and opens your invoice.
-24/7 support
Creating and sending an invoice has never been so easy:
Step 1: Tap create invoice
Step 2: Select your client to bill, easily from your contacts
Step 3: Add the desired items and prices
Step 4: You are ready to go, save and send.

bluejetty:00025285:ios.name: Airborne Attack
bluejetty:00025285:ios.summary: Prepare to take command of an advanced air defense system in Airborne Attack, the ultimate mobile game for adrenaline-seeking players! Engage in intense battles as you defend against relentless aerial attacks and experience the thrill of co
bluejetty:00025285:ios.description:
Prepare to take command of an advanced air defense system in Airborne Attack, the ultimate mobile game for adrenaline-seeking players! Engage in intense battles as you defend against relentless aerial attacks and experience the thrill of controlling a powerful Close-In Weapon System (CIWS) to protect your base from enemy threats. 
Key Features:
1. Master the Art of Air Defense: Become an expert in air defense tactics as you take control of a cutting-edge CIWS. Track, target, and engage enemy aircraft with precision and lightning-fast reflexes. Protect your base and repel wave after wave of enemy attacks.
2. Realistic CIWS Simulation: Experience the authentic feel of operating a CIWS through realistic controls and immersive graphics. Marvel at the intricate details of the weapon system and feel the power of its rapid-fire Gatling gun as you engage multiple targets simultaneously.
3. Challenging Missions: Put your air defense skills to the test with a variety of challenging missions. Take part in intense campaigns, defend strategic locations, and thwart enemy offensives. Adapt your strategy to changing scenarios and unlock new missions as you progress.
4. Upgrade and Customize: Enhance your CIWS and base defenses with upgrades and customization options. Unlock new weapon systems, improve firing speed, increase accuracy, and strengthen your base's resilience against enemy attacks. Customize your CIWS appearance with various skins and decals.
5. Multiplayer Battles: Team up with friends or compete against players from around the world in thrilling multiplayer battles. Join forces to protect each other's bases or engage in fierce PvP battles to prove your air defense supremacy. Earn rewards and climb the global leaderboards.
6. Strategic Decision-Making: Analyze incoming threats, prioritize targets, and make split-second decisions to maximize your defense capabilities. Manage your resources efficiently and deploy defensive strategies to outsmart enemy tactics. Every decision can mean the difference between victory and defeat.
7. Stunning Visuals and Sound: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world with high-quality graphics and dynamic effects. From the explosive destruction of enemy aircraft to the whirring of the CIWS Gatling gun, every moment is brought to life with captivating sound design.
Ready to defend your base from airborne threats? Download Airborne Attack now and embark on a thrilling air defense journey that will put your skills to the ultimate test!

bluejetty:00186130:ios.name: TI-Nspire™ CAS
bluejetty:00186130:ios.summary: Texas Instruments, the No. 1 recommended brand of graphing calculators in the U.S., has optimized its most powerful Computer Algebra System (CAS) math engine for an all-in-one iPad app that makes teaching and learning math more engaging, me
bluejetty:00186130:ios.description:
Texas Instruments, the No. 1 recommended brand of graphing calculators in the U.S., has optimized its most powerful Computer Algebra System (CAS) math engine for an all-in-one iPad app that makes teaching and learning math more engaging, meaningful and … fun! 
ONE CAS APP. ALL THE MATH. 
Open the door to math mastery with the first-in-class iPad CAS app that delivers comprehensive graphing, data entry and analysis, statistical modeling and calculating functionality. 
Solve equations with algebraic precision, factor and expand variable expressions, complete the square, find antiderivatives, compute limits, find exact solutions in irrational form and more. 
Make math more meaningful by importing images from the iPad camera or photo library and overlaying graphs and equations on them to illustrate abstract math principles in the real world.* 
Visualize crucial connections by observing how equations change — in real time, on one screen — when you touch, grab and interact with shapes, graphs and objects on the screen. 
Graph functions, inequalities, implicit functions, conic sections, scatter plots, statistical plots and regression models, 3D graphs, parametric, polar and differential equations. 
Enter equations in proper math notation so math symbols and formulas on the screen are identical to those in text books and on the board. 
Deepen understanding by exploring hundreds of free activities for Pre-Algebra, Algebra, Geometry, Calculus, Statistics, Pre-Calculus and more from the online Math Nspired resource center. 
Create and store work on your iPad, and share it using your Email or Dropbox account. 
A COMPLETE LEARNING RESOURCE 
TI Education Technology is committed to success in mathematics by providing advanced learning tools that have been designed in collaboration with leading educators and researchers. 
TI provides world-class professional development for teachers, as well as free activities and curriculum content. 
For additional information about the TI-Nspire CAS App for iPad, please visit our website. 
The TI-Nspire CAS App for iPad does not support external and third party keyboards.
* TI-Nspire CAS App for iPad supports .jpg, jpeg, .bmp and .png image formats. 
iPad is a registered trademark of Apple Inc.

bluejetty:00166643:ios.description:
Join 2,500,000+ others exploring the immersive world of Awakening. The #1 national award-winning* Legends of Learning math game for kids. Learn math & science skills while battling and collecting Beasties by answering math or science questions.
From the team that brought you Legends of Learning, the educational game for kids used by over 100,000 teachers across the US, comes Awakening, the educational game for kids to extend learning beyond the classroom.
Math and Science made fun! Be unique & creative, style an avatar with an infinite number of clothing & accessory combinations. Learn new dance moves to impress your friends. Customize a home to live in with items collected from the Town. Get access to 2,000+ fun mini math or science games in the Arcade, updated weekly. Play against your friends or meet new friends.
What Kids Are Saying
"This app is super fun and you can learn at the same time! If you don't like learning but you love your phone this game is literally for you."
"...Try out Legends of Learning it’s an RPG game and you have to learn your math in order to play..."
"This is so good I can't stop playing it and it makes me smarter in science."
"Amazing app, everything is top notch and honestly almost perfect. With the multi-platforms, battles, shopping, it ties in just the right amount of learning but still fun."
Inside The Game
- Explore and learn in the immersive world of Awakening while leveling up math/science skills:
- Town - meet people, buy items to upgrade your avatar/house and battle Beasties
- Arcade - access 2,000+ fun learning games to have fun and earn coins
- Your House - be creative with interior design! Build your home with dozens of custom room and layout options.
- The Wilds - *upgrade* to an Adventure Pass for exclusive access to this uncharted territory
- Exclusive Unlocks - *upgrade* to an Adventure Pass to unlock exclusive Beastie Evolutions
- Awakening School -*upgrade* to an Adventure Pass for exclusive access to learning puzzles
- Battle and collect Beasties to level up math/science skills with challenging questions
- Be creative and look fantastic! Create a unique avatar style with a huge selection of clothing/accessories. Learn different dance moves to impress your friends.
- Be part of the community! Invite friends to play against each other or together
For Parents
- Curriculum-based math/science in a single learning app for kids, powered by original research conducted with Vanderbilt University
- Extend learning outside the classroom that grows with your child, math or science for kids grades 1-8 
- Safe for your kids. No personal data collection and no free-form conversations with other players
- Play from anywhere - offline, computer, tablet or mobile phone
- Sign up for free parent portal access to track your child's progress over time. 
- Free to play, buy an adventure pass for special access to additional content, lands, additional outfits, monthly boxes with Beasties or coins.

Access expanded lands, learn even more:
+ The Wilds - a new land to explore
+ Awakening School - learn with your friends
+ New Beastie Evolutions - power up your squad
Unlock all 2,000+ learning games in the Arcade
Exclusive items: Flamewhelp Beastie & knight/princess outfits
Plus - get a 10,000-coin bonus for signing up

bluejetty:00098318:ios.description:
Kitchen Crisis! The customers are eagerly waiting for their sushi and the waiters are starting to sweat with anxiety! Use your nimble fingers and precise judgment to deliver the sushi to their plates!
Tap the sushi and move it to the correct position for the waiter to serve it! The sushi color and quantity needed by the waiter are displayed on the plates, quickly fulfill their needs! With each correct sushi delivery, the waiter will happily accept the plate, completing the task.
Tips:
1. Space for serving is limited, so learn to plan placement wisely to avoid filling it up!
2. Prioritize the nearest orders to clear tasks more quickly.
3. Got troubles? Make good use of tools! “Remove” and “Move” can help you pass levels effortlessly~
Key Features:
Super Fun: Vibrant and cute sushi designs will boost your appetite and mood!
Brain Twister: It requires hand-eye coordination and tests your logical planning, stimulating your brain while you relax.
Stress Relief: Paired with fresh and lively background music, fulfilling sushi orders is pure joy!
Rich Content: As you pass levels, more waiters and tools await your challenge, adding layers of fun!
Can you save the kitchen from the crisis? Use your skills and wisdom to satisfy everyone and keep the sushi restaurant bustling with customers!

bluejetty:00157210:ios.description:
Play as a soul traveling from body to body through the cycle of life, experiencing everything life has to offer while trying to break the cycle and reach Nirvana.
This **choice-based AI game** features hundreds of life situations, strategic decisions, dark humor, and replayable story paths. With **AI-generated content**, the game reduces repeated cards and introduces more dynamic, varied, and unexpected events across your journey.
- Super Hero
- Assassin
- Super Star
- Gangsta
- Wizard
- Rockemon Master
Balance your core needs throughout life:
- Money
- Health
- Popularity
- Happiness
Every year brings a new choice, and every choice can change your future. With expanded **AI-generated content**, the game can deliver more variety, fewer repeated cards, and more surprising life events.
You may:
- Make friends
- Get married
- Have children
- Choose your "Rockemon"
- Break out of jail
- Unlock unique story paths
- Discover strange and hilarious outcomes
Be careful: every decision matters. If one of your life bars reaches the top or bottom, you die. But death is not the end. You will return in a new body, with another chance to gain experience, unlock new paths, and move closer to Nirvana.
Can you defeat The Creator and finally break the cycle of life? And when a lost soul offers you a way out, will you trust her?
**How to Play**
- Drag each card slowly to the left or right to reveal your choices
- Release the card on the option you want to select
- Watch how each choice affects your life bars
- Stay balanced to survive longer
- Unlock achievements to discover new lives, stories, perks, and endings
Try to reach old age, uncover hidden events, meet death himself, and explore new ways to live and die in this replayable narrative adventure.
Play this beta version now for free.
Stay tuned for updates and new content:
Web - https://www.goldtusksstudio.com 
YouTube - https://www.youtube.com/@goldtusksstudios 
Discord - discord.gg/aNMENAVYHj
Be advised: If you have any mental health conditions, this game may cause you to overthink your own life, so please play with caution.

bluejetty:00039128:ios.description:
Open a Cashback debit card with free service in Raiffeisen Online. Using Raiffeisen Online mobile app, you can manage your accounts and cards, make secure payments and money transfers, exchange currency, open new products, control expenses and get direct online consultation with Bank employees. 
This is a whole bank branch in your pocket, ready to solve your daily tasks. Simple. Convenient. 24/7. Download and manage your personal finance wherever and whenever you want. 
Main screen
• balances of your products
• personalized customization
• favorite transaction templates
• managed list of accounts and cards: adding and hiding of products
• quick access to transactions history, forms of payments and transfers, chat, app settings
Payments and transfers
• transfers by phone number to Raiffeisen Bank customers and participants of the Quick Payment System (Alfa-Bank, Tinkoff, VTB, and many others)
• free transfers to Raiffeisen Bank cards from cards of other banks
• quick transfers between your accounts, within the Bank, and to other banks
• convenient card-to-card transfers to any Russian bank
• free-of-charge payments for various services (mobile, Internet, TV) 
Products management
• online opening of new accounts, debit cards and insurance programs
• ordering documents and certificates 
• favorable exchange rates for transfers between your accounts
• card PIN code change in case of loss or theft 
Payments of utilities, tax arrears, traffic and parking fines
• commission-free payments of fines, tax debts, and housing services by Personal Account Number (ELS)
• easy payment of accruals
• searching for tax arrears by INN (TIN)
• subscription to notifications about new bills and accruals 
Extra features
• templates for transfers — you don’t have to fill up details again
• automatic payments
• QR code scanning for automatically filling up the transfer details
• access to online banking for the additional cardholders
Information Services
• online chat with Bank employees
• searching of nearest branches and ATMs
• history of incoming SMS and push notifications
• individual offers from the Bank, special offers and discounts from our partners
• Expenses Accounting Service service for analyzing your spending 
Be successful with Raiffeisen Online without borders. All you need is the internet.

bluejetty:00187552:ios.description:
Invoice with ease using Invoice2go from BILL. Quickly create & send professional invoices for small businesses, consultants, contractors & freelancers in minutes.
Invoice and accept payments with ease using Invoice2go. Set up Invoice2go Money to easily keep track of your payments and expenses in one central place. Small business owners in over 160 countries trust Invoice2go to send professional invoices and estimates to clients.
Whether you need to create an invoice or quote, business receipt for your side gig, or small business, Invoice2go is the #1 free invoice app for the job.
Create estimates for your clients so they’ll know what to expect. When the job is done, convert estimates into invoices with a tap and send them out. Track invoices to keep up with every payment.
Create great-looking, professional invoices, and estimates, and get paid faster using one simple app. Accept all the ways your clients want to pay online. Capture your expenses as you incur them.
Invoice2go is the on-the-go invoicing tool for all types of small businesses, freelancers, and contractors, from dog walkers to web designers to musicians.
All of your information is automatically synced and available on your iPhone, iPad, and computer.
Invoice2go has been the #1 invoice app for 10+ years and counting. Here’s why people choose Invoice2go:
BUSINESS INVOICES
- Invoice maker with 8 professional invoice templates optimized for easy use.
- Add a logo for your business. Upload your own or create one using our custom logo designer.
- Match your brand. Sync the color of your logo to your invoice.
EASY INVOICES & ESTIMATES
- Create and send an invoice in under 1 minute.
- Make invoices without any training. If you can send an email, you can use Invoice2go.
- Review your edits before you send an estimate or invoice.
- iOS Widgets: Instantly see all outstanding payments from your home screen
- Siri Shortcuts: Ask Siri to create invoices and estimates or to view reports
ESTIMATE CREATOR
- Create an estimate template for your project.
- Share estimates with your client and save it for invoicing.
- Convert an estimate into an invoice in seconds.
FAST BILLING
- Send invoices on the spot. Improve your turnaround time and save yourself the paperwork.
- Accept payments instantly. Add the payments feature so clients can pay your invoices using American Express, Visa, Mastercard, Discover, Paypal, and Apple Pay.
- Never miss a thing. Keep an eye on overdue invoices and send automatic payment reminders.
SMALL BUSINESS ACCOUNTING
- Easily track your expenses. Simply snap a photo of your receipt to safely store and claim business expenses.
- Save for next time. Add expenses directly to your invoice and save recurring expenses for future use.
- No more overflowing shoeboxes. Organize all of your expenses and print expense reports with one tap.
STAY ORGANIZED
- Know what happens to your invoice after you hit “send.”
- See when customers have viewed your invoices and who still needs to make a payment.
- Schedule appointments and organize your day.
- Keep track of your receipts and time on the job so you can bill accurately.
- Run reports and get all the information you need in one statement. Just select a client and we’ll take care of the rest.
- The home screen showcases your most critical business insights, making it easier to make faster, informed decisions
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
A subscription is required to use Invoice2go, and there’s three plans you can choose from. When you sign up, you’ll get the first 30 days free.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless turned off in Account Settings at least 24 hours before end of current period. Payment is charged to your iTunes account. Unused portion of free trial is forfeited after purchase.
Read more about our terms and conditions here - https://invoice.2go.com/tosInline/
Read more about our privacy policy here - https://invoice.2go.com/privacyInline/

bluejetty:00102855:android.summary:
You can use the Midttrafik app to purchase single trip tickets, multiride tickets, transit tickets and youth cards for Midttrafik buses, Letbanen and the Lemvigbanen. 
Single trip tickets and multiride tickets purchased on the app cannot b
bluejetty:00102855:android.description:
You can use the Midttrafik app to purchase single trip tickets, multiride tickets, transit tickets and youth cards for Midttrafik buses, Letbanen and the Lemvigbanen. 
Single trip tickets and multiride tickets purchased on the app cannot be used on Arriva or DSB trains. 
Transit tickets and youth cards purchased on the app can be used for Midttrafik's buses, Letbanen, Lemvigbanen as well as Arriva's and DSB's trains.
You can purchase:
Multiride tickets
Single trip tickets
Transit tickets
Youth cards
Special tickets (for example, tickets to Djurs Sommerland)
You need to create an account and decide how to pay before you can use the Midtttrafik app.
You can pay using MobilePay or connect a payment card (Dankort, Visa, Visa/Dankort, Mastercard, Maestro, Visa Electron, American Express) to your account.
If your phone’s language settings are set to English, the Midttrafik app will use an English user interface. You can alsp switch the language in the settings menu.
Remember:
• Purchase your mobile ticket before you start your journey and before boarding.
• Make sure you have an internet connection to purchase your ticket, although you don’t need an internet connection to show your ticket.
• Make sure your phone has enough power for the whole journey so that you can present your ticket at the ticket control.
• Your phone must be intact so that the ticket is readable on the screen at the ticket control.
• Single trip tickets and multiride tickets purchased on the Midttrafik app are only valid within the Midttrafik region for journeys on Midttrafik buses or the Lemvigbanen.
• Single trip tickets and multiride tickets purchased on the Midttrafik app are not valid for journeys on Arriva or DSB trains.
• Transit tickets and youth cards purchased on the app can be used for Midttrafik's buses, Letbanen, Lemvigbanen as well as Arriva's and DSB's trains.
Contact Midttrafik Customer Services on +45 70 210 230 if you have any questions. Alternatively, you can find more information at www.midttrafik.dk.

Single trip tickets and multiride tickets purchased on the app cannot be used on Arriva or DSB trains. 
 
Transit tickets and youth cards purchased on the app can be used for Midttrafik's buses, Letbanen, Lemvigbanen as well as Arriva's and DSB's trains.
 
You can purchase:
 
Multiride tickets
Single trip tickets
Transit tickets
Youth cards
Special tickets (for example, tickets to Djurs Sommerland)
 
You need to create an account and decide how to pay before you can use the Midtttrafik app.
 
You can pay using MobilePay or connect a payment card (Dankort, Visa, Visa/Dankort, Mastercard, Maestro, Visa Electron, American Express) to your account.
 
If your phone’s language settings are set to English, the Midttrafik app will use an English user interface. You can alsp switch the language in the settings menu.
 
Remember:
 
• Purchase your mobile ticket before you start your journey and before boarding.
• Make sure you have an internet connection to purchase your ticket, although you don’t need an internet connection to show your ticket.
• Make sure your phone has enough power for the whole journey so that you can present your ticket at the ticket control.
• Your phone must be intact so that the ticket is readable on the screen at the ticket control.
• Single trip tickets and multiride tickets purchased on the Midttrafik app are only valid within the Midttrafik region for journeys on Midttrafik buses or the Lemvigbanen.
• Single trip tickets and multiride tickets purchased on the Midttrafik app are not valid for journeys on Arriva or DSB trains.
• Transit tickets and youth cards purchased on the app can be used for Midttrafik's buses, Letbanen, Lemvigbanen as well as Arriva's and DSB's trains.
 
Contact Midttrafik Customer Services on +45 70 210 230 if you have any questions. Alternatively, you can find more information at www.midttrafik.dk.

bluejetty:00038665:ios.summary:
DSLoad Station is the ultimate mobile client for managing your Synology Download Station. Take full control of your downloads with a secure, private, and feature-rich interface for DSM 6.0 and DSM 7.0+.
SECURE & PRIVATE CONNECTION
• End-to
bluejetty:00038665:ios.description:
DSLoad Station is the ultimate mobile client for managing your Synology Download Station. Take full control of your downloads with a secure, private, and feature-rich interface for DSM 6.0 and DSM 7.0+.
SECURE & PRIVATE CONNECTION
• End-to-end encryption for your credentials
• Your data never leaves your device and your NAS
• No tracking, no ads, complete privacy guaranteed
• Connect seamlessly on your local network or remotely via QuickConnect
• Full support for SSL/TLS encryption & two-factor authentication (2FA)
POWERFUL DOWNLOAD MANAGEMENT
• Full control over your tasks: start, pause, resume, delete, and clear
• Add tasks from URLs, files, or directly from your browser with the share sheet
• Advanced filtering to sort and find your downloads easily
• Get real-time updates with background notifications
• Select specific files within a task before downloading
ADVANCED NAS FEATURES
• Browse your DiskStation folders to choose where downloads go
• Monitor your NAS storage, VPN status, and system health
• Integrated RSS feed manager to automate your downloads
• Powerful search to find new content with your Download Station search modules
• Manage multiple Synology NAS servers from one app
SEAMLESS iOS INTEGRATION
• Home & Lock Screen Widgets: Keep an eye on your tasks, storage, and VPN status.
• Live Activities: Track your active downloads on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Face ID & Touch ID: Secure your app and your saved connections.
• Dark Mode: A beautiful interface that’s easy on the eyes.
• Siri & Shortcuts: Automate your download workflow.
EASY TO USE
• Quick setup in minutes — no technical knowledge required
• Intuitive and modern interface designed for iOS
• Manage your favorite servers and accounts with ease
• In-app browser for easy navigation and task creation
Whether you’re at home or on the go, DSLoad Station provides the most complete and secure way to manage your Synology Download Station.
Made by the Synology community for Synology users.
Need help? Have a suggestion or feature request? Email me at contact@dsload.app!
---
Some features require DSLoad Station Pro: yearly subscription or lifetime purchase. Free trial available. Family Sharing included.
DSLoad Station is not affiliated with Synology Inc.
Terms of use: https://dsload.app/resources/terms.html
