bluejetty:00044703:ios.description:
Get convenient support from the Peach State Health Plan app by Sharecare. Created for Medicaid members, this app has all the tools you need. These tools will help you manage your health and benefits with ease. With personal support, you can navigate the healthcare system. You’ll find it easier to understand, access, and use your insurance. You’ll find healthcare programs, services, and resources available to you.
Key features:
• Find providers and services nearby: Use "Near Me" navigation to find care. Locate healthcare providers, services, and pharmacies. Never struggle to find the care you need. 
• SNAP balance: Check your available balance within the app. Watch your Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) activity. Know your benefits to manage your food resources.
• 24/7 chat: Get instant answers you need. Chat to ask about your benefits, for medical advice, and more.
• Exclusive benefits and rewards: Get special offers and rewards just for you. Use these to improve your wellness. 
• RealAge test: Discover your body's true age with Sharecare’s RealAge® test. This quiz ranks your health behaviors and provides personal insights. Use the information and advice you learn to live a healthier, longer life.
• Factual content: Follow health topics important to you. You’ll find useful knowledge from Sharecare’s health and wellness experts that you can trust. Learn from medically reviewed content through videos, articles, and more.
• Health and well-being programs: Achieve your health goals. Join one of many programs aimed at helping you. Whether you want to manage your weight, quit tobacco, or reduce stress, we can help. Our programs offer the support and resources you need to succeed.
• And more: Explore extra features designed for your health and well-being. The Peach State Health Plan app gets new tools often. More support and resources are added to meet your needs.
Why choose Peach State Health Plan by Sharecare?
• Easy access: Find your health and benefit information all in one place. Get all your Medicaid resources and benefits in one-stop.
• Personalized experience: Each user has a unique health profile. Receive customized insights and support based on your needs.
• User-friendly design: Navigate the app with ease. Sharecare’s interface makes it simple.
• Secure and private: The highest security standards pro

Colorful 360 degree scenery, animation, and 3D visual effects will make your adventure vivid and fun. Those with a competitive streak can collect bonuses for speed and repeat the quest with new puzzles.

We'll be happy to stay in touch with you at www.facebook.com/CrispApp - make comments, ask questions, get news about coming games!

Fast. Funny. Addictive. Shortn helps you scroll away boredom in 30 seconds or less. Whether you're into pranks, weird moments, memes, or unexpected internet brilliance, Shortn learns what you like and delivers it.
And now, your scroll has a location. With the Map, you can explore what’s trending nearby like viral videos, fresh memes and real moments from people around you. The feed? Always spot-on. The vibe? Just right:
- That video that made you spit out your coffee
- Is she eating soap?
- The cat that accidentally started a trend
- The 6-second prank you immediately shared
- There's no pressure to perform. No polished aesthetics. Just good mood, scrolls, and the occasional “what did I just watch?”

- Personalized feed that knows what hits
- Fresh videos daily (new chaos, always)
- Filters, sounds & effects to post clips and start trends
- Custom profile that’s all you
- Instant sharing to wherever you hang out
Map it. Scroll it. Laugh at it. 
Download Shortn now & regret nothing. 
Need help? We gotchu at support@shortn.video.

bluejetty:00026359:ios.description:
Discover new perspectives and connect through conversation on Threads. 
See what people are talking about right now—from niche interests to big moments. With communities, you can find people who also care about your interests on Threads. Reply, listen, share or just follow along. 
Here’s what you can do on Threads:
■ Start a thread, share your take
Have something on your mind? Take it to Threads. Share a thought, ask a question or open up a conversation. There’s more than one way to kick things off with text, images, polls, ghost posts and more.
■ Jump into replies
Jump into the discussion, react to new ideas or just see where the conversation goes. Every thread is an invitation to join in.
■ Keep up with what’s trending
From live scores to breaking moments, Threads helps you stay close to what’s happening —and join the conversation when you’ve got something to say.
■ Control the content you see
Control who can reply to you, mention you or see your posts. Use Hidden Words to filter out posts and replies that include words or phrases you don’t want to see—so your experience stays on your terms.
■ Go deep on your interests
Follow friends, creators and communities for every interest. Threads is built to help you discover new voices and join conversations—starting with the communities you care about most.
■ Connect over chat
Keep the conversation going privately with 1:1 and group DMs. When a public thread gets more personal, move it to your inbox to go deeper or share it with a smaller group.

bluejetty:00064799:ios.description:
+++ Approve orders securely and conveniently +++
The photoTAN app allows you to approve your orders, such as transfers in online and mobile banking. To do this, the photoTAN security procedure must be activated by scanning a graphic in the activation letter.
+++ photoTAN and photoTAN push +++
Once a photoTAN procedure is active, you have 2 options for approving an order:
photoTAN – simply scan a graphic and enter the generated TAN (transaction number) in the order. This confirms the order and approves it. 
For added convenience, we recommend photoTAN push – once you have checked the data, confirm the order directly in the app. 
+++ Security +++
The photoTAN app is protected by a PIN of your choice or by biometric data.
+++ Note on activating photoTAN +++
Since 25 August 2025, it is no longer possible to set up a new photoTAN security procedure. Active photoTAN procedures can continue to be used. Our BestSign security procedure will replace photoTAN. BestSign is set up directly in the Deutsche Bank app. This means that your banking and security procedure will be available in one app in the future.
Learn more
https://www.deutsche-bank.de/pk/konto-und-karte/bankgeschaefte-erledigen/phototan.html

Natrium is a fast, robust & secure wallet for the NANO cryptocurrency. Natrium has been thoroughly audited by Red4Sec, a security firm with extensive experience in cryptocurrency and blockchain projects.
Features:
- Create a new NANO wallet or import an existing one.
- Secure pin and biometric authentication
- Send NANO instantly to anyone, anywhere in the world.
- Manage contacts in an intuitive easy-to-use address book
- Receive real-time notifications when you receive NANO
- Add and manage multiple NANO accounts
- Load NANO from a paper wallet or a seed.
- Share your personal account address with a personalized QR card.
- Personalize your experience with numerous themes.
- Change your wallet representative.
- View your account's entire transaction history.
- Support for over 20 different languages
- Support for over 30 different currency conversions.
IMPORTANT:
Remember to backup your wallet seed and store it in a safe place. It is the only way to recover your funds if you sign out of the wallet or lose your device! If someone else gets your seed, they will be able to control your funds!
Natrium is open source and available on GitHub.

Odyssey is the ultimate gym log and workout tracker that ranks your strength across 400+ exercises. Track progress, build custom plans, and climb the leaderboards with friends. Transform your training and join a fitness community that thrives on progress, motivation, and competition.
[FREE TO USE]
Odyssey is free to download and use for unlimited workout logging, custom plans, and gym tracking. While an optional Pro subscription is available for advanced analytics, the core logging experience is available to all users at no cost.

Designed for Every Gym-Goer
Whether you’re just starting your fitness journey or chasing new PRs, Odyssey adapts to your training style.
 Accessible & Minimalist: A clean interface with a Greek-inspired aesthetic.

bluejetty:00061132:ios.summary: ABBYY FineReader PDF - the first smart AI-powered scanner that turns your mobile device into an all-purpose tool to quickly capture docs and books, create electronic copies in PDF and JPEG, and extract texts from scans for further editing a
bluejetty:00061132:ios.description:
ABBYY FineReader PDF - the first smart AI-powered scanner that turns your mobile device into an all-purpose tool to quickly capture docs and books, create electronic copies in PDF and JPEG, and extract texts from scans for further editing and sharing. 
FineReader PDF - the top mobile scanner for iPhone or iPad from ABBYY, a Digital Intelligence company. 
*** Ranked #1 Business application in 98 countries *** 
*** Winner of SUPERSTAR Award in the "Document Capture" category in the Mobile Star Awards *** 
Use FineReader PDF to scan paper documents, books, agreements, receipts, magazine articles, notes, recipes, charts, tables, slides, whiteboards, or even billboards on the street and get perfect digital copies. 
KEY FEATURES 
• PDF & JPEG. Scan any text and save scans to JPEG images or cross-platform PDF documents.
• OFFLINE OCR. Quickly extract text from scans into TXT format on your device without an internet connection. 
• ONLINE OCR. Recognize text (OCR) on scans in 183 languages (including Latin, Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean alphabets) and choose from among 4 output formats. 
• SHARE & EXPORT. Send results by email, to FineReader PDF for Windows, save in cloud storages - iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, Yandex.Disk, Evernote, OneDrive for Business, and more.
• LIVE TEXT. Make phone calls, send emails, follow the links, and more from scanned docs.
• ABBYY NEURAL NETWORK. The smart gallery will automatically classify documents into 7 types: A4, books, business cards, handwritten, IDs, other docs, and receipts. 
• SEARCH TEXT ON PHOTOS. Type the text from a photo into a Search field in the gallery. FineReader PDF will find photos that have this text. 
• AR RULER. Define doc size in AR. It will be useful for non-standard documents and further printing them out in proper proportions. 
• SIRI SHORTCUTS. Open scans with Siri and set the flow of actions with scans using Shortcuts app. 
• ANNOTATE SCANS. Discover a set of easy-to-use tools to modify your PDFs: add your signature or a text box, use a highlighter, write with a pen, or conceal content with the redaction tool. 
• 3D TOUCH & SPOTLIGHT SEARCH SUPPORT. 
• PASSWORD ON PDF. Add a password for the image-only PDF files while exporting and sending via email. 
• MULTIPAGE DOCS. Create, edit, and enhance separate images or large multi-page documents without any additional selection on the viewfinder. 
• AUTO-CAPTURE AND FILTERS. Excellent visual quality with auto-capture of page boundaries and advanced image filters, which process scans in color, greyscale, or black-and-white versions. 
• BUILT-IN FILE STORAGE. Save scans inside the app with tags and search capabilities. 
• Transfer docs to your Mac or PC using Home Sharing. 
• AIRPRINT. Print out scans directly from your iPhone or iPad.

Introducing Match Paradise 3D - the ultimate puzzle matching game that will challenge your brain and keep you entertained for hours! With beautifully designed 3D levels and fun challenges, this game is perfect for anyone who loves to sort and match tiles.
Your mission is simple - tap on three identical tiles and connect them into triples. Keep sorting and matching objects until you clear all tiles from the screen. But be quick, as each level has a timer, and you must move fast to win more stars!
But don't worry, Match Paradise 3D is a relaxing and fun tile matching game that you can play anywhere, anytime. Whether you're on a long car ride or waiting for an appointment, this game is the perfect way to pass the time.
And if you ever get stuck, just use one of the amazing boosters to help you sort through the objects and pass tricky levels. You can even use the Shuffle feature to rearrange the items on the board and uncover hidden objects!
Match Paradise 3D is not just a fun puzzle game, it's also a great brain trainer. Improve your sorting skills to become a matching master and enjoy unique gameplay that will keep you busy for hours. Best of all, it's free to play.
So what are you waiting for? Tap to play and discover the addictive puzzle matching game that everyone is talking about. Fans of mahjong and solitaire games will love Match Paradise 3D, and you'll experience endless excitement and fun as you search for hidden objects and complete brain training missions.

bluejetty:00183061:ios.name: Call For Fire
bluejetty:00183061:ios.summary:
Call For Fire puts you in an observation post with a radio, a map and a laser range finder. Find the target, send the call for fire, watch the rounds land, correct them, and fire for effect.
This is not an arcade shooter. It is a training
bluejetty:00183061:ios.description:
Call For Fire puts you in an observation post with a radio, a map and a laser range finder. Find the target, send the call for fire, watch the rounds land, correct them, and fire for effect.
This is not an arcade shooter. It is a training simulation built by soldiers for soldiers, based on US JFIRE doctrine, and it follows the real sequence and radio procedure of a fire mission.
NEW IN 2.0
• Call it in by voice (beta, English). Hold to talk, speak the fire mission, and the fire direction centre reads it back. Speech is recognised on your phone, with no connection needed after a one-time download.
• Open terrain and endless missions. Random fire missions across wide, rolling ground, with the guns up to 15 km away.
• Shells and fuzes that behave differently. High explosive, ICM, white phosphorus and smoke, with quick, VT, time and delay fuzes. See the difference between a ground burst and an airburst.
• Advanced fire missions. Target size and attitude, sheaf, danger close, high angle, at my command, request splash and time of flight, check firing.
• Realistic dispersion. Rounds scatter along the gun-target line as they do from a real battery, and the pattern grows with range.
• Mission builder. Choose the range, gun position, sheaf and trajectory, then share the mission code with your section.
• A redesigned interface, and an after-action review that shows every impact.
WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
• Correct radio procedure for every stage of the call for fire
• Grid and polar missions
• How to spot a round and adjust onto the observer-target line
• How to bracket a target and when to fire for effect
• How to send a battle damage assessment
TWO WAYS TO TRAIN
• All Arms Call For Fire: 20 missions that take you from your first grid mission to moving targets and danger close.
• Observer Fire Missions: the advanced track, with random and custom missions, your choice of ammunition, and the full message to observer.
THIS APP IS FOR YOU IF
• You are a soldier who wants to sharpen your call for fire.
• You are an instructor or commander who needs a tool to teach it.
• You are in training and want an edge before the range.
• You want to understand how artillery is really called onto a target.
Available in English and Spanish. Voice entry is in beta and English only.

bluejetty:00130642:ios.description:
In the neon-soaked streets of Arclight City, the balance of power is threatened by secret corporations and dangerous underworld figures. The sprawling metropolis is hanging by a thread. It all depends on you and your gang to restore order...or seize control for yourselves.
But let's be real, we just want to dominate the city and crush our rivals!
This is the cyberpunk MMORPG adventure you've always dreamed of. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, build your gang, customize crazy cyber-gear, and rise to power! Super easy and intuitive controls, smooth gameplay, and immersive rogue-like elements make this the best MMORPG you will find on mobile.
Features:
- Unique Mercenaries: Each with special abilities to master.
- Unlimited Weapons & Gear: Collect, craft, and upgrade an endless array of items to create the ultimate loadout. Make each piece of gear truly unique!
- Procedurally Generated Dungeons: Dive into thrilling, ever-changing dungeons! Navigate layouts filled with hidden secrets, valuable treasures, and unexpected threats. Make meaningful choices during dynamic encounters—succeed to earn rewards or face consequences if you fail. Collect hundreds of unique lore notes to uncover the mysteries of Arclight City. Every dungeon brings new traps, puzzles, and enemies, making each adventure unpredictable and exciting. 
- Turn-Based Combat: Strategize and take turns to defeat your enemies with tactical precision.
- Anime & Pixel Art Style: Enjoy a unique blend of anime-inspired visuals and detailed pixel art, making Arclight City stand out with its distinct aesthetic.
- Idle & Background Tasks: Progress while you're away! Keep advancing even when the app is closed.
- Auto farm: Leave the app open and your character will slowly gather experience and items over time.
Download Arclight City today and dive into the neon-drenched world of power, mystery, and adventure. The fate of Arclight City is in your hands!

bluejetty:00099970:ios.description:
Screw Out Factory is the ultimate screw puzzle experience, a 3D color brain game where every screw, every move, and every puzzle matters. If you love puzzle games, if you enjoy unscrewing tricky challenges, and if you want to prove yourself as the screw master, this is the game for you.
From the very beginning, Screw Out Factory throws you into a screwdom world filled with screws, blocks, and puzzles that must be solved. The challenge is simple to learn but hard to master. Remove the screws, solve the color puzzles, and unlock every 3D level. The more you play, the more satisfying it becomes. Screw Out Factory is designed as a brain game, a screw puzzle, and a color puzzle all in one.
Why Screw Out Factory is the best screw puzzle brain game:
- It combines the action of unscrewing with the logic of puzzle solving.
- It offers hundreds of screw puzzles with 3D visuals and satisfying mechanics.
- It mixes color puzzle design with screw master strategy.
- It creates endless screwdom challenges that keep players engaged.
- It is a true brain game that tests logic, patience, and problem solving.
Core Features of Screw Out Factory:
- 3D Screw Puzzle Gameplay: Unscrew bolts, collect parts, and solve color puzzles in realistic 3D.
- Color Puzzle Challenges: Match colors, unlock hidden parts, and master screwdom levels.
- Brain Training: Improve focus, logic, and patience with screw puzzles that grow harder.
- Screw Master Levels: From simple screwdom puzzles to master-level challenges.
- Smooth Gameplay: Easy to pick up, addictive to play, and rewarding to master.
How to Play Screw Out Factory:
- Look at the screw puzzle carefully.
- Decide which screw to remove first.
- Unscrew in the correct order to unlock the puzzle.
- Solve the color blocks and complete the stage.
- Progress through screwdom levels to become the screw master.
Why players love Screw Out Factory
Players love the addictive mix of screw puzzles and color challenges. The 3D screw gameplay feels real and satisfying. Each puzzle solved feels like a victory. Screw Out Factory is not just a casual game—it’s a brain game that makes you think, plan, and improve. Every screw you remove, every puzzle you complete, brings you closer to being the screw master.
Highlights of Screw Out Factory:
- Free to play screw puzzle brain game.
- Regular updates with new screwdom challenges.
- Perfect for fans of screw puzzle, color puzzle, 3D puzzle, and brain games.
Screw Out Factory is more than just a screw puzzle. It is a complete screwdom world where screws, bolts, and puzzles are waiting for you. It is a 3D brain game that combines color, logic, and strategy. It is a test of patience and skill that only true screw masters can conquer.
In Screw Out Factory you will:
- Unscrew hundreds of bolts and screws.
- Solve screw puzzles that mix color and logic.
- Collect pieces and unlock 3D puzzle stages.
- Master screwdom levels step by step.
- Train your brain with every puzzle.
If you are searching for screw puzzle games, color puzzle challenges, or 3D brain games, then Screw Out Factory is the perfect match. It offers screwdom levels that keep getting harder, screw puzzles that keep your brain sharp, and satisfying collect mechanics that make you want to play again and again.
Download Screw Out Factory today and join players around the world who are becoming screw masters. Solve every screw puzzle, conquer every screwdom challenge, and prove your skills in the most addictive 3D screw puzzle brain game on mobile.

bluejetty:00072884:ios.description:
54D ON is a digital personalized training platform that brings together exercise, nutrition, and wellness in one place.
Unlike other apps, you never train alone. Every user is supported by a real coach who guides you, motivates you, and provides daily personalized follow-up. Your coach designs a 360° plan tailored to your level, goals, and lifestyle.
Train anytime, anywhere, with access to dozens of On-Demand programs and live workouts including strength, cardio, mobility, Pilates, yoga, and wellness. You also receive nutrition plans and tools designed to support your energy, focus, and consistency.
Everything is built to adapt to you, your pace, and your life.
Train when you want, where you want.
When you join the 54D ON family, you’re never training alone.
Note regarding Apple Health:
The app integrates with Apple Health to show your daily activity - distance, steps, active energy, and flights to help you better achieve your goals.
App also uses Apple Health to track energy burned and heart rate during a workout session, if an Apple Watch is used.
Workout metrics are shared with the coach to better design your workout schedule.
DISCLAIMER:
Users should seek a doctor’s advice before using this app and making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00018520:ios.description:
Have you ever worried about money? You are not alone. 
Download YNAB, get good at money, and never worry about money again.
“We started YNAB January 1st with $37 saved and ended the year with $42,000. Plus we paid $14,000 cash for a new roof.”
-Kyle, YNAB user since 2020
Start your free 30-day trial and stop feeling like you’re bad at money. 
“YNAB has removed the stress of money from my life and in doing so has helped make me a better husband. It's like I got to remove a personal flaw I had never been able to fix." 
-Kyle, again. We didn’t even pay him to say this, but maybe we should.
Why YNAB?
-92% of YNAB users report feeling less stressed about money since starting.
-The average user saves $600 in the first month, and $6,000 in the first year.
“A year of YNAB costs less than a massage and is a heck of a lot better for reducing stress.”
-Kat, YNAB user since 2016
Benefits and Features
STOP ARGUING ABOUT MONEY
…and start planning your life, together
-Create and share unlimited plans with up to six people with one subscription
-Real time updates between devices make it easy to keep everyone informed
-Cheaper than couples counseling
STOP DROWNING IN DEBT
…and start seeing progress with your paydown
-Make a plan to pay down debt by calculating time and interest saved with the Loan Planner
-Avoid new credit card debt with YNAB’s clever built-in spending categorization feature
STOP FEELING DISORGANIZED
…and start feeling totally in control 
-Securely link financial accounts to automatically import transactions
-Easily add transactions manually, if you prefer
-Ask Siri to update your plan or provide expense category balances on the go
START REACHING MORE GOALS
…and stop thinking your future is limited 
-Keep your priorities and goals in focus
-Visualize progress as you go
-Watch your net worth climb
START SPENDING CONFIDENTLY
…and stop feeling guilt, doubt, and regret
-Calculate your “Cost to Be Me” 
-Make a flexible, proactive spending plan
-Always know how much you have to spend
START FEELING SUPPORTED
…and stop feeling like you’re alone in this
-Talk to our “freakishly nice” award-winning support team (don’t tell them we called them freakish)
-Become part of our community of genuine, amazingly supportive people who get it
-Attend one of our live events to learn, share, play, and grow with like-minded getting-good-at-money people
The first step of never worrying about money again is starting a free 30-day trial. Are you ready to get good at money? 
(You seem ready! And we already really like you, so please join us.) 
Free for 30 Days, then Monthly/Annual Subscriptions Available
Subscription Details
-YNAB is a one-year auto-renewable subscription, billed monthly or annually.
-Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
-Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
-Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
-Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00071571:ios.description:
A moody, surreal, and immersive coloring experience
Step into Dark Color: Paint by Number, a creative coloring app designed for users who enjoy expressive art, atmospheric visuals, and deeper aesthetics beyond cute or cartoon styles. With moody tones, surreal imagination, and detailed illustrations, Dark Color offers a calm yet engaging way to relax, focus, and explore creativity through paint-by-number coloring. Whether you color to unwind, concentrate, or simply enjoy unique artwork, Dark Color provides a balanced experience where imagination meets relaxation.
What Makes Dark Color Different
Dark Color reimagines classic paint by number with a more artistic and immersive approach.
• A large and growing collection of expressive illustrations with rich mood and detail
• Clear, well-balanced designs that are satisfying and easy to color
• Simple tap-to-color gameplay designed for focus and flow
• Offline coloring available anytime, anywhere
• Regular updates bringing new artwork and visual inspiration
Every illustration is carefully designed to feel engaging without being overwhelming, making each coloring session smooth, enjoyable, and calming.
Explore Expressive & Surreal Themes
Discover a collection of imaginative and atmospheric artwork, including mysterious characters, surreal creatures, and expressive figures inspired by creativity and storytelling. Explore quiet forests, old houses, abstract spaces, and evocative landscapes designed to feel immersive and calming. Elegant symbolic forms and thoughtfully composed scenes invite slow, focused coloring and creative flow.
Each illustration is carefully balanced with clear structure and visual comfort, making it ideal for users who enjoy expressive, artistic coloring without visual stress.
Artistic Styles with Depth and Personality
Dark Color features illustrations inspired by alternative aesthetics, surreal art, fantasy imagination, and stylized design.
You’ll find artwork influenced by tattoo-style illustration, symbolic imagery, abstract forms, and expressive character design.
The collection focuses on mood, creativity, and atmosphere, offering visuals that feel bold yet approachable, artistic yet calming.
All designs are suitable for a 13+ audience, with no explicit or disturbing content.
Designed for Relaxation and Focus
Coloring in Dark Color is designed to help you slow down and enjoy the moment.
Following the numbered guide allows your mind to focus on color, rhythm, and completion. Watching each illustration gradually come to life can feel satisfying, calming, and rewarding.
There are no timers, no pressure, and no scores—just color at your own pace.
Features for Effortless Coloring
• Simple tap-to-color controls
• Smooth zoom in and zoom out for precise coloring
• Auto-fill tools to speed up larger areas
• Dark mode for comfortable nighttime coloring
• Easy sharing to save or show your finished artwork
Everything is designed to feel intuitive, stable, and comfortable for long or short coloring sessions.
Why Users Enjoy Dark Color
• A relaxing experience with a moody, artistic aesthetic
• Encourages focus, flow, and creative engagement
• Perfect for fans of surreal, fantasy, and expressive art
• Suitable for teens and adults seeking calm creativity
Dark Color is more than a coloring app—it’s a creative space to unwind and explore imagination through art.
Start Coloring Today
Download Dark Color: Paint by Number and explore a world of mood, imagination, and artistic expression.
Relax, focus, and enjoy immersive coloring—one number at a time.
Contact & Policies
Feedback: paintcolor.feedback@gmail.com
Terms of Service: http://launchertheme.com/paint_tos.html
Privacy Policy: http://launchertheme.com/paint_color_pp.html

bluejetty:00166221:ios.description:
Watch everything you love on the biggest screen in your home.
Turn your iPhone into a powerful casting and screen mirroring hub. Instantly stream videos, photos, music, web pages, and presentations to Chromecast, Smart TVs, Roku, Fire TV, and other supported devices.
Enjoy a smooth, fast, and reliable big-screen experience designed for everyday entertainment, sharing, and productivity.
Whether you want to watch movies, mirror your screen, stream YouTube videos, browse websites, play music, or present content, everything is just one tap away.
KEY FEATURES
• Screen Mirroring
Mirror your iPhone or iPad screen to your TV in real time. Ideal for movies, gaming, fitness, meetings, and presentations.
• Cast to TV (Chromecast & Smart TV)
Stream videos, photos, and media directly to Chromecast, Smart TVs, Roku, Fire TV..
• Web Video Casting
Browse websites inside the app and instantly cast supported online videos to your TV.
• YouTube Casting
Stream YouTube videos on the big screen with smooth playback controls.
• Photo & Video Sharing
Display your photos, albums, and videos on your TV in high quality.
• Music Streaming
Play music and audio files from your iPhone to your TV or connected devices.
• TV Remote Control
Control supported smart TVs and streaming devices directly from your iPhone.
• Sketchboard / Drawing Cast
Draw, write, and instantly project your sketches to the TV screen.
• Full Playback Controls
Play, pause, seek, rewind, fast-forward, and control volume easily.
WHY USERS LOVE THIS APP
• Fast and easy connection setup
• High-quality streaming and mirroring
• Simple and intuitive interface
• All-in-one casting solution
• Reliable wireless performance
• Works with multiple devices
SUPPORTED DEVICES
Chromecast, Google TV, Roku, Fire TV, Smart TVs, DLNA receivers, and other compatible streaming devices.
HOW IT WORKS?
Connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network.
Select your device from the list.
Choose Screen Mirroring, Web Cast, Photos, Videos, Music, YouTube, or Remote.
Start enjoying your content on the big screen instantly.

bluejetty:00126350:ios.description:
Easily catalog your collection of CDs and vinyl records. Just scan barcodes or search our CLZ Core online music database by artist/title or catalog number. Automatic album details, song lists and cover art.
CLZ Music is a paid subscription app, costing US $1.99 per month or US $19.99 per year.
Use the free 7-day trial to try all of the app's features and online services!
== 3 easy ways to catalog your CDs and vinyl records: ==
1. Scan their barcodes with the built-in camera scanner. Guaranteed 95% success rate.
2. Search by artist and title
3. Search by catalog number (great for finding Discogs entries)
The app will automatically provide full album details, tracks lists and cover art, either from the CLZ Core online CD database or the Discogs CD/vinyl database.
== Edit all fields ==
Edit all automatically provided details from CLZ Core, like artist, title, label, release dates, genres, track lists, etc.. you can even upload your own cover art (front and back!). Add personal details like condition, location, purchase date / price / store, notes, etc.. 
Create your own Custom Fields so that you can catalog information for which the app does not have a built-in data field.

A Safe & Engaging Educational App for Infants, Toddlers & Preschoolers

bluejetty:00061993:ios.description:
A Safe & Engaging Educational App for Infants, Toddlers & Preschoolers
Discover a world of wonder and learning with First, an award‑winning educational app powered by the trusted BabyFirst TV brand and created by First Media. Designed for children at every early developmental stage, First delivers a dynamic, interactive, and safe learning experience for:
• Infants (1‑2 Years): Introduce your little one to bright visuals, soothing sounds, and gentle concepts that lay the foundation for early learning.
• Toddlers (2‑4 Years): Engage with interactive videos, catchy songs, and fun stories that boost language skills, motor abilities, and sensory exploration.
• Preschoolers (5‑6 Years): Prepare your child for kindergarten with content that sparks curiosity, creativity, and critical thinking, all while having fun!
Key Features & Benefits
Safe, Closed Environment:
Enjoy peace of mind knowing your child is exploring a “walled garden” of carefully curated, age‑appropriate content—no uncontrolled suggestions, just high‑quality learning material.
Child‑Friendly Interface:
With large, easy‑to‑tap buttons and simple navigation, our intuitive design is perfect for early users and pre‑readers.
Built‑In Parental Controls:
Our innovative video player includes a locking mechanism to prevent accidental exits or interruptions, keeping your child focused while you control screen time.
Fresh & Dynamic Content:
Regular updates bring new songs, stories, games, and videos that grow with your child’s needs.
Trusted Quality & Proven Results:
Celebrated by parents worldwide with a 4.3‑star rating from over 31,000 reviews, First is renowned for its enriching content and safe learning environment.
An Engaging Educational Experience
First offers a natural, interactive learning journey for early childhood, toddler, and preschool education. Designed to support child development within a secure digital playground, our safe video player and robust parental controls ensure that your child enjoys only age‑appropriate content. Backed by the legacy of BabyFirst TV and First Media, every feature transforms screen time into a fun and enriching adventure.
Join the many families who trust First to turn screen time into a productive, joyful journey of discovery. Download now to unlock a world of educational adventures—all within a safe, controlled, and stimulating environment.
Every child deserves a bright, inspiring start—let First be the stepping stone to a lifetime of learning and fun!
It’s amusing how fans write our name in so many ways: babyfirst, baby first, Baby First, babyfirst tv, baby first tv, Baby First TV, Baby’s First TV, Babies First TV, babyfirstTV, baby firsttv, Baby TV, bf100, and more. We don’t mind what you call us—as long as you find us first!
We Value Your Feedback
We’d love to hear your thoughts and suggestions! Share your feedback by leaving a review or emailing us at app‑support@first.media.
Privacy & Technical Details
COPPA Compliant. We are committed to your child’s data privacy.
A stable broadband connection is required, and video quality depends on your data connection.
Subscription Details: • Most content requires a subscription. • Your subscription unlocks all paid content, including Games, Sleepy Time, First Songs, and First Books. • Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto‑renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. • Payment is charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation. • Renewal charges occur within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and show the renewal cost. • Manage subscriptions and disable auto‑renew in your account settings. • Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon subscription purchase. • Test free videos before purchasing a subscription.
Please review our Privacy Policy (https://babyfirsttv.com/privacy-policy) and Terms of Use (https://babyfirsttv.com/terms-of-use).

Step into the world of Hero Park and become a legendary medieval Tycoon! Design and manage a bustling town filled with blacksmiths, lively taverns, and dungeons teeming with adventure. Populate your dungeons with fierce monsters to challenge even the bravest heroes, and welcome a cast of unique characters—from daring heroes to quirky shopkeepers and mysterious vampires—each bringing your town to life. bluejetty:00164037:ios.description:
Welcome to Activ Health, your ultimate destination for a healthier, happier you! Discover a world of wellness at your fingertips with our comprehensive health and wellness app. Whether you're looking to lose weight, track your policy details boost your fitness, manage stress, improve sleep, or simply live a healthier life, Activ Health app has you covered.
We believe that your health is in your hands. Hence, with the Activ Health app you can Track and manage your Health, Access Health Care and Access your Health Insurance details at your finger-tips. At every step, our experts will guide and help you get better every day to become the healthiest version of you. We want you to become the healthiest version of you, and we are committed to help you make it happen through the Activ Health App.
Features
# Track & manage your Health: 
· Track your Fitness routine: The app syncs with health and fitness apps on your phone or with your fitness tracking device to o keep track of your health activities and motivate you to stay fit always. 
· Earn your Active Dayz™: Now, track your health activities on the app and earn Active Dayz™. Active Dayz™ can be earned by completing a Fitness centre or yoga centre activity for a minimum of 30 minutes at our panel of Fitness or yoga centres or burning 300 calories or more in one exercise session per day, or simply walking and recording 10,000 steps in a day. Active Dayz™ help you earn Health Rewards (HealthReturns TM ). Health returns can be earned by completing your health assessment and undertaking any one of the activities mentioned above.
· View your Health Returns™ balance: Track your Health Returns™. Funds earned under HealthReturns TM can be used to buy medicines, pay for diagnostic tests, towards the payment of Renewal Premium or it can be kept like a fund for any health emergency.
· A Community to keep you healthy: Become a part of our health community of like-minded fitness enthusiasts. Share your health achievements in our community and secure a leader board rank.
· Store and access your health history: Have a hassle-free experience as the app maintains your health history at one place.
# Access Health Care: 
· Expert Health Coach: We have experts who will help you manage your health better and guide you to a healthy living.
· Experience convenience with health facilities like - Chat with a Doctor, Call a Doctor, Call a Counsellor, Ask a Dietician and more. Also get an easy access to health related requirements like list of hospitals, diagnostic centres, pharmacists in your vicinity to avail cashless benefits
· Stay updated with Health Blogs: Get latest health trends to support your health and fitness, nutrition, lifestyle conditions and mental health needs for an activ living
· Health Tools: These health tools help you to measure your Cholesterol, calculate your blood glucose, blood pressure and more lifestyle conditions
 # Access your Health Insurance details at your finger tips
· Policy details at one-place: Find and edit your policy documents anytime, anywhere at your finger tips
· Raise & Track your claim: An easy claim process - In case of a planned hospitalization or an emergency simply intimate us through the app and we will assist you immediately. Also track the status of your claims through the app
· Renew your policy: Continue to stay protected by renewing your policy through the app easily

bluejetty:00062507:ios.description:
NeuroNation - Brain Training 
Exercise your mind & memory
Enhance your memory with science-backed exercises used by millions of users globally!
Unlock the full potential of your brain with NeuroNation, the scientifically-backed app designed to boost your cognitive abilities. Whether you’re looking to improve your focus, sharpen your mind, or simply have fun with challenging games, our app offers a comprehensive solution.
Features:
Scientifically Proven Techniques: Leverage exercises to enhance your memory, attention, concentration, and problem-solving skills. NeuroNation's brain training has been awarded the AOK Leonardo Health Prize for Digital Prevention sponsored by the German Federal Ministry of Health.
Personalised Training Programs: Tailor-made sessions adapt to your performance, ensuring optimal challenge and growth. NeuroNation performs a comprehensive analysis of your strengths and potential and creates a customised brain training plan that meets your needs.
Diverse Range of Games: Enjoy a variety of brain-stimulating activities including puzzles, memory and speed games, and logic challenges. Increase your thinking speed and concentration and improve your everyday mental performance.
Progress Tracking: Monitor your improvement over time with detailed insights. As you improve, the tasks can become more complex, promoting continuous cognitive growth without plateaus. You can follow your progress closely and benchmark it against your peer group.
Daily Challenges: Engage with new and exciting challenges to keep your brain active daily through NeuroBoosters.
User-Friendly Interface: Navigate easily with our intuitive design, suitable for all ages and skill levels.
Why NeuroNation?
Regular brain exercises help strengthen neural connections, leading to better memory. Daily mental exercises promote neuroplasticity, the brain's ability to reorganize itself by forming new neural connections. 
NeuroNation combines fun and effectiveness, making it easy to incorporate brain training into your daily routine. By using our app, you’re not just playing games — you’re investing in your cognitive health.
In several studies conducted by the Department of General Psychology at Freie Universität Berlin and the Medical School of Hamburg, the effectiveness of NeuroNation working memory training was proven.
Learn more about the science behind NeuroNation: The science behind NeuroNation | NeuroNation 
How It Works:
Our exercises are developed to target specific cognitive functions. Through consistent practice, users can experience improved memory recall, faster information processing, and better daily mental abilities. The app adjusts the difficulty level based on your progress, ensuring that you’re always challenged but never overwhelmed.
NEURONATION PREMIUM
With NeuroNation Premium, you have access to:
Comprehensive cognitive training program with more than 30 motivating exercises
Brain training customisation and in-depth performance insights
Regular publication of new exercises and courses
PRICING AND TERMS OF CONDITIONS

*Prices displayed are in USD. Actual charges might be converted to your local exchange currency depending on your country of residence.
Payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your Premium Membership (subscription) automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Our Privacy policy:

The protection of your data is very important to us. We will never disclose information to third parties and will always treat your data with the strictest confidence.

bluejetty:00168143:ios.summary:

- Register Luna Controllers to your Amazon account

bluejetty:00168143:ios.description:
The Luna Controller app allows you to set up and manage your Luna Controllers and play Luna games using your phone via the Phone Controller.
With the Luna Controller app you can:
- Register Luna Controllers to your Amazon account
- Set up your Luna Controller to connect to wifi and enable Cloud Direct
- Play games on Luna using touch inputs on your mobile device using the Phone Controller
- Add friends to your local Luna gaming session using Guest Mode
- Manage the Cloud Direct wifi connection
- Manage your Luna Controller Bluetooth connection
- Update the software on your Luna Controllers
- Check battery status
- Switch between Cloud Direct and Bluetooth
- Get help for common troubleshooting problems
To set up the Luna Controller:
1. Download and install the Luna Controller app on your mobile device.
2. Power up your Luna Controller with 2 AA batteries. Press and hold the Luna button for 3 seconds, and an orange light will start spinning
3. Open the Luna Controller app and follow the on-screen instructions
To set up a Luna Phone Controller:
No controller? No problem. You can use your phone to play Luna games.
1. Go to the appstore on your mobile device and install the Luna Controller app.
2. Sign into your Amazon account.
3. Select Play With Phone Controller.
The next time you're ready to play, just follow these steps:
1. Open the Luna app on a compatible device, such as a compatible Fire TV, PC or Mac
2. Open the Luna Controller app on your mobile device.
3. Select Launch under your virtual controller and wait for your controller to connect to Luna.
4. Use the virtual controller to select the game you want to play and launch it.
Guests can also download the Luna Controller app and join in on the gameplay.
By using this app, you agree to Amazon’s Conditions of Use (www.amazon.com/conditionsofuse) and Privacy Notice (www.amazon.com/privacy).

6- مؤشرات حركة الأسعار: رسوم بيانية واضحة لحركة الأسعار محليًا وعالميًا.
7- حساب قيمة ممتلكاتك وزكاة المال: احسب قيمة ممتلكاتك الذهبية بناءً على الأسعار اللحظية مع إمكانية حساب الزكاة.
8- حساب المصنعية: أداة دقيقة لحساب مصنعية الذهب سواء عند الشراء أو البيع.
9- التحكم في الإعلانات: تجربة سلسة ومرنة مع إمكانية التحكم في عرض أو إخفاء الإعلانات.
10- التحكم في الإشعارات: خصص إشعاراتك لتصلك تنبيهات الأسعار والأخبار بالطريقة التي تناسبك.
11- احفظ قطعك الذهبية أونلاين: قم بحفظ تفاصيل قطعك الذهبية في حسابك ومزامنتها عبر الأجهزة المختلفة.
12- تحليلات فنية متنوعة: اكتشف تحليلات ورسوم بيانية متقدمة تساعدك في قرارات البيع والشراء.
13- متابعة الأخبار الاقتصادية: آخر الأخبار الاقتصادية من مصادر موثوقة.
14- دليل محلات الصاغة: دليل شامل لمحلات الصاغة في مختلف المدن والمناطق.
15- مشاركة الأسعار بسهولة: شارك أسعار الذهب والدولار مع أصدقائك بنقرة واحدة.
16- دعم للغتين: واجهة استخدام عربية وإنجليزية.
17- وضع السمات: اختر بين الوضع الليلي والفاتح حسب تفضيلك.

bluejetty:00126078:ios.description:
Paste your caption. Get the right hashtags in seconds — graded for reach and checked for Instagram bans.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Copy your caption.
2. Open the app, tap Paste, then tap Hashtags.
3. Tap Copy, then paste into Instagram, TikTok or any app.
That's it. Your hashtags are ready.
GET THE RIGHT HASHTAGS
• Get a ready-to-post set from your caption or a few keywords, best tags first.
• The right number for each app: 5 for Instagram and TikTok, 1 for Threads, and a suggested 2 for X and 5 for LinkedIn.
• Tags show a simple grade (Great, Good, Unused, Overused, Instagram only or Banned) and their size in plain words: Niche, Medium, Big or Huge.
AVOID BANNED HASHTAGS
• For Instagram, Review & Copy checks your set for banned hashtags before you copy. Banned tags are named and left out of your post; Compose names them so you can remove them.
• If a tag can't be checked right now, the app marks it "Not checked" instead of calling it safe.
• Use the same tags every time? Paste them into Score to see which ones work, best first, or tap Check My Last Copy. If some would sink your post, Find Better Tags opens Create for a fresh set.
WRITE A BETTER CAPTION
• Improve your caption, change its tone (funny, professional, casual, inspirational or bold), or make it shorter or longer.
• Add emojis, get catchy opening lines, and get search phrases to work into your caption.
• My Voice: paste a few captions you wrote, and Compose's rewrites will sound like you.
• Don't like a rewrite? Tap Undo to get back what you had before.
• From Photo: pick a photo and get a caption with matching hashtags. Your photo stays on your device; only the hashtags are sent, to be checked.
These AI tools need Apple Intelligence and run on your device. Without it, Add Emojis works online.
CHECK YOUR WHOLE POST
• Compose: write your post with its hashtags and see how it looks on Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn and Threads. Your draft saves itself.
• Talk instead of typing: speak your caption and the app writes it down.
KNOW WHAT TO POST
• Trending: see what's trending worldwide, what a tag is about, and how fresh the list is. Copy a tag in one tap; banned ones can't be copied.
• Coming up: special days ahead, with the hashtag to use.
POST AT THE RIGHT TIME
• Reminders at the best times for each app, or at your own times.
• If you allow alarms, a countdown appears on your Lock Screen 15 minutes before each reminder. Tap Get Hashtags to see your recent tags for that app and your pinned sets.
• Widgets for your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Apple Watch show the next suggested time to post.
KEEP YOUR BEST SETS
• Favorites: save sets by category (Travel, Food, Fitness and more) and pin the ones you use most.
• Copy History: your recent copies (up to 100), saved automatically.
• Insights: your most-used hashtags and your last 7 days, in simple charts.
• Left before copying? Your caption and hashtags are still there when you come back.
ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Your Favorites and Copy History sync with iCloud. On Apple Watch, see what's trending and save a tag to Favorites.
FREE TO START
Try 5 hashtag sets, 5 AI captions and 5 scores for free. A free use only counts when you get a result. Then go unlimited with a weekly, monthly or yearly Pro plan. New subscribers get a 3-day free trial. Cancel anytime.
Making hashtags, Score, Trending, Coming up, the banned check and online Add Emojis need an internet connection.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://fierce-inlet-63133.herokuapp.com/insight-privacy-and-term
